champions.name: Aatrox
champions.title: the Darkin Blade

playstyle.identity: Aatrox is a drain-tank juggernaut who sustains through fights with his massive healing. He excels at teamfighting and diving backlines, becoming nearly unkillable when ahead.
playstyle.howToPlay: Land your Q sweetspots (the edge of each swing) for maximum damage and knockups. Chain Q1 > W > Q2 > Q3 for a full combo. Use E to reposition Q hitboxes. In teamfights, use R to amp your healing and dive priority targets.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Aatrox spikes hard at level 3 with all Q ranks and again at 6 with his ultimate's healing amp. Eclipse or Black Cleaver first item makes him a serious threat. He's strongest in mid-game teamfights.

strengths: Massive sustain in fights with passive and R healing
Strong teamfight presence with AoE damage and CC
Can dive backlines effectively with ultimate
weaknesses: Healing countered hard by Grievous Wounds
Q sweetspots are telegraphed and dodgeable
Falls off late game against scaling carries
Vulnerable when abilities are on cooldown

passive.name: Deathbringer Stance
passive.summary: Periodically empowers next auto to deal bonus damage and heal Aatrox.
passive.details: Every few seconds, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and heals him. The cooldown is reduced when Aatrox hits enemies with abilities or attacks.

abilities.name: The Darkin Blade
abilities.summary: Three-part sword swing with knockups at the sweetspot edges.
abilities.details: Aatrox swings his sword up to three times, each dealing damage in an area. The edge of each swing (sweetspot) deals more damage and knocks up enemies. Can be recast twice for the second and third swings.

abilities.name: Infernal Chains
abilities.summary: Fires a chain that slows and pulls enemies back if they don't escape.
abilities.details: Aatrox fires a chain that damages and slows the first enemy hit. If they remain in the area, they're pulled back to the center after a delay.

abilities.name: Umbral Dash
abilities.summary: Short dash that can be used during Q to reposition.
abilities.details: Aatrox dashes a short distance. Passively grants omnivamp against champions. Can be cast during Q to reposition the sweetspot.

abilities.name: World Ender
abilities.summary: Transform to increase damage, healing, and movement speed. Resets on takedown.
abilities.details: Aatrox unleashes his true form, gaining movement speed, increased damage, and massively increased healing. Duration extends on champion takedown. Fears nearby minions on activation.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.title: the Nine-Tailed Fox

playstyle.identity: Ahri is a mobile burst mage who excels at picking off targets with her charm and dashing in for the kill. Her kit rewards patience and precision, allowing her to weave in and out of fights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Land Charm (E) to set up your combo: follow with Q through the target for both hits, then W. Use your ultimate's three dashes to reposition, chase, or escape. In lane, poke with Q and look for charm opportunities when enemies overstep.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ahri spikes hard at level 6 when she gains her ultimate's mobility. She's strong with first item completion (typically Luden's) and becomes a serious threat in the mid-game when roaming.

strengths: High mobility with three ultimate dashes
Safe laning with sustain from passive
weaknesses: Charm is telegraphed and can be dodged
Falls off compared to scaling mages late game
Vulnerable when ultimate is on cooldown

passive.name: Essence Theft
passive.summary: Gain healing when hitting enemies with abilities.
passive.details: Ahri gains a stack of Essence Theft when her abilities hit enemies (up to 3 per cast). At 9 stacks, her next ability heals her for each enemy hit. This sustain helps her survive poke in lane and stay healthy in extended fights.

abilities.name: Orb of Deception
abilities.summary: Throw an orb that deals magic damage out and true damage on return.
abilities.details: Ahri throws her orb in a line, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back. The true damage portion ignores magic resistance, making this ability effective against tanky targets. It's your primary waveclear and poke tool.

abilities.name: Fox-Fire
abilities.summary: Release three flames that automatically target nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Ahri releases three fox-fires that seek out nearby enemies, prioritizing champions hit by Charm. The flames deal reduced damage to minions. This is your main DPS in close-range fights and helps with last-hitting while trading.

abilities.name: Charm
abilities.summary: Blow a kiss that charms the first enemy hit, making them walk toward you.
abilities.details: Ahri blows a kiss that charms the first enemy hit, causing them to walk harmlessly toward her while taking increased damage from her abilities. Landing Charm is crucial for your burst combo and creates pick opportunities.

abilities.name: Spirit Rush
abilities.summary: Dash up to three times, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Ahri dashes and fires essence bolts at nearby enemies. She can recast this up to two more times within a window. The dashes can cross walls and the bolts prioritize champions. This is your main outplay tool for dodging, chasing, or escaping.

playstyle.identity: Akali is a high-mobility assassin who weaves in and out of fights with her shroud. She excels at diving backlines and escaping with her multiple dashes.
playstyle.howToPlay: Use passive-empowered autos between abilities for maximum damage. W shroud grants invisibility and energy restore. E marks targets for a second dash. R1 engages, R2 executes. Combo: R1 > E > Q > auto > E2 > Q > R2.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Akali spikes at level 6 with her execute ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds another gap closer. She's strong in mid-game skirmishes and picks.

passive.name: Assassin's Mark
passive.summary: Abilities create a ring around enemies; crossing it empowers next auto.
passive.details: Damaging a champion with an ability creates a ring around them. Crossing the ring empowers Akali's next auto attack to deal bonus magic damage and restore energy.

abilities.name: Five Point Strike
abilities.summary: Throws kunai in a cone, slowing at max range.
abilities.details: Akali throws kunai in a cone, dealing magic damage. Enemies at maximum range are briefly slowed. At max rank, heals Akali if she's missing health.

abilities.name: Twilight Shroud
abilities.summary: Creates a smoke cloud that grants invisibility and restores energy.
abilities.details: Akali drops a smoke bomb, creating a shroud that expands. While inside, she's invisible and gains movement speed. Restores energy and extends duration when entering. Attacking briefly reveals her.

abilities.name: Shuriken Flip
abilities.summary: Backflip that throws a shuriken; recast to dash to marked target.
abilities.details: Akali flips backward, throwing a shuriken that damages and marks the first enemy hit. Recast to dash to the marked target, dealing damage again.

abilities.name: Perfect Execution
abilities.summary: Two-part ultimate: first dash stuns, second dash executes low health targets.
abilities.details: First cast: Akali dashes through an enemy champion, dealing damage and briefly stunning. Second cast: Dash in a direction, dealing damage that scales with missing health. Must wait briefly between casts.

playstyle.identity: Akshan is a roaming marksman who revives allies by killing enemies who killed them. His grappling hook provides unique mobility for an ADC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive marks enemy 'Scoundrels' who killed your allies - kill them to revive those allies. Q boomerang extends on champion hit. E swings around terrain for resets. W goes invisible near walls. R is a lock-on channel.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Akshan spikes at level 6 with his lock-on ultimate. Kraken and on-hit scale his DPS. He's strong at roaming and resurrecting allies mid-game.

passive.name: Dirty Fighting
passive.summary: Every three hits deal bonus damage; cancelled autos fire faster second shot.
passive.details: Every third hit deals bonus magic damage. If Akali cancels an auto attack, the second shot fires much faster. Killing Scoundrels (enemies who killed allies) revives those allies.

abilities.name: Avengerang
abilities.summary: Throws a boomerang that extends range on champion hit.
abilities.details: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and back. Range extends each time it hits a champion. Reveals enemies briefly.

abilities.name: Going Rogue
abilities.summary: Passive marks Scoundrels; active grants camouflage near terrain.
abilities.details: Passive: Enemy champions who kill Akshan's allies become Scoundrels. Killing a Scoundrel revives allies they killed. Active: Akshan becomes camouflaged near terrain and gains movement speed toward Scoundrels.

abilities.name: Heroic Swing
abilities.summary: Grappling hook that swings around terrain while firing at enemies.
abilities.details: Akshan fires a grappling hook that attaches to terrain. He swings around it, firing at the nearest enemy. Can jump off early. Cooldown resets on takedown.

abilities.name: Comeuppance
abilities.summary: Lock-on channel that fires bullets; blocked by first champion hit.
abilities.details: Akshan locks onto an enemy champion and channels, then fires bullets that deal damage. Bullets are blocked by the first enemy champion hit, making it best for isolated targets.

playstyle.identity: Alistar is a tanky engage support with a devastating headbutt-pulverize combo. He excels at initiating fights and peeling for carries.
playstyle.howToPlay: W-Q combo (headbutt into instant pulverize) is your bread and butter for engage. E heals nearby allies when you auto. R cleanses CC and massively reduces damage taken. Flash-Q for surprise engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Alistar spikes at level 2 with W-Q combo and level 6 with damage reduction. Tank items make him nearly unkillable during R. He's strong at all stages as an engager.

passive.name: Triumphant Roar
passive.summary: Heal yourself and nearby allies when you stun or enemies die nearby.
passive.details: Alistar builds Triumph stacks when enemies die nearby or he stuns/knocks up. At full stacks, he heals himself and nearby allied champions.

abilities.name: Pulverize
abilities.summary: Stomp the ground to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing magic damage and knocking up enemies around him. Core part of the W-Q engage combo.

abilities.name: Headbutt
abilities.summary: Charge to an enemy, knocking them back and stunning briefly.
abilities.details: Alistar dashes to a target enemy, dealing damage and knocking them back. Can be used to knock enemies into your team or instantly followed by Q to combo.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.summary: Deal damage around you; at max stacks, next auto stuns.
abilities.details: Alistar tramples the ground around him, dealing damage over time. Each tick against champions builds stacks; at max stacks, his next auto attack stuns.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Will
abilities.summary: Cleanse CC and massively reduce incoming damage.
abilities.details: Alistar roars, removing all crowd control and taking massively reduced damage for several seconds. Lets him dive towers and survive focus.

playstyle.identity: Ambessa is a dashing bruiser who chains ability combos for constant repositioning. She excels at extended fights where she can weave dashes between abilities.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive lets you dash after abilities. Q slashes and resets. W blocks and counters. E is a combo tool dash. R marks and lets you repeatedly dash to targets. Chain abilities with passive dashes for constant mobility.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ambessa spikes at level 3 with full combo access and level 6 with her chase ultimate. Trinity Force and bruiser items scale her. She's strong in skirmishes throughout.

passive.name: Drakehound's Step
passive.summary: After abilities, next auto dashes you forward and deals bonus damage.
passive.details: Casting abilities empowers Ambessa's next basic attack to dash her toward the target, dealing bonus damage and healing her.

abilities.name: Cunning Sweep
abilities.summary: Slash in a direction; hitting enemies resets it once.
abilities.details: Ambessa slashes in a direction, dealing damage. If it hits an enemy, she can recast once. Generates energy for her passive.

abilities.name: Repudiation
abilities.summary: Enter a defensive stance; block damage then counter-strike.
abilities.details: Ambessa braces, reducing incoming damage from one direction. After blocking or after the duration, she strikes forward dealing damage.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.summary: Dash and slash, pulling enemies hit toward you.
abilities.details: Ambessa dashes and slashes, dealing damage and pulling enemies slightly toward her. Good combo starter or extender.

abilities.name: Public Execution
abilities.summary: Mark an enemy; gain repeated dashes toward marked targets.
abilities.details: Ambessa marks an enemy champion. While marked, she can repeatedly dash to them, dealing damage. Marking a new target refreshes the ability.

playstyle.identity: Amumu is a tank jungler with two bandage tosses and a teamfight-winning ultimate. He's simple to play and excels at engaging on grouped enemies.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q has two charges for engaging or chasing. W toggles AoE tears around you. E deals damage and reduces cooldown when hit. R stuns all enemies around you. Q into a group, R, then W-E for massive AoE damage and CC.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Amumu spikes at level 6 with his AoE stun ultimate. Sunfire and tank items scale his damage and durability. He's strong in teamfights at all stages.

passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.summary: Auto attacks curse enemies to take bonus true damage.
passive.details: Amumu's basic attacks curse enemies for a few seconds, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

abilities.name: Bandage Toss
abilities.summary: Throw a bandage that pulls you to the first enemy hit. Two charges.
abilities.details: Amumu throws out a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit and stunning them. Stores up to two charges.

abilities.name: Despair
abilities.summary: Toggle AoE tears that deal percent health magic damage around you.
abilities.details: Amumu cries, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies based on their max health. Drains mana while active.

abilities.name: Tantrum
abilities.summary: Deal AoE damage around you; cooldown reduced when hit.
abilities.details: Amumu has a tantrum, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. Passively reduces physical damage taken, and the cooldown is reduced each time Amumu is hit.

abilities.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
abilities.summary: Stun all nearby enemies in a large area.
abilities.details: Amumu entangles all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage and stunning them. One of the best teamfight ultimates in the game.

playstyle.identity: Anivia is a control mage with incredible zone control and a revive passive. She excels at stalling games and controlling chokepoints with her wall and ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q stuns on reactivation (pass through then detonate). W creates impassable terrain. E deals double damage to chilled (Q/R) targets. R is a persistent blizzard zone. Wall enemies into your R, then E for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Anivia spikes at level 6 with her zone control ultimate. Tear stacking and Rod of Ages scale her. She's a late-game monster with waveclear and control.

passive.name: Rebirth
passive.summary: On death, become an egg that revives after a few seconds if not killed.
passive.details: When Anivia takes lethal damage, she transforms into an egg for several seconds. If the egg survives, she's reborn with health. Long cooldown.

abilities.name: Flash Frost
abilities.summary: Launch a slow-moving ball that stuns and chills on reactivation.
abilities.details: Anivia fires a chunk of ice that damages and chills enemies it passes through. Reactivate to detonate, stunning and damaging enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Crystallize
abilities.summary: Create an impassable ice wall.
abilities.details: Anivia creates a wall of ice that blocks movement. Can be used to trap enemies, block paths, or interrupt dashes. Doesn't damage.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.summary: Deal damage to a target; deals double damage if they're chilled.
abilities.details: Anivia blasts an enemy with frost, dealing magic damage. If the target was recently damaged by Q or R (chilled), the damage is doubled.

abilities.name: Glacial Storm
abilities.summary: Create a persistent blizzard that chills and damages enemies inside.
abilities.details: Anivia creates an expanding blizzard zone that deals damage per second and chills enemies. Drains mana while active and can be toggled off. Interrupted by CC.

playstyle.identity: Annie is a burst mage with a point-and-click stun and a giant bear ultimate. She's simple but deadly, able to flash-R delete entire teams.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks stun every 4 abilities. Q is point-and-click (refunds mana on kill). W is a cone. E shields and damages. R summons Tibbers who fights for you. Stack to stun, then Flash-R-W-Q for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Annie spikes at level 6 with Tibbers burst. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage range. She's strong at all stages with reliable point-and-click stun.

passive.name: Pyromania
passive.summary: Every 4 ability casts, next damaging ability stuns.
passive.details: After casting 4 abilities, Annie's next damaging ability will stun enemies hit. A swirling indicator shows when stun is ready.

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.summary: Point-and-click fireball that refunds mana and cooldown on kill.
abilities.details: Annie hurls a fireball at an enemy, dealing magic damage. If it kills the target, the mana cost and cooldown are refunded.

abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.summary: Cone of fire damage in front of Annie.
abilities.details: Annie releases a cone of fire, dealing magic damage to all enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Molten Shield
abilities.summary: Shield yourself or Tibbers; damages enemies who attack.
abilities.details: Annie grants herself or Tibbers a shield that absorbs damage and grants movement speed. Enemies who attack the shielded target take magic damage.

abilities.name: Summon: Tibbers
abilities.summary: Summon a giant bear that deals AoE damage on arrival and fights for you.
abilities.details: Annie summons Tibbers, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. Tibbers stays and fights, dealing burn damage around him. Annie can direct Tibbers to attack.

champions.name: Aphelios
champions.title: the Weapon of the Faithful

playstyle.identity: Aphelios is the most complex ADC in the game with five different weapons that cycle in a set order. Mastering his weapon combinations unlocks devastating teamfight potential that no other marksman can match.
playstyle.howToPlay: Track your weapon queue and plan ahead. Each weapon has 50 ammo - when depleted, it goes to the back of the queue. Q costs ammo and combos with your off-hand weapon. Learn the key combos: Calibrum+Gravitum for long-range roots, Infernum+Severum for teamfight healing, Crescendum+anything for turret DPS.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Aphelios spikes at level 2 with both abilities unlocked. He's extremely strong with certain weapon combinations (Infernum R). Scales well with crit items and becomes a late-game monster with proper weapon management.

strengths: Some weapon combos are incredibly powerful
Infernum R can wipe entire teams
Strong sustained DPS and burst depending on weapons
weaknesses: Power varies wildly based on current weapons
Can get stuck with bad weapon combos at crucial moments

passive.name: The Hitman and the Seer
passive.summary: Cycle through 5 weapons with unique effects; off-hand weapon empowers abilities.
passive.details: Aphelios has 5 weapons that cycle in order. Main hand attacks and off-hand empowers Q. Weapons: Calibrum (extra range), Severum (lifesteal), Gravitum (slow), Infernum (AoE), Crescendum (close-range chakram). Each weapon has 50 ammo - manage them carefully.

abilities.name: Weapon Abilities
abilities.summary: Each weapon has a unique Q ability that also applies off-hand effects.
abilities.details: Calibrum Q: Long-range skillshot, marks target for bonus damage. Severum Q: Rapidly fire both weapons while moving. Gravitum Q: Root all enemies affected by Gravitum slow. Infernum Q: Spray flames in a cone. Crescendum Q: Deploy a turret that attacks with off-hand.

abilities.name: Phase
abilities.summary: Swap between main-hand and off-hand weapons.
abilities.details: Instantly swap your main-hand and off-hand weapons. This is crucial for managing your weapon queue and setting up the right combinations. Use it to access the right weapon for each situation or to prepare for teamfights.

abilities.name: Weapon Queue System
abilities.summary: Aphelios has no E - weapons cycle automatically when ammo depletes.
abilities.details: Unlike other champions, Aphelios has no E ability. Instead, his weapon queue system replaces it. When a weapon runs out of ammo (50 shots), it moves to the back of the queue and the next weapon becomes available. Plan your ammo usage to have the right weapons ready.

abilities.name: Moonlight Vigil
abilities.summary: Fire a moon blast that applies your main-hand weapon's effect in an AoE.
abilities.details: Aphelios fires a concentrated blast that explodes on the first enemy hit, damaging nearby enemies. The explosion applies your main-hand weapon's effect to all enemies hit. Infernum R is devastating (flames spread between enemies), Gravitum R roots everyone, Crescendum R generates max chakrams.

playstyle.identity: Ashe is a utility ADC with global engage and constant slows. She excels at kiting, vision control, and initiating fights from across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive slows enemies with autos. Q stacks then activates for a flurry of arrows. W pokes and slows. E reveals anywhere on map. R is a global stun arrow (longer stun at range). Use W to poke, Q for DPS, R to engage or catch.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ashe spikes with Kraken Slayer and attack speed. Her utility is strong at all stages. She scales well into late game teamfights.

passive.name: Frost Shot
passive.summary: Auto attacks slow enemies and deal bonus damage to slowed targets.
passive.details: Ashe's attacks slow enemies. Attacks against enemies already slowed by Frost Shot deal bonus damage based on crit chance instead of critting.

abilities.name: Ranger's Focus
abilities.summary: Stack with autos, then activate for rapid-fire attacks.
abilities.details: Passive: Ashe builds Focus stacks with attacks. Active: Consume stacks to gain attack speed and fire a flurry of arrows with each attack.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.summary: Fire a cone of arrows that slow the first enemies hit.
abilities.details: Ashe fires arrows in a cone, dealing damage and applying Frost Shot slow to the first enemy hit per arrow.

abilities.name: Hawkshot
abilities.summary: Send a hawk anywhere on the map to reveal an area.
abilities.details: Ashe sends a hawk spirit to scout anywhere on the map, revealing terrain as it travels and briefly revealing an area at the destination.

abilities.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
abilities.summary: Global stun arrow that stuns longer at greater distance.
abilities.details: Ashe fires a giant arrow globally. The first enemy champion hit takes damage and is stunned; stun duration increases with distance traveled.

playstyle.identity: Aurelion Sol is a scaling mage who permanently grows stronger by absorbing Stardust. His abilities expand with stacks, eventually becoming map-wide threats.
playstyle.howToPlay: All abilities generate Stardust stacks that scale your kit. Q explodes and executes. W is your main damage, dropping stars in a line. E flies over terrain. R creates a massive black hole. Farm Stardust stacks to become unstoppable late.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Aurelion Sol spikes at Stardust thresholds (75, 150+). Rod of Ages and mana scale him. He's a late-game hypercarry mage who needs to scale.

passive.name: Cosmic Creator
passive.summary: Damaging enemies generates Stardust that permanently scales your abilities.
passive.details: Aurelion Sol's abilities generate Stardust stacks. Stardust permanently increases the size, damage, and effects of his abilities.

abilities.name: Breath of Light
abilities.summary: Channel a beam of starfire that deals damage and executes low HP targets.
abilities.details: Aurelion Sol channels starfire in a direction, dealing damage. Enemies below a health threshold are executed. Generates Stardust on hits.

abilities.name: Astral Flight
abilities.summary: Fly over terrain; during flight, Q has no cooldown.
abilities.details: Aurelion Sol flies in a direction, passing through terrain. During flight, Breath of Light has no cooldown. Can be recast to drop early.

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.summary: Summon a black hole that pulls enemies and detonates.
abilities.details: Aurelion Sol creates a singularity that pulls enemies toward its center. After a delay, it detonates dealing damage. Size scales with Stardust.

abilities.name: Falling Star / The Skies Descend
abilities.summary: Crash a star down; at 75 Stardust, becomes a massive shockwave.
abilities.details: Aurelion Sol crashes a star dealing damage and stunning. At 75 Stardust, transforms into The Skies Descend, a massive shockwave that knocks up and deals huge damage.

champions.name: Aurora
champions.title: the Witch Between Worlds

playstyle.identity: Aurora is a bunny-hopping burst mage who dashes between spirit realm and reality. She excels at repositioning and bursting with her spirit-powered abilities.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals and damages when exiting targets. Q curses then procs for damage. W dashes and enters spirit realm (heals). E is a skillshot that can hit spirits. R traps enemies in a zone they can't escape. Hop in and out to proc passive.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Aurora spikes at level 6 with her trapping ultimate. AP items scale her burst. She's strong at picks and teamfight zone control.

weaknesses: R can be escaped with dashes

passive.name: Spirit Abjuration
passive.summary: Exiting enemies heals you and deals damage; entering marks them.
passive.details: When Aurora enters an enemy, she marks them. Exiting marked enemies deals magic damage and heals her. Rewards weaving in and out of fights.

abilities.name: Twofold Hex
abilities.summary: Fire a missile that curses, then fire again to detonate for damage.
abilities.details: Aurora fires a missile that damages and curses enemies. Recast sends another missile that deals additional damage to cursed targets.

abilities.name: Across the Veil
abilities.summary: Hop and enter spirit realm briefly, becoming untargetable and healing.
abilities.details: Aurora hops in a direction and briefly enters the spirit realm, becoming untargetable, healing, and gaining movement speed. She can hop again while in spirit realm.

abilities.name: The Weirding
abilities.summary: Skillshot that damages and slows, also hitting spirits.
abilities.details: Aurora sends out a spirit missile that damages and slows enemies. Can hit enemies in the spirit realm as well.

abilities.name: Between Worlds
abilities.summary: Create a zone that traps enemies inside, preventing escape.
abilities.details: Aurora creates a large zone. Enemies inside can't leave the zone (dashes and movement are blocked at the edge). She can freely enter and exit.

champions.name: Azir
champions.title: the Emperor of the Sands

playstyle.identity: Azir is an emperor mage who commands sand soldiers to fight for him. He's one of the hardest champions to master but rewards that mastery with incredible zone control and late-game damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Summon soldiers with W and command them with Q to reposition. Soldiers attack enemies you right-click - they're your main damage source. Use E to dash to your soldiers for mobility or escape. The Shurima Shuffle (E through soldiers, then R to push enemies into your team) is your signature play.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Azir spikes at level 2 when he can combo W+Q for poke. He gets a major spike with Nashor's Tooth for soldier DPS. He's a late-game monster - one of the best scaling mages in the game with proper positioning.

strengths: Game-changing ultimate for engage or disengage
weaknesses: Extremely high skill ceiling and floor
Relies on soldiers being in good positions

passive.name: Shurima's Legacy
passive.summary: Azir can summon a turret on destroyed tower ruins.
passive.details: Azir can click on the ruins of any destroyed turret (ally or enemy) to raise a Sun Disc - a tower that lasts for a period of time. It's useful for sieging or defending, providing zone control and chip damage.

abilities.name: Conquering Sands
abilities.summary: Command all soldiers to dash to a location, damaging and slowing enemies.
abilities.details: All active Sand Soldiers dash toward the target location, damaging and slowing enemies they pass through. This is how you reposition soldiers for damage or poke. It also extends soldier attack range for a brief moment, enabling long-range poke combos.

abilities.name: Arise!
abilities.summary: Summon a Sand Soldier that attacks enemies you command.
abilities.details: Azir summons a Sand Soldier at the target location. When you attack an enemy in range of a soldier, the soldiers stab in that direction, dealing magic damage. Soldiers are your primary damage source - keep them positioned where enemies want to be.

abilities.name: Shifting Sands
abilities.summary: Dash to one of your soldiers, gaining a shield; stop on enemy collision.
abilities.details: Azir dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, gaining a shield. If he collides with an enemy champion, he stops and gains an additional soldier. This is mobility, escape, and engage all in one. The E+Q combo (E then Q mid-dash) extends your dash range dramatically.

abilities.name: Emperor's Divide
abilities.summary: Summon a wall of soldiers that pushes enemies and blocks dashes.
abilities.details: Azir summons a wall of shield soldiers that charge forward, knocking back and damaging enemies. The wall then remains as terrain that enemies cannot dash through. Use it to disengage, peel, or perform the Shurima Shuffle to push enemies into your team.

playstyle.identity: Bard is a roaming support who collects chimes across the map. His magical journey portals and ultimate stasis create unique playmaking opportunities.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive spawns chimes - collect them for mana, XP, and meep upgrades. Q stuns if it hits two targets or a target and wall. W heals over time. E creates a portal through terrain. R puts everything in an area into stasis. Roam for chimes, E to gank, R to engage or disengage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Bard spikes with chime collection (stronger meeps) and level 6 for R plays. Roaming early creates leads. He scales well with chimes throughout.

passive.name: Traveler's Call
passive.summary: Chimes spawn across the map; meeps empower auto attacks.
passive.details: Chimes spawn across the map - collecting them grants experience, mana, and buffs Bard's meeps. Meeps are spirits that empower his auto attacks with bonus damage and slows.

abilities.name: Cosmic Binding
abilities.summary: Fire a missile that stuns if it hits two targets or one target and terrain.
abilities.details: Bard fires a missile that damages and slows the first enemy. If it hits another enemy or terrain behind them, both targets are stunned.

abilities.name: Caretaker's Shrine
abilities.summary: Place a healing shrine that powers up over time.
abilities.details: Bard places a shrine that heals and speeds up the first ally to touch it. The heal increases if the shrine charges for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Magical Journey
abilities.summary: Create a portal through terrain that anyone can use.
abilities.details: Bard opens a one-way corridor through terrain. Any champion can use the portal - allies travel faster through it than enemies.

abilities.name: Tempered Fate
abilities.summary: Put everything in an area into stasis (untargetable and invulnerable).
abilities.details: Bard puts all units in an area into stasis for a few seconds - they can't act but can't be damaged. Affects champions, minions, monsters, and towers. Can save allies or freeze enemies.

playstyle.identity: Bel'Veth is a scaling jungler who consumes Void Coral to infinitely stack attack speed. She transforms into her true form after eating epic monsters.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q dashes in 4 directions (separate cooldowns). W knocks up and damages. E channels damage reduction and explosions. R consumes Void Coral (from camps/champions) for form and spawns void minions from epic monster coral. Stack attack speed, transform, take over.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Bel'Veth spikes after consuming Rift Herald or Dragon coral. Kraken and attack speed scale her infinitely. She's a late-game monster.

passive.name: Death in Lavender
passive.summary: Killing units drops Void Coral that permanently stacks attack speed.
passive.details: Takedowns leave Void Coral. Consuming coral permanently increases attack speed. Large monsters and champions grant more stacks. After true form, attack speed becomes uncapped.

abilities.name: Void Surge
abilities.summary: Dash in one of four directions; each direction has a separate cooldown.
abilities.details: Bel'Veth dashes in a direction, dealing damage. Each of the four directions (relative to her) has a separate cooldown, reduced by attacking.

abilities.name: Above and Below
abilities.summary: Knock up and damage enemies in a direction.
abilities.details: Bel'Veth slams the ground, dealing damage and knocking up enemies in a line. Slow enemies take increased damage.

abilities.name: Royal Maelstrom
abilities.summary: Channel damage reduction while dealing damage around you; lowest HP enemy takes more.
abilities.details: Bel'Veth channels, gaining damage reduction and dealing damage around her. The lowest health enemy takes increased damage. Explodes at the end.

abilities.name: Endless Banquet
abilities.summary: Consume Void Coral to transform; epic monster coral spawns void minions.
abilities.details: Passive: Champions and epic monsters drop Void Coral. Active: Consume coral to heal and transform into True Form, gaining explosion on autos and health. Epic monster coral spawns void minions.

playstyle.identity: Blitzcrank is a hook support who can single-handedly win fights by grabbing a squishy. Landing one hook can instantly delete an enemy carry.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q hooks the first enemy hit and pulls them to you. W gives speed but slows after. E knocks up your next auto attack. R silences and damages around you. Land Q, E knockup, R silence for full combo. One hook wins fights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Blitzcrank spikes at level 2 with hook-knockup combo. He's strong at all stages - one hook can always win a fight regardless of game time.

passive.name: Mana Barrier
passive.summary: When low on health, gain a shield based on mana.
passive.details: When Blitzcrank drops to low health, he gains a shield that absorbs damage based on his current mana. Has a long cooldown.

abilities.name: Rocket Grab
abilities.summary: Fire a fist that grabs the first enemy hit and pulls them to you.
abilities.details: Blitzcrank fires his right hand, grabbing the first enemy hit and pulling them to him, dealing damage and stunning briefly.

abilities.name: Overdrive
abilities.summary: Gain massive movement speed, but slow yourself when it ends.
abilities.details: Blitzcrank supercharges, gaining movement and attack speed for a few seconds. When it ends, he's slowed briefly.

abilities.name: Power Fist
abilities.summary: Next auto attack knocks up the target.
abilities.details: Blitzcrank charges his fist, causing his next auto attack to deal double damage and knock up the target.

abilities.name: Static Field
abilities.summary: Passive: autos spark lightning. Active: Silence and damage enemies around you.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks zap a nearby enemy for magic damage. Active: Blitzcrank detonates, dealing damage and silencing all nearby enemies.

playstyle.identity: Brand is a combo mage who stacks ablaze for maximum damage. His ultimate bounces between enemies, making him devastating against grouped teams.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities apply Ablaze. E spreads to nearby ablaze targets. Q stuns ablaze targets. W does bonus damage to ablaze. R bounces between enemies (prioritizes champions). Combo: E-Q for stun, or W-E for spread, then R into grouped enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Brand spikes at level 6 with his bouncing ultimate. Liandry's burn synergizes with his passive. He's strong in teamfights against grouped enemies.

passive.name: Blaze
passive.summary: Abilities set enemies ablaze; 3 stacks detonates for % max health damage.
passive.details: Brand's abilities apply Ablaze, dealing damage over time. Hitting an ablaze enemy with 3 stacks causes them to detonate, dealing percent max health damage in an area.

abilities.name: Sear
abilities.summary: Fire a fireball that stuns ablaze targets.
abilities.details: Brand launches a fireball that deals damage. If the target is ablaze, they're stunned.

abilities.name: Pillar of Flame
abilities.summary: After a delay, explode an area; deals bonus damage to ablaze targets.
abilities.details: Brand creates a pillar of flame that erupts after a delay, dealing magic damage. Ablaze enemies take bonus damage.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.summary: Set a target ablaze; spreads to nearby ablaze enemies.
abilities.details: Brand sets a target ablaze, dealing magic damage. If the target is already ablaze, the fire spreads to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Pyroclasm
abilities.summary: Bouncing fireball that prioritizes champions and ablaze targets.
abilities.details: Brand launches a fireball that bounces between enemies up to 5 times, dealing damage each bounce. Prioritizes champions and ablaze targets. Slows ablaze targets.

playstyle.identity: Braum is a protective tank support whose shield blocks all projectiles. He excels at peeling for carries and providing engage with his ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks stuns with ally autos. Q slows and applies passive. W jumps to an ally, giving armor/MR. E shield blocks ALL projectiles from one direction. R knocks up in a line and creates a slow zone. Stand in front of carries, E to block, R to engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Braum spikes at level 6 with his engage ultimate. Tank items make him durable. He's strong at protecting carries at all stages.

passive.name: Concussive Blows
passive.summary: Autos and Q apply stacks; at 4 stacks, target is stunned.
passive.details: Braum's auto attacks apply Concussive Blows. After applying a stack, allies can add stacks with their autos. At 4 stacks, the target is stunned and takes bonus damage.

abilities.name: Winter's Bite
abilities.summary: Fire ice that slows and applies passive stack.
abilities.details: Braum propels ice from his shield, dealing damage, slowing, and applying a stack of Concussive Blows to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Stand Behind Me
abilities.summary: Jump to an ally, giving you both bonus armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Braum leaps to an ally, positioning himself between them and enemies. Both Braum and the ally gain bonus armor and magic resist.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.summary: Raise shield that blocks ALL projectiles from that direction.
abilities.details: Braum raises his shield, blocking all projectiles from that direction. He takes reduced damage from the first hit and negates all subsequent hits while gaining movement speed.

abilities.name: Glacial Fissure
abilities.summary: Slam the ground to knock up enemies in a line and create a slow zone.
abilities.details: Braum slams the ground, creating a fissure that knocks up enemies in a line (first enemy hit is knocked up longer). A slow field persists in the area.

champions.name: Briar
champions.title: the Restrained Hunger

playstyle.identity: Briar is a frenzied diver who loses control to gain power. She has no base health regen and must heal through combat while her abilities make her go berserk.
playstyle.howToPlay: No base health regen - heal only through damage. Q bites to heal. W enters frenzy (auto-attacks nearest enemy). E charges to knockup and stun against walls. R is global - she flies to a target and frenzies them down. W carefully, R to engage from anywhere.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Briar spikes at level 6 with global engage. Blade of the Ruined King sustains her. She's strong at diving and picking throughout.

weaknesses: Can be kited if W ends

passive.name: Crimson Curse
passive.summary: No base regen; heal from abilities based on damage dealt. Abilities apply bleed.
passive.details: Briar has no base health regeneration. Instead, she heals based on damage dealt. Her abilities cause enemies to bleed, healing her and dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: Head Rush
abilities.summary: Dash and bite to stun briefly and heal.
abilities.details: Briar dashes to an enemy and bites them, dealing damage, stunning them briefly, and healing based on damage dealt. While frenzied, she can't choose targets.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack
abilities.summary: Enter frenzy to auto the nearest enemy; recast to bite.
abilities.details: Briar enters a frenzy, gaining attack speed and movement speed but losing control (attacks nearest enemy). Recast to empower next attack to bite for healing. Can be cancelled by E.

abilities.name: Chilling Scream
abilities.summary: Charge a scream that damages, knocks back, and stuns against terrain.
abilities.details: Briar channels then screams, dealing damage and knocking back enemies. Enemies knocked into walls are stunned. Removes Blood Frenzy.

abilities.name: Certain Death
abilities.summary: Fly to a target anywhere on the map and enter an enhanced frenzy.
abilities.details: Briar kicks a hemolith globally, flying to the first champion hit. On arrival, she enters an empowered frenzy focused on that target, gaining bonus stats and fearing nearby enemies.

playstyle.identity: Caitlyn is a long-range ADC who controls fights with traps and poke. She excels at sieging and has one of the longest attack ranges in the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive headshots deal bonus damage (stacks from autos and traps/net). Q pokes through targets. W places traps that root and grant headshot. E net knocks you back and slows enemy. R is a long-range sniper shot. Trap enemies, headshot them, ult to finish.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Caitlyn spikes at levels 1-2 with range advantage and at first item. Infinity Edge and crit scale her. She's strongest early and late, weaker mid.

passive.name: Headshot
passive.summary: Every few autos, or after trap/net, next auto is a headshot dealing bonus damage.
passive.details: Caitlyn's next attack deals bonus damage after gaining stacks from autos and abilities. Traps and nets instantly grant headshot on targets they hit.

abilities.name: Piltover Peacemaker
abilities.summary: Fire a piercing shot that deals damage in a line.
abilities.details: Caitlyn charges briefly, then fires a shot that damages enemies in a line. Deals reduced damage to targets after the first.

abilities.name: Yordle Snap Trap
abilities.summary: Place traps that root enemies and grant headshot.
abilities.details: Caitlyn places a trap that arms after a moment. Enemies who step on it are rooted, revealed, and Caitlyn gains headshot against them. Stores multiple charges.

abilities.name: 90 Caliber Net
abilities.summary: Fire a net that knocks you back and slows enemies hit.
abilities.details: Caitlyn fires a net, knocking herself back while the projectile slows enemies hit. Grants headshot on enemy hit.

abilities.name: Ace in the Hole
abilities.summary: Lock onto a champion and fire a long-range sniper shot. Can be blocked.
abilities.details: Caitlyn takes aim at a target champion, then fires a powerful shot. The bullet can be blocked by other enemy champions stepping in the way.

champions.name: Camille
champions.title: the Steel Shadow

playstyle.identity: Camille is a precision diver who locks down a single target with her ultimate. Her true damage legs and hookshot make her an exceptional duelist and split-pusher.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives shield based on enemy damage type. Q first hit gives speed, second hit deals true damage. W heals from outer half. E hookshots to walls then dashes. R locks enemy in a zone. E-E to engage, Q-Q for true damage, R to isolate.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Camille spikes at level 6 with her isolation ultimate. Trinity Force and Divine Sunderer scale her. She's strong as a split-pusher and diver throughout.

weaknesses: E can miss or be interrupted

passive.name: Adaptive Defenses
passive.summary: Auto attacks on champions grant a shield based on their primary damage type.
passive.details: Basic attacks on enemy champions grant Camille a shield that absorbs damage. The shield type matches the enemy's primary damage type (physical or magic).

abilities.name: Precision Protocol
abilities.summary: Two-part auto reset; second hit deals true damage.
abilities.details: First cast: Camille's next auto deals bonus damage and grants movement speed. Second cast (after short delay): Next auto deals increased damage, converted to true damage.

abilities.name: Tactical Sweep
abilities.summary: Sweep in a cone; outer half slows and heals.
abilities.details: Camille sweeps her leg, dealing damage in a cone. Enemies hit by the outer half take bonus damage, are slowed, and heal Camille.

abilities.name: Hookshot
abilities.summary: Fire a hookshot to terrain, then dash to an enemy stunning them.
abilities.details: First cast: Camille fires a hookshot, pulling herself to terrain. Second cast: Dash to a target area, knocking up and stunning enemies hit.

abilities.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
abilities.summary: Leap to a target and lock them in a zone they can't escape.
abilities.details: Camille leaps to an enemy champion, creating a zone around them. The target cannot leave the zone by any means. Camille gains bonus damage against them. Zone ends if Camille leaves.

champions.name: Cassiopeia
champions.title: the Serpent's Embrace

playstyle.identity: Cassiopeia is a DPS mage who can't buy boots but gains movement speed from passive. Her E spam on poisoned targets makes her a machine-gun mage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Can't buy boots - passive gives speed. Q poisons and speeds you if hit. W creates a slow zone that poisons and grounds. E is spammable on poisoned targets (refunds mana, heals). R stuns if enemies face you, slows if not. Q-E spam, R facing enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Cassiopeia spikes with Tear stacking and at level 9 for E spam. Rod of Ages and AP scale her. She's a late-game DPS monster.

weaknesses: R can whiff if enemies look away

passive.name: Serpentine Grace
passive.summary: Can't buy boots; gains movement speed per level instead.
passive.details: Cassiopeia cannot purchase boots. Instead, she gains bonus movement speed per level, reaching the equivalent of tier 2 boots by max level.

abilities.name: Noxious Blast
abilities.summary: Poison an area; hitting gives you movement speed.
abilities.details: Cassiopeia blasts a circle with poison after a delay, dealing damage over time. If she hits a champion, she gains movement speed.

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.summary: Create a poison zone that grounds and slows enemies.
abilities.details: Cassiopeia spews poison that creates a zone, poisoning and slowing enemies inside. Enemies in the zone are also grounded (can't dash or flash).

abilities.name: Twin Fang
abilities.summary: Spam on poisoned targets for damage and healing; refunds mana.
abilities.details: Cassiopeia strikes with her fangs, dealing magic damage. If the target is poisoned, Twin Fang deals bonus damage, heals her, and refunds the mana cost.

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.summary: Enemies facing you are stunned; others are slowed.
abilities.details: Cassiopeia blasts enemies in a cone. Enemies facing her are stunned; enemies facing away are slowed. Devastating teamfight ability.

playstyle.identity: Cho'Gath is a scaling tank who grows infinitely with his ultimate stacks. His CC and true damage execute make him a teamfight terror who can eat objectives.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q knocks up after delay. W silences in a cone. E makes autos deal AoE damage. R eats a target for true damage and permanently increases your size/health if it kills. Stack R on minions/monsters early, then eat champions and objectives.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Cho'Gath spikes with R stacks (6 from minions/monsters, infinite from champions). Tank items scale with his bonus health. He's a late-game raid boss.

passive.name: Carnivore
passive.summary: Killing units heals and restores mana.
passive.details: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he regains health and mana. This sustain helps his laning phase significantly.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.summary: After a delay, spikes erupt knocking up and slowing enemies.
abilities.details: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground at a target location. After a delay, spikes erupt knocking up enemies, dealing damage, and slowing them.

abilities.name: Feral Scream
abilities.summary: Scream in a cone to damage and silence enemies.
abilities.details: Cho'Gath screams in a cone, dealing magic damage and silencing enemies, preventing them from using abilities.

abilities.name: Vorpal Spikes
abilities.summary: Auto attacks deal AoE damage and slow.
abilities.details: Cho'Gath's auto attacks launch spikes that deal AoE damage and slow enemies around the target.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.summary: Devour a target for true damage; kills permanently increase your size and health.
abilities.details: Cho'Gath eats a target, dealing true damage. If it kills them, Cho'Gath grows, gaining permanent bonus health and size. Can stack infinitely from champions/epic monsters.

playstyle.identity: Corki is a poke ADC whose damage is mostly magic despite building AD. His Package lets him roam with a devastating zone control ability.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive converts most damage to magic. Q is a bomb. W dashes and burns. E shreds armor in a cone. R fires rockets (Big One every 3rd). Package spawns in base - pick up for mega W dash. Poke with R, all-in with W, Package for roams.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Corki spikes with first Package (8 min) and Trinity Force. Crit and AD scale his magic damage. He's strong at poke and bursting squishies.

passive.name: Hextech Munitions
passive.summary: Auto attacks deal mostly magic damage. Periodically, The Package spawns in base.
passive.details: Corki's auto attacks deal 80% magic and 20% physical damage. Periodically, The Package spawns in base - picking it up empowers Valkyrie.

abilities.name: Phosphorus Bomb
abilities.summary: Throw a bomb that damages and reveals enemies.
abilities.details: Corki throws a bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies and revealing them for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Valkyrie
abilities.summary: Dash and leave a burning trail. Package: massive dash that knocks aside and burns.
abilities.details: Corki dashes in a direction, leaving a fire trail. With Package: Special Delivery is a longer dash that knocks enemies aside and leaves a massive burning zone.

abilities.name: Gatling Gun
abilities.summary: Fire a cone of bullets that shred armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Corki fires his gatling gun in a cone, dealing damage over time and shredding enemy armor and magic resist with each tick.

abilities.name: Missile Barrage
abilities.summary: Fire rockets that poke; every 3rd is a Big One with larger damage and AoE.
abilities.details: Corki fires a missile that damages enemies. He stores missiles over time (up to 7). Every third missile is a Big One, dealing increased damage in a larger area.

playstyle.identity: Darius is a lane-dominant juggernaut who stacks bleed for an execute ultimate. He excels at 1v2s and can pentakill if he gets his reset going.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive bleeds stack to 5, then you get Noxian Might (bonus AD). Q blade edge heals massively. W slows and is an auto reset. E pulls enemies. R is a true damage execute that resets on kill. Get 5 stacks, then R through the whole team.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Darius spikes at level 6 with his execute and with Trinity Force or Stridebreaker. He's strongest in mid-game teamfights where he can reset R.

passive.name: Hemorrhage
passive.summary: Abilities bleed enemies; at 5 stacks, gain Noxian Might (massive AD).
passive.details: Darius's attacks and abilities apply bleed stacks up to 5. Each stack deals damage over time. At 5 stacks on any champion, Darius gains Noxian Might, granting massive bonus AD.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.summary: Swing axe in a circle; blade edge heals and deals more damage.
abilities.details: Darius swings his axe in a circle. Enemies hit by the blade (outer edge) take more damage and heal Darius for each champion hit.

abilities.name: Crippling Strike
abilities.summary: Auto reset that slows and deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: Darius's next auto attack deals bonus damage and slows the target. Short cooldown, refunds mana on kill.

abilities.name: Apprehend
abilities.summary: Pull enemies toward you and slow them.
abilities.details: Darius pulls all enemies in a cone toward him and slows them briefly. Passive: grants armor penetration.

abilities.name: Noxian Guillotine
abilities.summary: Execute dealing true damage based on bleed stacks; resets on kill.
abilities.details: Darius leaps to an enemy and dunks them for true damage that increases with bleed stacks. If it kills, the cooldown resets and Darius gains Noxian Might.

playstyle.identity: Diana is a diving assassin/bruiser who pulls enemies together with her ultimate. She excels at bursting grouped enemies after dashing into the backline.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers every third auto with cleave. Q arcs and marks enemies. W creates orbs that shield and damage. E dashes to an enemy (reset if marked). R pulls enemies together then damages. E to a mark, W for shield, R for AoE burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Diana spikes at level 6 with her teamfight ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. She's strong in mid-game teamfights against grouped enemies.

passive.name: Moonsilver Blade
passive.summary: Every third auto attack cleaves nearby enemies.
passive.details: Diana gains attack speed. Every third auto attack cleaves nearby enemies for bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Crescent Strike
abilities.summary: Fire an arcing bolt that marks enemies hit.
abilities.details: Diana fires a bolt of moonlight that arcs, dealing damage to enemies and marking them with Moonlight for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Pale Cascade
abilities.summary: Create orbiting spheres that shield you and damage enemies.
abilities.details: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that damage enemies they hit. She also gains a shield. If all three spheres hit, the shield refreshes.

abilities.name: Lunar Rush
abilities.summary: Dash to an enemy; cooldown resets if they're marked.
abilities.details: Diana dashes to an enemy, dealing damage. If the target is marked with Moonlight, the mark is consumed and the cooldown resets.

abilities.name: Moonfall
abilities.summary: Pull nearby enemies together, then detonate for massive damage.
abilities.details: Diana reveals and pulls all nearby enemies toward her, slowing them. After a delay, she deals massive magic damage to all nearby enemies, increased per target.

playstyle.identity: Dr. Mundo is an unkillable tank who regenerates massive health. He uses health as a resource and becomes nearly impossible to kill with his ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities cost health. Passive rejects CC periodically. Q is a slow cleaver. W creates a damage zone and stores damage to convert to healing. E empowers autos and throws. R heals massively over time. Just run at enemies and outlast them.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Mundo spikes at level 6 with his healing ultimate. Tank items with health scale his passive. He's a late-game unkillable tank.

passive.name: Goes Where He Pleases
passive.summary: Periodically immune to one immobilizing effect; drops a canister to heal.
passive.details: Mundo resists the next immobilizing effect and instead loses health and drops a canister. Walking over it heals him and reduces the passive cooldown.

abilities.name: Infected Bonesaw
abilities.summary: Throw a cleaver that damages and slows based on target's current health.
abilities.details: Mundo throws his cleaver, dealing damage based on the target's current health and slowing them. Refunds health if it hits.

abilities.name: Heart Zapper
abilities.summary: Deal damage around you and store damage taken to convert to healing.
abilities.details: Mundo charges an electricity field that damages nearby enemies. While charging, he stores a portion of damage taken. Recast to detonate and heal for the stored damage.

abilities.name: Blunt Force Trauma
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to smash and deal bonus damage based on missing health.
abilities.details: Passive: Mundo gains bonus AD based on missing health. Active: Next auto deals bonus damage and if it kills, Mundo swats the target away.

abilities.name: Maximum Dosage
abilities.summary: Gain massive health regeneration, AD, and size over several seconds.
abilities.details: Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, gaining bonus AD, movement speed, and regenerating a huge portion of his max health over time.

playstyle.identity: Draven is a cash-in ADC who stacks gold with his passive. Catching spinning axes maximizes his damage and lets him snowball harder than any other ADC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q makes autos spin - catch the axe landing spot to keep it spinning. W gives speed. E knocks aside and slows. R is global damage. Stack passive gold with Q catches, cash in on kills for massive gold lead. Catch axes, dominate lane.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Draven spikes with his first kill (passive gold) and Infinity Edge. He's strongest when snowballing in early-mid game with gold leads.

passive.name: League of Draven
passive.summary: Catching axes and kills stack Adoration; kills cash in for bonus gold.
passive.details: Draven gains Adoration stacks when catching axes or killing minions. Killing champions cashes in stacks for massive bonus gold. Dying loses stacks.

abilities.name: Spinning Axe
abilities.summary: Auto attacks spin, dealing bonus damage. Catch the axe to keep it spinning.
abilities.details: Draven's next auto attack becomes a Spinning Axe that deals bonus damage. The axe bounces to a landing spot - catching it resets Spinning Axe.

abilities.name: Blood Rush
abilities.summary: Gain attack speed and movement speed; refreshes on axe catch.
abilities.details: Draven gains bonus movement and attack speed that decay over time. Catching a Spinning Axe refreshes Blood Rush's cooldown.

abilities.name: Stand Aside
abilities.summary: Throw axes that knock enemies aside and slow them.
abilities.details: Draven throws his axes in a line, dealing damage, knocking enemies aside, and slowing them.

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.summary: Throw global axes that damage enemies and return to you.
abilities.details: Draven hurls two massive axes globally, dealing damage to enemies hit. Axes return to Draven after hitting an enemy champion or reaching the edge of the map.

champions.name: Ekko
champions.title: the Boy Who Shattered Time

playstyle.identity: Ekko is a time-manipulating assassin who can rewind to his position a few seconds ago. He excels at diving, bursting, then rewinding to safety.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive procs on 3rd hit for burst. Q boomerangs and slows. W creates a delayed stun zone (reveals when he enters). E dashes then blinks to target. R rewinds you to your position 4 seconds ago, healing and dealing AoE damage. Go in, burst, R out.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ekko spikes at level 6 with his escape ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds another gap closer. He's strong in skirmishes and picks.

weaknesses: R position is visible to enemies

passive.name: Z-Drive Resonance
passive.summary: Third hit or ability on a target deals bonus damage and gives you movement speed.
passive.details: Every third attack or ability against the same target deals bonus magic damage and grants Ekko movement speed. Has a cooldown per target.

abilities.name: Timewinder
abilities.summary: Throw a device that slows, then returns dealing damage.
abilities.details: Ekko throws a device that expands, damaging and slowing enemies. It then contracts and returns, dealing damage again.

abilities.name: Parallel Convergence
abilities.summary: After a delay, create a zone that stuns enemies if you enter.
abilities.details: Ekko opens a time rift that activates after a delay. If Ekko enters the zone, enemies inside are stunned and he gains a shield. Otherwise, enemies are only slowed.

abilities.name: Phase Dive
abilities.summary: Dash, then blink to an enemy with your next attack.
abilities.details: Ekko dashes a short distance. His next attack gains range and causes him to blink to the target, dealing bonus damage.

abilities.name: Chronobreak
abilities.summary: Rewind to your position 4 seconds ago, healing and dealing AoE damage.
abilities.details: Ekko becomes untargetable and rewinds to where he was 4 seconds ago (shown by his hologram). On arrival, he heals and deals massive damage to nearby enemies.

playstyle.identity: Elise is a spider-form jungler with two sets of abilities. Her human form pokes and sets up, while spider form executes and sustains.
playstyle.howToPlay: Human: Q damage scales with current health. W sends exploding spider. E is a cocoon stun. Spider: Q execute scales with missing health. W summons spiderlings. E rappels up, becoming untargetable. Human E-Q-W, then spider Q-W for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Elise spikes at level 3 with both forms and at level 6 for stronger spider form. Magic pen scales her. She's strongest early-mid game.

passive.name: Spider Queen
passive.summary: In spider form, gain spiderlings that attack with you.
passive.details: Human abilities ready spiderlings. In spider form, spiderlings attack alongside Elise, dealing damage and applying spell effects.

abilities.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
abilities.summary: Human: damage based on current health. Spider: execute based on missing health.
abilities.details: Human (Neurotoxin): Deal magic damage scaling with target's current health. Spider (Venomous Bite): Lunge and deal magic damage scaling with target's missing health.

abilities.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
abilities.summary: Human: send exploding spider. Spider: gain attack speed and heal on hit.
abilities.details: Human (Volatile Spiderling): Send a spider that explodes on enemies. Spider (Skittering Frenzy): Spiderlings gain attack speed and heal Elise on hit.

abilities.name: Cocoon / Rappel
abilities.summary: Human: skillshot stun. Spider: ascend untargetable, can descend on enemies.
abilities.details: Human (Cocoon): Fire a skillshot that stuns the first enemy and reveals them. Spider (Rappel): Ascend, becoming untargetable. Can descend on enemies or nearby locations.

abilities.name: Spider Form
abilities.summary: Toggle between human and spider forms.
abilities.details: Elise transforms into spider form, changing her abilities. Spider form grants bonus movement speed and spiderlings. Transforms back to human form on recast.

champions.name: Evelynn
champions.title: Agony's Embrace

playstyle.identity: Evelynn is a permanent stealth assassin who picks off isolated targets from the shadows. Her unique camouflage after level 6 makes her a constant threat that forces enemies to play scared.
playstyle.howToPlay: Farm until level 6 - you're weak before permanent stealth. Once you hit 6, your camouflage lets you bypass wards and gank from unexpected angles. Approach targets, land Q, let charm cook with W, then burst with empowered E and R to execute and escape.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Level 6 is Evelynn's biggest spike - she gains permanent stealth. She spikes again with first item (usually Hextech Rocketbelt for gap-closing). Full AP build makes her one-shot squishies instantly.

strengths: Ultimate resets her position and executes

passive.name: Demon Shade
passive.summary: Enter camouflage when out of combat; regenerate health when low.
passive.details: After level 6, Evelynn enters Demon Shade when out of combat, becoming camouflaged (invisible until close to enemies or revealed by control wards). While in Demon Shade, she also regenerates health rapidly when below a threshold. This sustain helps you stay healthy while hunting.

abilities.name: Hate Spike
abilities.summary: Fire a spike that marks targets; recast to fire darts at marked enemies.
abilities.details: Evelynn fires a skill shot that damages and marks the first enemy hit. For the next few seconds, she can recast Q three times to fire darts at the nearest marked target. The initial skillshot does more damage - landing it is crucial for your burst combo.

abilities.name: Allure
abilities.summary: Curse a target; after charging, your next attack charms them.
abilities.details: Evelynn curses a target for a few seconds. If she hits them with an ability or attack after the curse has charged (2.5 seconds), she charms them and shreds their magic resist. Against monsters, the charm is instant. Learning to time the charm is essential for ganks.

abilities.name: Whiplash
abilities.summary: Whip a target, dealing damage based on their max health.
abilities.details: Evelynn whips her target, dealing magic damage plus a percentage of their max health. When entering Demon Shade, Whiplash is empowered - it becomes a dash that deals increased damage. Use the empowered version for gap-closing and burst.

abilities.name: Last Caress
abilities.summary: Devastate enemies in an area and blink backwards; deals more to low health targets.
abilities.details: Evelynn unleashes her demonic energy, dealing massive magic damage in a cone. The damage is doubled against enemies below 30% health, making it a powerful execute. She then blinks backwards, allowing her to escape after assassinating a target.

playstyle.identity: Ezreal is a skillshot-based ADC who never needs to auto attack thanks to his Q. His blink keeps him safe while he pokes from range.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q applies on-hit and reduces all cooldowns when it hits. W attaches to enemies/turrets for bonus damage. E is a blink that fires a homing bolt. R is a global skillshot. Poke with Q, E to safety, stack Tear with abilities.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ezreal spikes with Tear stacked and Trinity Force or Muramana. He's strong at all stages with consistent poke and safety.

passive.name: Rising Spell Force
passive.summary: Hitting abilities stacks attack speed.
passive.details: Hitting an ability grants Ezreal a stack of attack speed. Stacks up to 5 times.

abilities.name: Mystic Shot
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt that applies on-hit effects and reduces cooldowns.
abilities.details: Ezreal fires a bolt dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects. Hitting a target reduces all ability cooldowns.

abilities.name: Essence Flux
abilities.summary: Fire an orb that attaches to enemies; hitting it with an ability detonates for damage.
abilities.details: Ezreal fires an orb that attaches to the first enemy or structure hit. Hitting the marked target with an ability or auto detonates the mark for bonus damage and refunds mana.

abilities.name: Arcane Shift
abilities.summary: Blink to a location and fire a homing bolt at the nearest enemy.
abilities.details: Ezreal blinks to a target location and fires a bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing magic damage. Can be used over walls.

abilities.name: Trueshot Barrage
abilities.summary: Fire a massive global skillshot that damages all enemies in its path.
abilities.details: Ezreal channels briefly, then fires a wave of energy globally, dealing damage to all enemies in its path. Deals reduced damage to minions.

playstyle.identity: Fiddlesticks is an ambush mage who fears enemies with surprise attacks. His ultimate from fog of war is one of the most devastating engages in the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive places effigies that look like you standing still. Q fears (instant fear from unseen). W drains and heals. E silences and slows. R channels then blinks, dealing massive AoE. Set up R from fog/over walls for surprise fear + damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Fiddlesticks spikes at level 6 with his ultimate. Zhonya's lets him R in and survive. He's strongest when flanking from fog.

passive.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
passive.summary: Replaces trinket with effigies that look like Fiddlesticks. Unseen abilities fear.
passive.details: Fiddlesticks places effigies that pose like him. If enemies can't see Fiddlesticks before his abilities hit, they're feared.

abilities.name: Terrify
abilities.summary: Fear an enemy; instant if they couldn't see you.
abilities.details: Fiddlesticks fears a target. If Fiddlesticks was unseen (in fog, brush, or using R), the fear activates instantly and deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Bountiful Harvest
abilities.summary: Drain nearby enemies, healing Fiddlesticks. Extra damage on last tick.
abilities.details: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies over a few seconds, healing himself. The final tick deals extra damage and heals more if it completes.

abilities.name: Reap
abilities.summary: Slash in an arc that silences and slows enemies in the center.
abilities.details: Fiddlesticks slashes in a crescent, dealing damage and slowing. Enemies hit in the center are also silenced.

abilities.name: Crowstorm
abilities.summary: Channel then blink, dealing massive AoE damage around you for several seconds.
abilities.details: Fiddlesticks channels briefly, then blinks to a location dealing damage per second in a large area around him. Combined with unseen bonus, this fears all enemies.

champions.name: Fiora
champions.title: the Grand Duelist

playstyle.identity: Fiora is a duelist who hits vitals for percent max health true damage. She's one of the best split-pushers and 1v1ers in the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive reveals vitals on enemies (hit for true damage and speed). Q dashes and prioritizes vitals. W parries everything and stuns if it blocks CC. E slows then crits. R reveals all 4 vitals - proc all 4 for massive healing zone. Dance around enemies hitting vitals.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Fiora spikes at level 6 with her vital ultimate. Ravenous Hydra and Divine Sunderer scale her. She's a late-game 1v1 monster.

weaknesses: Needs vitals to be positioned well

passive.name: Duelist's Dance
passive.summary: Reveals vitals on enemies; hitting them deals true damage and heals.
passive.details: Enemy champions periodically reveal a vital. Striking the vital deals percent max health true damage, heals Fiora, and grants movement speed.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.summary: Dash and stab; prioritizes vitals and refunds cooldown.
abilities.details: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy. Prioritizes vitals and champions. If it hits, the cooldown is partially refunded.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.summary: Parry all damage and CC; stuns if it blocks an immobilizing effect.
abilities.details: Fiora parries all damage and debuffs for a moment, then stabs dealing damage and slowing. If she parries an immobilizing effect, the enemy is stunned instead.

abilities.name: Bladework
abilities.summary: Next two autos: first slows, second critically strikes.
abilities.details: Fiora empowers her next two auto attacks. The first slows the target; the second is guaranteed to critically strike.

abilities.name: Grand Challenge
abilities.summary: Reveal all 4 vitals; hitting all creates a healing zone.
abilities.details: Fiora reveals all four vitals on an enemy champion. Hitting all four (or if the target dies) creates a large healing zone for Fiora and allies.

playstyle.identity: Fizz is a slippery assassin who can't be targeted during his E. He excels at bursting squishies and dodging key abilities with his playful-trickster pole.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive ignores unit collision and reduces auto damage taken. Q dashes through target applying on-hit. W empowers autos with bleed. E hops on pole (untargetable), can hop again or slam down. R throws fish that attaches and summons shark. R-Q-W-E for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Fizz spikes at level 6 with his shark ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. He's strong at picks and all-ins mid-game.

passive.name: Nimble Fighter
passive.summary: Ignore unit collision and take reduced auto attack damage.
passive.details: Fizz can walk through units and takes reduced damage from auto attacks.

abilities.name: Urchin Strike
abilities.summary: Dash through a target, dealing damage and applying on-hit effects.
abilities.details: Fizz dashes through a target enemy, dealing magic damage and applying on-hit effects. Always travels a fixed distance.

abilities.name: Seastone Trident
abilities.summary: Passive: autos bleed. Active: empower next auto for burst damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks deal bonus damage over time. Active: Fizz empowers his next auto attack to deal bonus damage, increased if target is bleeding.

abilities.name: Playful / Trickster
abilities.summary: Hop on pole becoming untargetable; hop again or slam down for damage.
abilities.details: Fizz hops on his trident, becoming untargetable. Recast to hop to a location, or wait to slam down dealing AoE damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Chum the Waters
abilities.summary: Throw a fish that attaches and summons a shark to knock up and damage.
abilities.details: Fizz throws a fish that attaches to the first champion hit (or drops to the ground). After a delay, a shark erupts, knocking up the target and dealing massive damage. Size increases with distance.

playstyle.identity: Galio is an anti-mage tank who can ult to allies globally. He excels at protecting teammates and engaging teamfights with his taunt.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers autos periodically with AoE magic damage. Q creates a tornado. W charges taunt (longer charge = longer taunt, but damages Galio). E dashes and knocks up. R gives ally shield then crash lands, knocking up. R to save allies or follow up engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Galio spikes at level 6 with global follow-up. AP or tank items both work. He's strong against magic damage teams.

passive.name: Colossal Smash
passive.summary: Periodically, autos deal bonus AoE magic damage.
passive.details: Every few seconds, Galio's next auto attack is enhanced to deal bonus magic damage in an area. Cooldown reduced by hitting champions with abilities.

abilities.name: Winds of War
abilities.summary: Fire two gusts that converge into a tornado dealing percent health damage.
abilities.details: Galio fires two windblasts that deal damage and converge into a tornado at the target location, dealing percent max health damage over time.

abilities.name: Shield of Durand
abilities.summary: Charge a taunt; release to taunt and damage nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Galio channels, reducing damage taken. On release, he taunts nearby enemies (longer charge = longer taunt). Charging too long slows Galio.

abilities.name: Justice Punch
abilities.summary: Dash forward knocking up the first champion hit.
abilities.details: Galio dashes forward, stopping on the first champion hit and knocking them up. Can dash over small walls.

abilities.name: Hero's Entrance
abilities.summary: Grant an ally a shield then fly to them, knocking up enemies on arrival.
abilities.details: Galio designates an ally anywhere on the map, granting them damage reduction. After a delay, he crashes down, dealing damage and knocking up enemies in the area.

champions.name: Gangplank
champions.title: the Saltwater Scourge

playstyle.identity: Gangplank is a barrel-chaining pirate who scales into late game. His barrel combos one-shot squishies and his global ult provides map pressure.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive burns enemies on hit. Q is a ranged auto that procs on-hit (use on barrels). W cleanses CC and heals. E places barrels that chain and ignore armor when shot. R is global slow/damage zone with upgrades. Chain barrels into enemies, Q the barrel for AoE crit.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Gangplank spikes with Trinity Force and crit items. Late game with 3 items his barrels one-shot. He needs time to scale.

weaknesses: Barrels can be killed by enemies

passive.name: Trial by Fire
passive.summary: Periodically, next auto burns and gives movement speed.
passive.details: Every few seconds, Gangplank's next auto attack ignites the target, dealing true damage over time and granting him movement speed.

abilities.name: Parrrley
abilities.summary: Ranged auto that applies on-hit; earns extra gold on kill.
abilities.details: Gangplank fires his pistol, dealing damage and applying on-hit effects. Killing a unit grants bonus gold and Silver Serpents for upgrading R.

abilities.name: Remove Scurvy
abilities.summary: Cleanse all CC and heal based on missing health.
abilities.details: Gangplank eats citrus fruit, removing all crowd control and healing himself. Heal amount increases based on missing health.

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.summary: Place barrels that chain together; shooting them damages and ignores armor.
abilities.details: Gangplank places a barrel that decays over time. Attacking it when it's at 1 HP detonates it, damaging enemies and chaining to nearby barrels. Barrel damage ignores armor.

abilities.name: Cannon Barrage
abilities.summary: Global AoE that slows and damages; upgradeable with Silver Serpents.
abilities.details: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area globally, dealing waves of damage and slowing enemies. Can be upgraded with Silver Serpents for additional effects.

champions.name: Garen
champions.title: The Might of Demacia

playstyle.identity: Garen is a straightforward juggernaut who punishes mistakes with high damage while being nearly unkillable. His simple kit lets you focus on fundamentals like trading patterns and wave management.
playstyle.howToPlay: Use Q to silence enemies and prevent their escape or retaliation, then spin with E for sustained damage. W provides a shield when you expect burst damage. Execute low-health enemies with R. In lane, short trades with Q-E work well; disengage before they can trade back.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Garen spikes at level 6 with his execute ultimate and again at level 11 when it deals max health damage. He's strong with Stridebreaker for gap-closing or Trinity Force for burst.

strengths: Extremely tanky with W armor/MR and passive regeneration
Simple kit that's easy to execute
No mana costs - can stay in lane indefinitely

passive.name: Perseverance
passive.summary: Regenerate health rapidly when out of combat.
