passive.details: After not taking damage for a few seconds, Garen regenerates a percentage of his max health per second. This sustain is incredibly powerful in lane, allowing you to recover from trades without backing. Stay safe and let your passive work.

abilities.name: Decisive Strike
abilities.summary: Gain movement speed and empower your next attack to deal bonus damage and silence.
abilities.details: Garen gains movement speed and removes slows for a few seconds. His next basic attack deals bonus damage and silences the target. Use the speed boost to reach enemies and the silence to prevent their escape abilities or counterattacks.

abilities.name: Courage
abilities.summary: Gain a shield and damage reduction. Passively gain armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Passively, Garen gains permanent armor and magic resist by killing units (up to a cap). Actively, he gains a shield and significant damage reduction for a short duration. Time this to block burst damage from abilities or all-ins.

abilities.name: Judgment
abilities.summary: Spin rapidly, dealing damage to nearby enemies and shredding their armor.
abilities.details: Garen spins for several seconds, dealing damage to enemies around him. The spin deals increased damage to the nearest enemy and reduces their armor. You can move while spinning but cannot use basic attacks. Cancel early for the E-R combo.

abilities.name: Demacian Justice
abilities.summary: Call down a giant sword that deals true damage based on the target's missing health.
abilities.details: Garen calls down a sword on a target enemy champion, dealing true damage based on their missing health. This ignores all resistances, making it an effective execute regardless of how tanky the enemy is. Use when enemies are low to secure kills.

champions.name: Gnar
champions.title: the Missing Link

playstyle.identity: Gnar is a transform top laner who builds rage then becomes Mega Gnar. Mini Gnar kites and pokes while Mega Gnar engages with massive CC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Rage builds with combat - at full rage, transform to Mega. Mini: Q boomerang, W procs 3-hit speed, E hop. Mega: Q slow boulder, W stun, E slam, R throws enemies into walls for stun. Manage rage to transform at the right time.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Gnar spikes at level 6 with Mega Gnar's ultimate. Black Cleaver and tank items scale him. He's strong in teamfights when he can transform.

weaknesses: Weak when Mega is on cooldown

passive.name: Rage Gene
passive.summary: Build rage through combat; at max rage, transform into Mega Gnar.
passive.details: Gnar builds rage through combat. At max rage, he transforms into Mega Gnar, gaining new abilities, health, and CC but losing speed and range.

abilities.name: Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss
abilities.summary: Mini: boomerang slows and returns. Mega: throw boulder that slows.
abilities.details: Mini: Throw a boomerang that slows and returns. Catching it reduces cooldown. Mega: Throw a boulder that stops on first unit, dealing AoE damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Hyper / Wallop
abilities.summary: Mini: 3 hits proc burst and speed. Mega: slam to stun.
abilities.details: Mini (Hyper): Every third hit on the same target deals bonus damage and grants movement speed. Mega (Wallop): Slam in front, stunning enemies.

abilities.name: Hop / Crunch
abilities.summary: Mini: bounce off units. Mega: slam down and slow.
abilities.details: Mini: Gnar hops, bouncing off units for extra distance and attack speed. Mega: Gnar leaps and slams down, dealing damage and slowing.

abilities.name: GNAR!
abilities.summary: Mega only: throw all nearby enemies; stun if they hit terrain.
abilities.details: Only in Mega Gnar: Gnar throws all nearby enemies in a direction, dealing damage. Enemies thrown into walls take bonus damage and are stunned.

champions.name: Gragas
champions.title: the Rabble Rouser

playstyle.identity: Gragas is a drunken brawler who disrupts with his explosive cask. He can burst squishies or tank depending on build, with strong CC either way.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals on ability use. Q throws a barrel that can be reactivated (more damage if it ferments). W makes next auto deal bonus damage and reduces damage taken. E body slams and stuns. R throws cask that knocks enemies away. E-flash for engage, R to isolate targets.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Gragas spikes at level 6 with his disruptive ultimate. AP for burst, tank for frontline. He's flexible at all stages.

weaknesses: R can knock enemies to safety

passive.name: Happy Hour
passive.summary: Using abilities heals Gragas.
passive.details: Every time Gragas uses an ability, he heals for a percentage of his max health.

abilities.name: Barrel Roll
abilities.summary: Roll a barrel that ferments; reactivate to explode, slowing enemies.
abilities.details: Gragas rolls a barrel that ferments over time, dealing increased damage. Reactivate to detonate, damaging and slowing enemies.

abilities.name: Drunken Rage
abilities.summary: Channel briefly to reduce damage taken; next auto deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: Gragas drinks, channeling briefly to reduce incoming damage. After drinking, his next auto deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Body Slam
abilities.summary: Dash and slam, dealing damage and stunning enemies hit.
abilities.details: Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy hit. Enemies hit take damage and are stunned.

abilities.name: Explosive Cask
abilities.summary: Throw a cask that explodes, knocking enemies away from the center.
abilities.details: Gragas throws his cask to a location. On impact, it explodes dealing damage and knocking enemies away from the center.

playstyle.identity: Graves is a shotgun jungler who reloads between autos. His pellet-based attacks make him excellent at clearing camps and bursting in close range.
playstyle.howToPlay: Auto attacks fire pellets (more damage close). Must reload after 2 shots (auto attack to reload). Q fires a line that bounces back. W creates a smoke screen that blinds. E dashes and reloads one shell. R knocksback and damages in a cone. Get close, burst, E to kite.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Graves spikes early with his clear speed and at Eclipse. He's a strong early-mid game jungler who can snowball.

passive.name: New Destiny
passive.summary: Autos fire pellet shotgun blasts; must reload after 2 shots.
passive.details: Graves' auto attacks fire multiple pellets that deal increased damage at close range. He has 2 shells and must reload after firing them.

abilities.name: End of the Line
abilities.summary: Fire a blast that bounces off terrain for delayed explosion.
abilities.details: Graves fires a powder round that deals damage and bounces off terrain. After a delay or hitting terrain, it detonates dealing additional damage.

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.summary: Throw a canister that creates a smoke zone blinding enemies inside.
abilities.details: Graves throws a canister that creates a smoke cloud, slowing and blinding enemies inside (they can't see outside the smoke).

abilities.name: Quickdraw
abilities.summary: Dash and reload one shell; gain armor stacking.
abilities.details: Graves dashes in a direction, reloading one shell. He gains a stack of True Grit, giving armor. Hitting enemies refreshes and adds stacks.

abilities.name: Collateral Damage
abilities.summary: Fire an explosive shell that knocks you back and enemies away.
abilities.details: Graves fires a heavy shell dealing damage in a cone. The initial target is knocked back, and Graves recoils backward. The shell explodes at max range or on hitting a champion.

playstyle.identity: Gwen is an AP skirmisher who becomes untargetable in her mist. She shreds through tanks with her true damage snipping and sustains through fights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals and deals percent health damage. Q snips, center snips deal more and apply passive. W creates mist (untargetable by enemies outside). E dashes and empowers autos with range/speed. R fires needles 3 times (must auto between). W to survive burst, Q for damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Gwen spikes at level 6 with her R burst and with Riftmaker for sustain. She's strong in extended fights and scales well.

passive.name: Thousand Cuts
passive.summary: Autos and Q deal bonus magic damage and heal Gwen based on damage dealt.
passive.details: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on target's max health. She heals based on the damage dealt by this passive.

abilities.name: Snip Snip!
abilities.summary: Snip multiple times; center snips deal more and apply true damage.
abilities.details: Gwen snips at least twice, dealing magic damage. Enemies in the center take true damage and apply her passive. More snips based on stacks from auto attacks.

abilities.name: Hallowed Mist
abilities.summary: Create a mist zone; enemies outside can't target or hit you.
abilities.details: Gwen creates a zone of mist. While inside, she's untargetable by enemies outside the mist. The mist follows her once then stays in place.

abilities.name: Skip 'n Slash
abilities.summary: Dash and gain attack speed, range, and on-hit damage.
abilities.details: Gwen dashes and empowers her auto attacks with bonus range, attack speed, and magic damage on-hit. First attack on a champion refunds half the cooldown.

abilities.name: Needlework
abilities.summary: Fire needles up to 3 times; must hit an enemy to unlock next cast.
abilities.details: Gwen fires a needle, then can recast twice more (each cast fires more needles). Must hit an enemy with autos or abilities to unlock each recast.

playstyle.identity: Hecarim is a charging cavalry jungler who gains AD from movement speed. He excels at ganking and diving with his devastating team-wide fear ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive converts movement speed to AD. Q is spammable AoE damage. W heals based on damage dealt around you. E charges, ramming and knocking back enemies. R charges through, fearing enemies. E into lanes for ganks, R for teamfight engages.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Hecarim spikes at level 6 with fear engage and with Trinity Force. He's strong at ganking and teamfights throughout.

passive.name: Warpath
passive.summary: Gain attack damage based on bonus movement speed.
passive.details: Hecarim gains bonus attack damage equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed. He also ignores unit collision.

abilities.name: Rampage
abilities.summary: Swing to deal AoE damage; stacks to reduce cooldown.
abilities.details: Hecarim swings his glaive, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Each hit builds stacks that reduce the cooldown.

abilities.name: Spirit of Dread
abilities.summary: Create an aura that heals you based on damage dealt nearby.
abilities.details: Hecarim creates a damaging aura and heals for a portion of all damage dealt to enemies within it (capped against minions/monsters).

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.summary: Charge forward gaining speed; next attack knocks back and deals more damage at range.
abilities.details: Hecarim gains movement speed over time. His next attack knocks the target back and deals bonus damage based on distance traveled.

abilities.name: Onslaught of Shadows
abilities.summary: Charge forward with spectral riders, fearing enemies where you land.
abilities.details: Hecarim charges forward with spectral riders, dealing damage. Enemies in the area where he lands are feared away from him.

playstyle.identity: Heimerdinger is a zone control mage who places turrets that fight for him. He excels at sieging and turning ganks by overwhelming enemies with turret damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q places turrets (up to 3) that auto-attack and empower with your abilities. W fires rockets. E throws a grenade that stuns. R empowers next ability: R-Q is a mega turret, R-W is massive rockets, R-E is a bouncing stun. Set up turrets, E-W for burst, R-Q for 1v2s.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Heimerdinger spikes at level 6 with empowered abilities. Liandry's and Zhonya's scale him. He's strong at controlling space.

passive.name: Hextech Affinity
passive.summary: Gain movement speed near allied turrets and towers.
passive.details: Heimerdinger gains bonus movement speed when near allied turrets and towers.

abilities.name: H-28G Evolution Turret
abilities.summary: Place a turret that auto-attacks enemies. Up to 3 active.
abilities.details: Heimerdinger places a turret that attacks enemies. Turrets deal bonus damage when Heimerdinger hits enemies with abilities. He can have up to 3 turrets.

abilities.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
abilities.summary: Fire a barrage of rockets that converge on the cursor.
abilities.details: Heimerdinger fires multiple rockets in a cone that converge toward the cursor. Each rocket deals magic damage.

abilities.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
abilities.summary: Throw a grenade that stuns enemies in the center.
abilities.details: Heimerdinger throws a grenade that bounces to a location, dealing damage and stunning enemies. Enemies in the center are stunned; others are slowed.

abilities.name: UPGRADE!!!
abilities.summary: Empower next ability: mega turret, massive rockets, or bouncing stun.
abilities.details: Heimerdinger empowers his next ability. R-Q places a mega turret. R-W fires massive rockets. R-E throws a bouncing stun grenade.

champions.name: Hwei
champions.title: the Visionary

playstyle.identity: Hwei is an artistic mage with 9 abilities organized into 3 subjects. He switches between damage, utility, and crowd control based on the situation.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q opens damage spells (burst, line, AoE). W opens utility spells (shield, zone speed, ally attach). E opens CC spells (root, fear zone, slow). Press subject (QWE) then ability slot (QWE) to cast. R splashes paint that damages and roots. Master all 9 for maximum versatility.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Hwei spikes at level 6 with his teamfight ultimate. Luden's and mage items scale him. He's strong with ability variety.

weaknesses: Each ability has its own CD

passive.name: Signature of the Visionary
passive.summary: Damaging enemies marks them; allied damage on marked targets deals bonus damage.
passive.details: Hwei's damage marks enemies. Allies who damage marked enemies deal bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Subject: Disaster
abilities.summary: Damage spells: QQ fires a bolt, QW a long line, QE an AoE that detonates on recast.
abilities.details: Q opens damage abilities. QQ: Fire a bolt that damages and splashes. QW: Paint a long line of fire. QE: Create an AoE that detonates.

abilities.name: Subject: Serenity
abilities.summary: Utility spells: WQ shield, WW speed zone, WE attach to ally.
abilities.details: W opens utility abilities. WQ: Shield that heals. WW: Create a speed zone. WE: Attach paint to ally for damage.

abilities.name: Subject: Torment
abilities.summary: CC spells: EQ root line, EW fear zone, EE pull and slow.
abilities.details: E opens CC abilities. EQ: Paint a line that roots. EW: Create a fear zone. EE: Fire a bolt that pulls and slows.

abilities.name: Spiraling Despair
abilities.summary: Splash paint that expands, damaging and rooting enemies inside.
abilities.details: Hwei throws paint that expands over time, dealing damage and building up despair. At max despair, enemies inside are rooted.

champions.name: Illaoi
champions.title: the Kraken Priestess

playstyle.identity: Illaoi is a tentacle juggernaut who pulls spirits from enemies. She excels at teamfighting in her own space where her tentacles can slam repeatedly.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive spawns tentacles near walls. Q slams tentacles for damage and healing. W leaps and commands nearby tentacles to slam. E pulls out enemy spirit - damage the spirit to damage them. R slams all nearby tentacles and spawns new ones for each champion hit. Fight in your tentacles.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Illaoi spikes at level 6 with her teamfight ultimate. Divine Sunderer and bruiser items scale her. She's strong when enemies fight in her territory.

strengths: R wins teamfights in her area
weaknesses: E can miss or be dodged
Falls off if forced to move

passive.name: Prophet of an Elder God
passive.summary: Periodically spawn tentacles near terrain.
passive.details: Illaoi periodically spawns a tentacle on nearby walls. Tentacles swing when commanded by abilities.

abilities.name: Tentacle Smash
abilities.summary: Slam tentacles in a direction; heal if hitting champions.
abilities.details: Illaoi slams tentacles in a line, dealing damage. Hitting champions heals her. Nearby tentacles also slam.

abilities.name: Harsh Lesson
abilities.summary: Leap and empower next auto; commands tentacles to slam target.
abilities.details: Illaoi leaps to a target, dealing bonus damage. All nearby tentacles also swing at the target.

abilities.name: Test of Spirit
abilities.summary: Pull out an enemy's spirit; damage to spirit also damages them.
abilities.details: Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy. Damaging the spirit deals a portion as damage to the enemy. If the spirit dies or the enemy walks away, they become a vessel and spawn tentacles.

abilities.name: Leap of Faith
abilities.summary: Slam and spawn a tentacle for each nearby enemy champion.
abilities.details: Illaoi slams down, dealing damage and spawning a tentacle for each enemy champion hit. While active, Harsh Lesson has no cooldown.

playstyle.identity: Irelia is a blade dancer who dashes repeatedly through enemies. She excels at weaving through teamfights, resetting Q through marked targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks with abilities for bonus damage. Q dashes to target and resets if it kills or hits marked targets. W reduces damage and deals it on release. E throws blades that stun between them and mark. R throws blades that mark and create a wall. E-R to mark, then Q through everything.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Irelia spikes at level 6 with R marks and with BOTRK. She's strong at all-ins throughout mid-game.

passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.summary: Stack attack speed with abilities; at max stacks, deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Hitting enemies with abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, Irelia gains bonus attack speed and deals bonus magic damage on-hit.

abilities.name: Bladesurge
abilities.summary: Dash to a target; resets on kill or hitting marked targets.
abilities.details: Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing damage and healing. If it kills or the target is marked, the cooldown resets.

abilities.name: Defiant Dance
abilities.summary: Reduce incoming damage while channeling; release to deal damage.
abilities.details: Irelia channels, reducing physical damage taken. On release, she deals damage in a direction, increased by damage taken during channel.

abilities.name: Flawless Duet
abilities.summary: Place two blades that connect, stunning and marking enemies between.
abilities.details: Irelia throws a blade, then throws a second. The blades connect, stunning enemies between them and marking them for Q reset.

abilities.name: Vanguard's Edge
abilities.summary: Throw blades that mark champions and create a damaging wall.
abilities.details: Irelia throws a barrage of blades, damaging and marking enemy champions. The blades form a wall that damages and slows enemies who pass through.

playstyle.identity: Ivern is a support jungler who frees camps instead of killing them. He excels at supporting his team with shields and crowd control while Daisy fights for him.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive grows camps instead of killing them. Q roots and lets allies dash to rooted target. W creates brush. E shields ally and explodes for slow. R summons Daisy who knocks up with third hit. Gank with Q, shield carries with E, use Daisy for teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ivern spikes at level 6 with Daisy. Support items scale his shields. He's strong at supporting carries throughout.

passive.name: Friend of the Forest
passive.summary: Can't attack camps; instead grow them and free them for gold/XP.
passive.details: Ivern can't attack jungle camps. Instead, he channels to grow them, then frees them later for gold and XP without fighting.

abilities.name: Rootcaller
abilities.summary: Throw a root; allies can dash to the rooted target.
abilities.details: Ivern throws a skillshot that roots the first enemy hit. Ivern and allies can right-click the rooted target to dash to them.

abilities.name: Brushmaker
abilities.summary: Create a patch of brush; autos deal bonus damage in brush.
abilities.details: Ivern creates a patch of brush that lasts for a while. While in brush (including his own), Ivern's auto attacks deal bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Triggerseed
abilities.summary: Shield an ally; after a delay, explodes to slow enemies.
abilities.details: Ivern shields an ally. After a delay, the shield explodes dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Daisy!
abilities.summary: Summon Daisy, a golem that knocks up with every third attack.
abilities.details: Ivern summons his golem friend Daisy. Daisy attacks enemies and every third hit on the same target knocks them up. Ivern can recast to direct her.

playstyle.identity: Janna is a peeling enchanter with powerful disengage. Her ultimate heals allies while knocking enemies away, making her excellent at protecting carries.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives speed to allies moving toward you. Q charges a tornado (longer charge = longer knockup). W slows and damages. E shields an ally and gives AD. R heals allies around you while knocking enemies away. Save Q and R for enemy divers.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Janna spikes at level 6 with her disengage ultimate. Enchanter items scale her shields. She's strong at protecting carries at all stages.

passive.name: Tailwind
passive.summary: Gain movement speed; allies moving toward you also get speed.
passive.details: Janna gains bonus movement speed. Nearby allied champions gain movement speed when moving toward her.

abilities.name: Howling Gale
abilities.summary: Charge a tornado that knocks up; longer charge = longer distance and knockup.
abilities.details: Janna charges a tornado. Release to send it forward, knocking up enemies. Longer charge increases distance and knockup duration.

abilities.name: Zephyr
abilities.summary: Passive: gain movement speed. Active: damage and slow an enemy.
abilities.details: Passive: Janna gains bonus movement speed. Active: Deal magic damage to a target and slow them.

abilities.name: Eye of the Storm
abilities.summary: Shield an ally and grant them bonus AD.
abilities.details: Janna shields an ally, granting them bonus attack damage while the shield holds.

abilities.name: Monsoon
abilities.summary: Knock away enemies and heal allies around you while channeling.
abilities.details: Janna channels, knocking back enemies and healing allies in an area around her every second. She can move or act to cancel it.

playstyle.identity: Jarvan IV is a versatile engage jungler who traps enemies in his arena. His flag-drag combo makes him a reliable ganker with knockup engage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive deals bonus damage on first hit per target. Q is a skillshot that pulls you to your flag and knocks up. W slows around you and shields. E throws a flag giving attack speed. R creates impassable terrain trapping enemies inside. E-Q combo for knockup engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jarvan spikes at level 2 with E-Q combo and level 6 with arena trap. He's strong at ganking and teamfight engage throughout.

passive.name: Martial Cadence
passive.summary: First auto on each enemy deals bonus damage based on their current health.
passive.details: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current health. Has a cooldown per target.

abilities.name: Dragon Strike
abilities.summary: Thrust your lance; if it hits your flag, dash to it and knock up enemies.
abilities.details: Jarvan extends his lance in a line, dealing damage and reducing armor. If it passes through his flag, he dashes to it, knocking up enemies in his path.

abilities.name: Golden Aegis
abilities.summary: Shield based on nearby enemies and slow them.
abilities.details: Jarvan shields himself, with the shield increasing for each nearby enemy champion. Nearby enemies are also slowed.

abilities.name: Demacian Standard
abilities.summary: Throw a flag that gives attack speed; combo with Q to dash.
abilities.details: Jarvan throws a flag that deals damage on impact. The flag grants attack speed to nearby allies and acts as a target for Q's dash.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.summary: Leap to an enemy and create impassable terrain around you.
abilities.details: Jarvan leaps to an enemy champion, dealing damage and creating a circle of impassable terrain. Champions can use dashes to escape.

playstyle.identity: Jax is a scaling duelist who becomes nearly unkillable late game. His Counter Strike dodges all autos, making him a nightmare for auto-attack champions.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks attack speed with autos. Q leaps to target. W empowers next auto. E dodges all autos and stuns when it ends. R gives armor/MR and empowers every third auto. Jump in, E to dodge, auto-W-auto for burst. Late game you 1v9.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jax spikes at level 6 with R resistances and with Trinity Force. He's a late-game hyperscaling duelist.

passive.name: Relentless Assault
passive.summary: Auto attacks build stacks, increasing attack speed.
passive.details: Jax's basic attacks build stacks, granting bonus attack speed. Stacks fall off if Jax doesn't attack for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Leap Strike
abilities.summary: Jump to a target (ally, enemy, or ward).
abilities.details: Jax leaps to a target unit, dealing damage if it's an enemy. Can target allies, enemies, or wards.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.summary: Next auto attack deals bonus magic damage.
abilities.details: Jax empowers his next basic attack to deal bonus magic damage. Can be used as an auto reset.

abilities.name: Counter Strike
abilities.summary: Dodge all auto attacks; reactivate to stun nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Jax enters a defensive stance, dodging all basic attacks and reducing AoE damage. After 2 seconds or on recast, he stuns nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Grandmaster's Might
abilities.summary: Passive: every third auto deals bonus damage. Active: gain armor and MR.
abilities.details: Passive: Every third auto attack deals bonus magic damage. Active: Jax gains bonus armor and magic resist based on his AD and AP.

playstyle.identity: Jayce is a poke/all-in hybrid with two forms. His ranged form pokes with accelerated Q while hammer form bursts and knocks away enemies.
playstyle.howToPlay: Cannon (Ranged): Q shoots a shock blast. W creates a gate (Q through gate = accelerated). E speeds allies. Hammer (Melee): Q hammer slam. W AoE lightning. E knocks away. R swaps forms. Poke with cannon Q-E, then hammer all-in for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jayce spikes at level 3-6 with both forms and with lethality items. He's strongest mid-game at poking and bursting.

passive.name: Hextech Capacitor
passive.summary: Swapping forms grants movement speed and ghost.
passive.details: Each time Jayce transforms, he gains bonus movement speed and ignores unit collision for a short time.

abilities.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
abilities.summary: Hammer: leap and slam. Cannon: fire a shock blast.
abilities.details: Hammer: Jayce leaps to a target, dealing AoE damage and slowing. Cannon: Fire a blast that explodes on first enemy (accelerated through gate).

abilities.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
abilities.summary: Hammer: AoE lightning around you. Cannon: fire 3 fast shots.
abilities.details: Hammer: Deal magic damage around Jayce. Also passively restore mana on hit. Cannon: Fire 3 auto attacks rapidly at reduced damage.

abilities.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
abilities.summary: Hammer: knock enemy away. Cannon: create a speed gate.
abilities.details: Hammer: Knock an enemy back, dealing percent max health damage. Cannon: Create a gate that accelerates allied champions and Shock Blast.

abilities.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
abilities.summary: Swap between cannon (ranged) and hammer (melee) forms.
abilities.details: Jayce transforms, changing his abilities. Hammer gains bonus armor/MR. Cannon first attack shreds resistances.

playstyle.identity: Jhin is an artistic marksman who fires exactly four shots, with the fourth always critting. He builds AD and crit into movement speed, excelling at picks and poke.
playstyle.howToPlay: 4 bullets - 4th always crits and grants speed. Passive converts attack speed to AD and crit to movement speed. Q bounces between targets. W roots if target was recently damaged by ally. E places traps. R fires 4 global sniper shots. Reload during W or R animation.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jhin spikes with Infinity Edge and crit items. He's strong at picks and teamfight poke throughout.

passive.name: Whisper
passive.summary: Four shots (4th crits); attack speed becomes AD, crits give movement speed.
passive.details: Jhin fires 4 shots then reloads. The 4th shot always crits with bonus damage. He can't gain attack speed normally - bonus attack speed becomes bonus AD. Critical strikes grant movement speed.

abilities.name: Dancing Grenade
abilities.summary: Throw a grenade that bounces between enemies, dealing more damage on kills.
abilities.details: Jhin throws a canister that bounces to up to 4 targets. Each kill increases the next bounce's damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Flourish
abilities.summary: Fire a long-range shot that roots enemies recently damaged by allies.
abilities.details: Jhin fires a shot in a line, dealing damage and revealing. Enemies damaged by Jhin or allies recently are rooted.

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.summary: Place invisible traps that slow and damage enemies.
abilities.details: Jhin places an invisible trap that reveals and slows enemies. After a delay, it detonates dealing damage. Enemies killed by Jhin spawn traps.

abilities.name: Curtain Call
abilities.summary: Fire 4 long-range shots in a cone; 4th deals massive damage.
abilities.details: Jhin sets up his sniper rifle and fires up to 4 shots globally in a cone. Each shot damages and slows; the 4th shot deals massive damage based on missing health.

champions.name: Jinx
champions.title: the Loose Cannon

playstyle.identity: Jinx is a hypercarry marksman who snowballs out of control with her passive reset. Once she gets a kill or assist, she becomes a mobile destruction machine that can clean up entire teams.
playstyle.howToPlay: Farm safely in lane using Pow-Pow (minigun) for single targets and Fishbones (rocket) for poke and waveclear. Land W to slow enemies for your support's engage. Use E traps defensively or to zone. Your global ultimate can snipe low-health enemies anywhere on the map.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jinx spikes hard at 3 items when her attack speed and crit synergize. She's weak early but becomes one of the strongest late-game carries. Get Excited! resets turn teamfights in her favor.

strengths: Insane late-game scaling and teamfight cleanup
Passive gives huge movement and attack speed on takedowns
Long range with rocket launcher form
weaknesses: Very squishy and vulnerable to assassins
Relies on team to peel for her

passive.name: Get Excited!
passive.summary: Gain massive movement and attack speed after a kill or assist.
passive.details: Whenever Jinx scores a kill, assist, or destroys a structure, she gains a huge burst of movement speed and attack speed that decays over a few seconds. This is what makes Jinx a cleanup monster - each takedown refreshes the buff and lets her chase down the next target.

abilities.name: Switcheroo!
abilities.summary: Switch between a rapid-fire minigun and an explosive rocket launcher.
abilities.details: Toggle between Pow-Pow (minigun) and Fishbones (rocket launcher). Pow-Pow grants stacking attack speed with each hit. Fishbones costs mana, has longer range, and deals splash damage. Use minigun for sustained DPS and rockets for poke and waveclear.

abilities.name: Zap!
abilities.summary: Fire a long-range shock that damages and slows the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Jinx fires a shock blast that damages and heavily slows the first enemy hit. It has long range and reveals the target. Use it to poke in lane, check bushes, slow fleeing enemies, or set up your E traps. The cast time makes you vulnerable, so position carefully.

abilities.name: Flame Chompers!
abilities.summary: Throw out traps that root enemies who walk over them.
abilities.details: Jinx tosses a line of three traps that arm after a brief delay. Enemies stepping on armed traps are rooted and take damage. Use them defensively to block engages, in choke points during fights, or on top of CC'd enemies for guaranteed roots.

abilities.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
abilities.summary: Fire a global rocket that deals massive damage based on missing health.
abilities.details: Jinx fires a rocket that travels across the map, gaining damage the farther it travels. It deals damage in an area and deals bonus damage based on enemies' missing health. Use to snipe low-health enemies, start fights, or steal objectives from across the map.

champions.name: K'Sante
champions.title: the Pride of Nazumah

playstyle.identity: K'Sante is a skill-expressive tank who transforms into a damage dealer with his ultimate. He excels at isolating targets and dueling in All Out form.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a short stab (3rd Q knocks up). W charges and dashes, unstoppable and stunning. E dashes to ally or through enemy. R knocks back an enemy and transforms to All Out (less tanky, more damage, lower cooldowns). R a carry into your team or 1v1 them.
playstyle.powerSpikes: K'Sante spikes at level 6 with his dueling ultimate. Tank items work, but R converts them to damage. He's strong at isolating and outplaying.

strengths: All Out form has high damage

passive.name: Dauntless Instinct
passive.summary: Abilities mark enemies; marked auto attacks deal percent max health damage.
passive.details: K'Sante's damaging abilities mark enemies. Auto attacking a marked enemy deals bonus percent max health damage. In All Out form, this damage is increased.

abilities.name: Ntofo Strikes
abilities.summary: Stab forward; third Q knocks up enemies.
abilities.details: K'Sante stabs, dealing damage and slowing. The third consecutive Q knocks up enemies. All Out: Increased damage.

abilities.name: Path Maker
abilities.summary: Charge and dash forward, unstoppable during charge, stunning enemies.
abilities.details: K'Sante charges, becoming unstoppable and reducing damage taken. Release to dash, dealing damage and stunning enemies hit.

abilities.name: Footwork
abilities.summary: Dash; can dash to an ally or through an enemy.
abilities.details: K'Sante dashes to a location. If he dashes to an ally, they both gain a shield. Can dash through enemies during All Out.

abilities.name: All Out
abilities.summary: Knock an enemy back and transform, sacrificing tankiness for damage.
abilities.details: K'Sante knocks an enemy back and transforms into All Out form. His tank stats are converted to bonus AD and omnivamp, and abilities deal more damage.

playstyle.identity: Kai'Sa is an evolving ADC who upgrades abilities by buying stats. She excels at diving into fights with her ultimate and bursting isolated targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive procs plasma on 5 hits for burst. Abilities evolve at stat thresholds (Q at AD, W at AP, E at attack speed). Q fires missiles (more on isolated). W long-range poke. E gives speed and invisibility when evolved. R dashes to any plasma-marked enemy. Evolve Q first.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kai'Sa spikes at each evolution. Q evolve at Kraken makes her dangerous. She's strong mid-late with all evolutions.

passive.name: Second Skin
passive.summary: Attacks and abilities stack plasma; at 5 stacks, proc for burst damage.
passive.details: Kai'Sa's attacks and abilities apply plasma stacks. Ally CC also adds stacks. At 5 stacks, the target takes bonus magic damage. She also evolves abilities at stat thresholds.

abilities.name: Icathian Rain
abilities.summary: Fire missiles that prioritize nearby enemies; more damage on isolated targets.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa fires missiles at nearby enemies. Missiles prioritize champions and deal more damage to isolated targets. Evolves to fire more missiles.

abilities.name: Void Seeker
abilities.summary: Fire a long-range skillshot that marks for plasma and reveals.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa fires a bolt that damages, reveals, and applies plasma stacks. Evolves to apply more stacks and have lower cooldown on hit.

abilities.name: Supercharge
abilities.summary: Gain movement speed and attack speed; evolved grants invisibility.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa charges up, gaining movement speed. After charging, she gains attack speed. Evolves to grant brief invisibility during charge.

abilities.name: Killer Instinct
abilities.summary: Dash to any enemy with plasma stacks, gaining a shield.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa dashes to a location near an enemy champion with plasma, gaining a damage-absorbing shield.

playstyle.identity: Kalista is a mobile ADC who hops with every auto attack. She bonds with an ally for coordinated engages and can pull them to safety.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive makes you hop in move direction after each auto. W binds you to an ally for bonus damage together. Q throws a spear that passes through kills. E stacks rend - activate to pull out spears for burst/slow. R pulls bound ally to you, they can launch for knockup.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kalista spikes with attack speed for more hops and with BOTRK. She's strong with an aggressive support who can use her R.

passive.name: Martial Poise
passive.summary: Auto attacks make Kalista hop in the direction she's moving.
passive.details: Kalista's auto attacks cause her to dash in the direction she's moving. She can't cancel auto attacks normally.

abilities.name: Pierce
abilities.summary: Throw a spear that passes through killed targets.
abilities.details: Kalista hurls a spear, dealing damage. If it kills the target, it continues through and transfers any rend stacks.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.summary: Bind to an ally; gain bonus damage when attacking the same target.
abilities.details: Passive: Kalista and her bound Oathsworn deal bonus damage when they attack the same target. Active: Send a sentinel to scout an area.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.summary: Auto attacks stack spears; activate to rip them out for damage and slow.
abilities.details: Passive: Attacks lodge spears in enemies. Active: Rip out all spears, dealing damage per spear and slowing. Cooldown resets if it kills.

abilities.name: Fate's Call
abilities.summary: Pull your bound ally to you; they can launch out for a knockup.
abilities.details: Kalista draws her bound ally to her, making them untargetable. They can then launch themselves out, knocking up the first enemy hit.

playstyle.identity: Karma is an early-game enchanter who starts with her ultimate. She excels at poking and shielding, with Mantra empowering abilities throughout the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: R (Mantra) is available at level 1 and empowers next ability. Q fires a blast that slows and detonates (R-Q adds explosion). W tethers and roots after duration (R-W heals massively). E shields and speeds (R-E shields all allies). Poke with R-Q or teamfight with R-E.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Karma spikes at levels 1-3 with Mantra poke. Enchanter items scale her. She's strongest early-mid before falling off.

passive.name: Gathering Fire
passive.summary: Abilities and autos reduce Mantra's cooldown.
passive.details: Karma's abilities and auto attacks against champions reduce Mantra's cooldown.

abilities.name: Inner Flame
abilities.summary: Fire a blast that explodes and slows. Mantra: adds a larger detonation.
abilities.details: Karma fires a ball of flame that explodes on the first enemy, dealing damage and slowing. Mantra (Soulflare): The explosion is larger and leaves a damaging field.

abilities.name: Focused Resolve
abilities.summary: Tether to an enemy; if it holds, they're rooted. Mantra: heal massively.
abilities.details: Karma tethers to an enemy, dealing damage. If the tether holds, the enemy is rooted. Mantra (Renewal): Also heals Karma significantly.

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.summary: Shield an ally and grant movement speed. Mantra: shield all nearby allies.
abilities.details: Karma shields an ally and grants them movement speed. Mantra (Defiance): Also shields all nearby allied champions.

abilities.name: Mantra
abilities.summary: Empower your next ability with bonus effects.
abilities.details: Karma empowers her next basic ability, adding bonus effects. Available at level 1, with cooldown reduced by Gathering Fire.

playstyle.identity: Karthus is a global damage mage whose ultimate hits all enemy champions. He excels at farming, teamfight DPS, and securing kills from across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive lets you cast for 7 seconds after death. Q is spammable AoE (double damage to isolated). W creates a slow/MR shred zone. E toggles AoE around you. R channels then damages ALL enemy champions globally. Farm with Q, die in fights, R from death.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Karthus spikes at level 6 with global R. Rabadon's amplifies his ult damage. He's strong at all stages with Q farm and R pressure.

passive.name: Death Defied
passive.summary: After dying, become a ghost that can cast abilities for 7 seconds.
passive.details: Upon death, Karthus becomes a spirit for 7 seconds, able to cast abilities at no cost. He can't move or be targeted during this time.

abilities.name: Lay Waste
abilities.summary: Drop a bomb that deals double damage to isolated targets.
abilities.details: Karthus creates a delayed explosion at a target location. Enemies hit take magic damage, doubled if they're the only target in the area.

abilities.name: Wall of Pain
abilities.summary: Create a wall that slows enemies and shreds magic resist.
abilities.details: Karthus creates a spectral wall. Enemies who pass through are slowed and have their magic resist reduced.

abilities.name: Defile
abilities.summary: Toggle AoE damage around you; passively restore mana on kill.
abilities.details: Passive: Karthus restores mana on killing units. Active: Toggle to deal damage per second to nearby enemies (drains mana).

abilities.name: Requiem
abilities.summary: Channel, then damage ALL enemy champions globally.
abilities.details: Karthus channels for 3 seconds, then deals magic damage to all enemy champions on the map. Can be cast during Death Defied.

playstyle.identity: Kassadin is a late-game hypercarry assassin who blinks constantly with his ultimate. He's weak early but becomes nearly unstoppable with items and levels.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive reduces magic damage and ignores unit collision. Q silences and gives magic shield. W empowers auto with mana restore. E requires 6 spells nearby to cast, then slows. R blinks and damages, stacking damage and mana cost each time. Farm to 16, then blink constantly.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kassadin spikes at level 6 with blink, level 11 with lower R cooldown, and level 16 when he's a monster. He needs time to scale.

passive.name: Void Stone
passive.summary: Take reduced magic damage and ignore unit collision.
passive.details: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and can walk through units.

abilities.name: Null Sphere
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt that damages, silences, and grants magic damage shield.
abilities.details: Kassadin fires a bolt dealing magic damage and interrupting channels. He gains a shield that absorbs magic damage.

abilities.name: Nether Blade
abilities.summary: Passive: autos deal bonus magic damage. Active: empower next auto to deal more and restore mana.
abilities.details: Passive: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Next attack deals increased damage and restores mana.

abilities.name: Force Pulse
abilities.summary: After 6 spells are cast nearby, fire a wave that damages and slows.
abilities.details: Kassadin charges Force Pulse when abilities are used near him. At 6 charges, he can cast it to deal damage and slow enemies in a cone.

abilities.name: Riftwalk
abilities.summary: Blink to a location dealing damage; stacks cost more mana but deal more damage.
abilities.details: Kassadin teleports to a location, dealing magic damage. Each consecutive cast within 15 seconds doubles the mana cost and increases damage.

playstyle.identity: Katarina is a reset assassin who bounces around teamfights collecting kills. Her abilities reset on takedowns, allowing her to pentakill if she gets going.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: daggers drop from abilities - pick them up for AoE damage. Q bounces and drops a dagger. W drops a dagger at your feet. E blinks to target (instant on daggers). R channels spinning blades around you. Q-E-W-E for burst, R in teamfights, reset on kills.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Katarina spikes at level 6 with R burst and at level 3 for combos. She's strong when she can chain resets in teamfights.

passive.name: Voracity
passive.summary: Takedowns reset cooldowns; picking up daggers deals AoE damage.
passive.details: Champion takedowns reduce all cooldowns significantly. Picking up daggers deals magic damage in an area around Katarina.

abilities.name: Bouncing Blade
abilities.summary: Throw a dagger that bounces between enemies and drops behind the first.
abilities.details: Katarina throws a dagger that bounces to nearby enemies, then drops on the ground behind the initial target.

abilities.name: Preparation
abilities.summary: Drop a dagger at your feet and gain movement speed.
abilities.details: Katarina tosses a dagger in the air above her (landing after a delay) and gains movement speed that decays.

abilities.name: Shunpo
abilities.summary: Blink to a target; instant cooldown if blinking to a dagger.
abilities.details: Katarina blinks to a target (ally, enemy, or dagger), dealing damage to enemies. Blinking to a dagger resets the cooldown.

abilities.name: Death Lotus
abilities.summary: Channel to throw daggers at nearby enemies, applying Grievous Wounds.
abilities.details: Katarina channels for up to 2.5 seconds, throwing daggers at up to 3 nearby enemies. Applies Grievous Wounds and deals massive damage.

playstyle.identity: Kayle is a scaling champion who transforms at levels 6, 11, and 16. She's weak melee early but becomes a ranged hypercarry angel who destroys teams.
playstyle.howToPlay: Evolve at 6 (ranged), 11 (waves), 16 (permanent fire waves). Q slows and shreds resist. W heals and speeds. E empowers auto and executes. R makes target invulnerable. Survive early, farm to 16, become a god.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kayle spikes at level 6 (ranged), level 11 (waves), and level 16 (permanent waves). AP or AD builds work. She's a late-game hypercarry.

passive.name: Divine Ascent
passive.summary: Evolve at levels 6, 11, and 16, gaining range and fire waves.
passive.details: Kayle transforms: Level 6 becomes ranged. Level 11 gains fire waves on attack. Level 16 waves become permanent and deal true damage. Also gain attack speed with stacks.

abilities.name: Radiant Blast
abilities.summary: Fire a blade that slows and shreds armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Kayle throws a blade that damages and slows enemies, reducing their armor and magic resist.

abilities.name: Celestial Blessing
abilities.summary: Heal yourself and an ally while granting movement speed.
abilities.details: Kayle heals herself and a nearby ally, granting both movement speed.

abilities.name: Starfire Spellblade
abilities.summary: Passive: autos deal bonus damage. Active: empower auto to deal bonus damage and execute.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Next attack deals bonus damage based on missing health.

abilities.name: Divine Judgment
abilities.summary: Make yourself or an ally invulnerable, then deal damage around them.
abilities.details: Kayle makes herself or an ally invulnerable for a few seconds. After the duration, swords rain down dealing damage around the target.

playstyle.identity: Kayn is a transforming jungler who becomes either Shadow Assassin (burst) or Rhaast (drain tank) based on who he fights. He walks through walls and adapts to the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive transforms based on combat (ranged = assassin, melee = Rhaast). Q dashes and damages. W slows (Rhaast knocks up). E walks through terrain and heals. R dives into an enemy, becoming untargetable. Choose form based on enemy comp.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kayn spikes when he transforms. Shadow Assassin bursts squishies. Rhaast sustains through tanks. He's strong after transformation.

passive.name: The Darkin Scythe
passive.summary: Fighting ranged grants Shadow Assassin; fighting melee grants Rhaast form.
passive.details: Kayn builds bars by fighting champions. Ranged champions build blue (Shadow Assassin), melee build red (Rhaast). First full bar allows transformation.

abilities.name: Reaping Slash
abilities.summary: Dash and spin, dealing damage twice.
abilities.details: Kayn dashes and spins his scythe, dealing damage twice. Can pass through thin walls.

abilities.name: Blade's Reach
abilities.summary: Slash forward dealing damage and slowing. Rhaast: also knocks up.
abilities.details: Kayn slashes in a line, damaging and slowing enemies. As Rhaast, this ability also knocks enemies up.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.summary: Walk through terrain gaining movement speed and healing.
abilities.details: Kayn gains movement speed and can walk through terrain. He heals the first time he enters terrain.

abilities.name: Umbral Trespass
abilities.summary: Dive into an enemy champion, becoming untargetable, then burst out.
abilities.details: Kayn infests an enemy champion, becoming untargetable inside them. After a few seconds or on recast, he bursts out dealing damage. Rhaast heals based on target max health.

champions.name: Kennen
champions.title: the Heart of the Tempest

playstyle.identity: Kennen is a teamfight mage who stuns with his mark system. His ultimate is devastating when he engages on grouped enemies, stunning everyone.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities apply marks; at 3 marks, enemies are stunned. Q is a skillshot shuriken. W empowers every 5th auto and can activate to damage marked enemies. E turns you into a lightning ball. R creates a storm that hits and marks nearby enemies repeatedly. E-flash-R into teams.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kennen spikes at level 6 with teamfight ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. He's strong at AoE stuns in teamfights.

weaknesses: R needs to be in melee

passive.name: Mark of the Storm
passive.summary: Abilities apply marks; at 3 marks, enemies are stunned.
passive.details: Kennen's abilities apply a Mark of the Storm. At 3 marks, the enemy is stunned and marks are consumed.

abilities.name: Thundering Shuriken
abilities.summary: Throw a shuriken that damages and marks the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Kennen throws a shuriken in a line, dealing damage and applying a mark to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Electrical Surge
abilities.summary: Passive: every 5th auto marks. Active: damage and mark all nearby marked enemies.
abilities.details: Passive: Every 5th auto deals bonus damage and applies a mark. Active: Damage and apply a mark to all nearby enemies already marked.

abilities.name: Lightning Rush
abilities.summary: Transform into a lightning ball, gaining speed and passing through units.
abilities.details: Kennen transforms into a ball of lightning, gaining movement speed and passing through units while damaging and marking enemies.

abilities.name: Slicing Maelstrom
abilities.summary: Create a storm that damages and marks nearby enemies repeatedly.
abilities.details: Kennen summons a storm around him that repeatedly hits nearby enemies, dealing damage and applying marks. Combined with his mark system, this can stun entire teams.

playstyle.identity: Kha'Zix is an evolving assassin who hunts isolated targets. His abilities upgrade at 6/11/16, and he one-shots anyone caught alone.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive makes next auto deal bonus damage from stealth/brush. Q is single target (massive bonus on isolated). W fires spikes that heal. E leaps. R goes invisible 2-3 times. Evolve Q for damage, E for resets, or R for invisibility. Hunt isolated targets.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kha'Zix spikes at each evolution (6, 11, 16). Duskblade and lethality scale him. He's strong at assassinating isolated targets.

passive.name: Unseen Threat
passive.summary: From stealth or brush, next auto deals bonus damage and slows.
passive.details: When Kha'Zix is unseen, his next basic attack against a champion deals bonus magic damage and slows them.

abilities.name: Taste Their Fear
abilities.summary: Slash an enemy; deals massive bonus damage if they're isolated.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix slashes a target, dealing physical damage. If the target is isolated (no allies nearby), the damage is massively increased. Evolve: Increases range and refunds cooldown on isolated targets.

abilities.name: Void Spike
abilities.summary: Fire spikes that slow; heal if they hit champions.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix fires spikes that damage and slow. If he's hit by the explosion, he heals. Evolve: Fires 3 spikes in a cone and applies passive slow.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.summary: Leap to a location. Evolve: longer range and resets on kill.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix leaps to a location, dealing damage on landing. Evolve: Increased range and the cooldown resets on champion takedown.

abilities.name: Void Assault
abilities.summary: Go invisible briefly; can cast multiple times. Evolve: 3 casts and longer stealth.
abilities.details: Kha'Zix becomes invisible and gains movement speed. Can be cast again within a few seconds. Evolve: Can be cast 3 times and duration is increased.

playstyle.identity: Kindred is a scaling marksman jungler who hunts marks for permanent stats. Their ultimate creates a zone where nothing can die.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive marks jungle camps and champions - kill marks for permanent range and damage. Q dashes and fires arrows. W creates a hunting zone where Q has lower cooldown. E slows and executes on 3rd hit. R prevents ALL deaths in an area (allies and enemies). Farm marks, R to save.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kindred spikes with marks (4 for first range increase). Attack speed and crit scale them. They're strong with marks stacked.

passive.name: Mark of the Kindred
passive.summary: Hunt marks on camps and champions for permanent attack range and damage.
passive.details: Lamb marks enemy champions; Wolf marks jungle camps. Killing marked targets grants permanent bonus attack range and percent health damage on attacks.

abilities.name: Dance of Arrows
abilities.summary: Dash and fire arrows at nearby enemies. Lower cooldown in W zone.
abilities.details: Kindred dashes and fires up to 3 arrows at nearby enemies. While inside Wolf's Frenzy, the cooldown is massively reduced.

abilities.name: Wolf's Frenzy
abilities.summary: Create a zone where Wolf attacks enemies and Q cooldown is reduced.
abilities.details: Kindred creates a hunting zone. Wolf attacks enemies inside, and Dance of Arrows cooldown is reduced while in the zone.

abilities.name: Mounting Dread
abilities.summary: Mark an enemy; after 3 attacks, deal massive damage and slow.
abilities.details: Kindred marks an enemy, slowing them. After 3 attacks, the mark detonates dealing missing health damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Lamb's Respite
abilities.summary: Create a zone where NO unit can die. After, heal all units inside.
abilities.details: Kindred creates a zone where no unit can drop below minimum health. When it ends, all units inside are healed. Affects allies and enemies.

playstyle.identity: Kled is an aggressive bruiser who can dismount and remount his lizard Skaarl. He excels at diving and chasing with his long-range charge ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Mounted: 2 health bars (Skaarl's then Kled's). Q throws a bear trap that pulls after sticking. W gives attack speed burst. E dashes through enemies (can recast to dash back). R charges in a direction, all allies behind gain speed. Dismounted: rebuild courage to remount.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kled spikes at level 6 with his engage ultimate. Eclipse and bruiser items scale him. He's strong at all-ins and dives.

passive.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
passive.summary: Mounted on Skaarl with bonus health; dismount when Skaarl flees, remount by gaining courage.
passive.details: Kled rides Skaarl, who has his own health bar. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts with reduced abilities. Attacking champions or killing units builds courage to remount Skaarl.

abilities.name: Bear Trap on a Rope / Pocket Pistol
abilities.summary: Mounted: throw a bear trap that pulls. Dismounted: fire a pistol.
abilities.details: Mounted: Throw a bear trap that damages and pulls the first enemy hit after a duration. Dismounted: Fire your pistol, dealing damage and knocking yourself back.

abilities.name: Violent Tendencies
abilities.summary: Passive: periodically gain attack speed; 4th hit deals max health damage.
abilities.details: When activated (or passively), Kled gains massive attack speed for 4 attacks. The 4th attack deals bonus damage based on max health.

abilities.name: Jousting
abilities.summary: Dash through enemies; can recast to dash back through the same target.
abilities.details: Kled dashes, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. He can recast to dash back through the same target again.

abilities.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
abilities.summary: Charge in a direction; allies behind gain speed and you gain a shield on impact.
abilities.details: Kled charges toward a location, gaining movement speed and a shield. Allied champions behind him also gain movement speed. On arrival, he deals damage and pulls the closest enemy.

playstyle.identity: Kog'Maw is a hyper-scaling ADC with massive range and percent health damage. He's immobile but melts tanks with his W-empowered attacks.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive lets you move and explode after death. Q shreds armor/MR. W gives huge range and percent max health damage on autos. E slows in a line. R fires artillery that scales with enemy missing health. Position safely, W for DPS, ult to finish.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kog'Maw spikes with attack speed and at level 9 for max W. Guinsoo's and on-hit melt tanks. He's a late-game hypercarry.

passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.summary: On death, become a bomb that explodes after 4 seconds.
passive.details: Upon death, Kog'Maw gains movement speed and explodes after 4 seconds, dealing true damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Caustic Spittle
abilities.summary: Fire a skillshot that shreds armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Passive: Gain attack speed. Active: Fire a skillshot that damages and shreds the armor and magic resist of the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
abilities.summary: Gain massive range and deal percent max health damage on autos.
abilities.details: Kog'Maw's attacks gain massive bonus range and deal percent max health magic damage for several seconds.

abilities.name: Void Ooze
abilities.summary: Spit ooze that damages and slows enemies in a line.
abilities.details: Kog'Maw launches ooze that damages enemies and leaves a trail that slows enemies who stand in it.

abilities.name: Living Artillery
abilities.summary: Fire artillery that deals more damage to low health targets. Costs more mana with rapid use.
abilities.details: Kog'Maw fires artillery at a location, dealing magic damage increased by the target's missing health. Repeated use within a short time increases the mana cost.

playstyle.identity: LeBlanc is a slippery burst mage who can return to her dash origin. She excels at assassinating targets and escaping with her multiple blinks.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive creates a clone at low health. Q marks target (proc with another ability for bonus damage). W dashes and can return. E tethers and roots after duration. R mimics last ability cast. Q-W to poke, Q-R-W-E for full burst, W back to safety.
playstyle.powerSpikes: LeBlanc spikes at level 6 with mimic burst. Luden's scales her damage. She's strong at picks and burst throughout mid-game.

passive.name: Mirror Image
passive.summary: When low on health, create a clone and briefly become invisible.
passive.details: When LeBlanc drops below a health threshold, she becomes invisible and creates a clone that can be controlled.

abilities.name: Sigil of Malice
abilities.summary: Mark a target; proccing the mark with another ability deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: LeBlanc fires a sigil at a target, dealing damage and marking them. If she damages them again with an ability, the mark detonates for bonus damage.

abilities.name: Distortion
abilities.summary: Dash to a location; can reactivate to return to the origin.
abilities.details: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage on arrival. She can reactivate within a few seconds to return to her starting position.

abilities.name: Ethereal Chains
abilities.summary: Fire a chain that roots if the tether holds.
abilities.details: LeBlanc fires a chain that damages and slows the first enemy hit. If the tether isn't broken, the target is rooted after a delay.

abilities.name: Mimic
abilities.summary: Cast an empowered version of your last basic ability.
abilities.details: LeBlanc casts a more powerful version of her most recently used basic ability. Can also return to Mimic Distortion's location.

champions.name: Lee Sin
champions.title: the Blind Monk

playstyle.identity: Lee Sin is the ultimate playmaking jungler with unmatched mobility and outplay potential. His high skill ceiling rewards mechanical mastery with flashy Insec kicks and ward-hop outplays.
playstyle.howToPlay: Clear jungle efficiently using abilities between autos for passive attack speed. Gank with Q, follow up with E slow, then decide to R kick them into your team or save it. Master ward-hopping (W to a ward) for mobility. The Insec combo (Q > ward behind > R kick into team) wins games.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Lee Sin dominates early game - his level 3 ganks are terrifying. He spikes with first item and is strongest in the mid-game. Falls off late, so close out games early or transition to a peeling role.

strengths: Incredible early game ganks and dueling
Game-changing ultimate for picks and teamfights
Strong objective control with Q execute
weaknesses: High skill floor and ceiling - hard to master
Energy-gated - can run out in extended fights
Requires wards for full mobility potential

passive.name: Flurry
passive.summary: After using an ability, your next 2 attacks gain attack speed and restore energy.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Lee Sin's next two basic attacks gain 40% attack speed and restore energy. This is crucial for sustain and clear speed - always weave auto attacks between abilities to maximize damage and energy efficiency.

abilities.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
abilities.summary: Fire a wave that marks enemies; recast to dash to them and deal execute damage.
abilities.details: Sonic Wave fires a skillshot that damages and marks the first enemy hit. Recast (Resonating Strike) to dash to the marked target, dealing damage based on their missing health. This is your engage, gap-close, and execute. Can be used on jungle camps for mobility.

abilities.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
abilities.summary: Dash to an ally or ward; recast to gain lifesteal and spell vamp.
abilities.details: Safeguard dashes to a target ally, minion, or ward, shielding both you and the target. Iron Will (recast) gives lifesteal and spell vamp. Ward-hopping (placing a ward and instantly W'ing to it) is essential for Lee Sin combos and escapes.

abilities.name: Tempest / Cripple
abilities.summary: Deal AoE damage and reveal enemies; recast to slow them.
abilities.details: Tempest deals magic damage to nearby enemies and reveals them for a few seconds. Recast (Cripple) slows all revealed enemies' movement and attack speed. Use for clearing camps, revealing invisible champions, and slowing enemies during ganks.

abilities.name: Dragon's Rage
abilities.summary: Kick an enemy champion, knocking back all enemies they collide with.
abilities.details: Lee Sin performs a powerful kick that sends the target flying, dealing massive damage. Enemies the kicked champion collides with are also knocked up and damaged. The famous 'Insec' maneuver involves Q'ing to a target, ward-hopping behind them, and R kicking them into your team.

playstyle.identity: Leona is an all-in tank support with layered crowd control. She excels at engaging and locking down targets with her multiple stuns.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive marks enemies for allies to proc bonus damage. Q is an auto reset stun. W gives armor/MR and explodes. E dashes to last enemy hit. R stuns in center, slows otherwise. E-Q for basic engage, R-E-Q for full lockdown.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Leona spikes at level 2-3 with her CC combo and level 6 with ranged engage. Tank items make her durable. She's strong at all-ins throughout.

passive.name: Sunlight
passive.summary: Abilities mark enemies; ally attacks consume marks for bonus damage.
passive.details: Leona's abilities mark enemies with Sunlight. Allied champions who attack marked enemies deal bonus magic damage and consume the mark.

abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to stun the target.
abilities.details: Leona's next basic attack deals bonus damage and stuns the target.

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.summary: Gain armor and MR; after a delay, explode for damage.
abilities.details: Leona surrounds herself with a solar shield, gaining bonus armor and magic resist. After a few seconds, it explodes dealing damage and extending the bonus if she hits an enemy.

abilities.name: Zenith Blade
abilities.summary: Fire a blade; dash to the last enemy champion hit.
abilities.details: Leona fires a blade through enemies, dealing damage. She dashes to the last enemy champion hit, rooting them.

abilities.name: Solar Flare
abilities.summary: Call down a sunbeam that stuns in the center, slows otherwise.
abilities.details: Leona calls down a beam of light at a target location. Enemies in the center are stunned; enemies in the outer area are slowed.

playstyle.identity: Lillia is a skirmishing AP jungler who stacks movement speed and puts enemies to sleep. She excels at kiting around fights with her constant speed.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive deals burn damage and hitting abilities stacks movement speed. Q swings (edge deals true damage). W slams with a delay. E rolls a seed that blooms on terrain or champions. R puts all Dream-marked enemies to sleep. Keep hitting abilities for speed, R for AoE sleep.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Lillia spikes at level 6 with her sleep ultimate. Liandry's burns with her passive. She's strong at kiting and teamfighting.

passive.name: Dream-Laden Bough
passive.summary: Abilities deal burn damage and stack movement speed.
passive.details: Lillia's abilities deal additional magic damage over time. Hitting abilities grants stacking movement speed.

abilities.name: Blooming Blows
abilities.summary: Swing and deal damage; outer edge deals true damage.
abilities.details: Lillia swings her censer, dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by the outer edge take bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Watch Out! Eep!
abilities.summary: Slam an area after a delay; center deals more damage.
abilities.details: Lillia slams down at a target area after a delay. Enemies in the center take significantly more damage.

abilities.name: Swirlseed
abilities.summary: Roll a seed that speeds up and blooms on terrain or champions.
abilities.details: Lillia rolls a seed that speeds up over distance. It blooms on hitting terrain or an enemy champion, dealing damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Lilting Lullaby
abilities.summary: Put all Dream-marked enemies to sleep; they take bonus damage on wake.
abilities.details: All enemy champions marked by Lillia's passive are put to sleep after a short delay. They take bonus damage when the sleep is broken.

playstyle.identity: Lissandra is a control mage who can lock herself in stasis or root all enemies near a target. She excels at engaging and locking down teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive spawns a frozen thrall from dead enemies. Q fires ice shards. W roots all nearby enemies. E sends a claw you can teleport to. R can self-cast (stasis + AoE damage) or target enemy (roots them + AoE). E-R for engage, self-R to survive burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Lissandra spikes at level 6 with her engage/survival ultimate. Luden's and mage items scale her. She's strong at teamfight control.

passive.name: Iceborn Subjugation
passive.summary: Enemies that die near Lissandra become frozen thralls that chase enemies.
passive.details: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra, they become a frozen thrall that slows nearby enemies and eventually shatters.

abilities.name: Ice Shard
abilities.summary: Fire ice that shatters through the first enemy, slowing.
abilities.details: Lissandra throws ice that shatters through the first target, damaging and slowing enemies in a line behind them.

abilities.name: Ring of Frost
abilities.summary: Root all nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Lissandra freezes all nearby enemies, dealing damage and rooting them.

abilities.name: Glacial Path
abilities.summary: Send a claw of ice; reactivate to teleport to it.
abilities.details: Lissandra sends an icy claw in a direction. She can reactivate to teleport to the claw's location.

abilities.name: Frozen Tomb
abilities.summary: Self-cast for stasis and AoE damage; or target enemy to root them and deal AoE.
abilities.details: On self: Lissandra encases herself in ice (stasis), healing and dealing damage around her. On enemy: The target is rooted and takes damage; a ring of frost spreads outward.

playstyle.identity: Lucian is a mobile ADC who weaves abilities between auto attacks. He excels at short trades and outdueling with his double-shot passive.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive fires two shots after each ability. Q shoots through minions. W marks enemies for speed when hit. E dashes (cooldown reduced by passive shots). R fires a barrage of bullets. Weave abilities with autos for maximum damage, E to reposition.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Lucian spikes at levels 2-3 with ability combos and at Kraken Slayer. He's strong in lane and mid-game skirmishes.

passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.summary: After using an ability, next auto fires two shots.
passive.details: After using an ability, Lucian's next basic attack fires two shots. The second shot deals reduced damage but can crit.

abilities.name: Piercing Light
abilities.summary: Fire a beam of light through an enemy in a line.
abilities.details: Lucian shoots a bolt of light through a target enemy, damaging all enemies in a line behind them.

abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
abilities.summary: Fire a shot that marks enemies; hitting marked enemies grants movement speed.
abilities.details: Lucian fires a shot that damages and marks enemies. Lucian gains movement speed when he or allies damage marked enemies.

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.summary: Dash in a direction; cooldown reduced by Lightslinger shots.
abilities.details: Lucian dashes a short distance. Each Lightslinger shot that hits an enemy reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: The Culling
abilities.summary: Fire a barrage of bullets in a direction; can move while firing.
abilities.details: Lucian fires a barrage of shots in a direction for a few seconds, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. He can move while firing.

playstyle.identity: Lulu is a polymorphing enchanter who makes allies stronger and enemies useless. She excels at buffing hypercarries and shutting down assassins.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: Pix follows allies you buff or enemies you debuff. Q fires bolts from you and Pix. W speeds allies or polymorphs enemies. E shields ally (Pix follows them) or damages enemy (Pix follows them). R gives ally health and knocks up enemies around them.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Lulu spikes at level 6 with her save ultimate. Enchanter items scale her shields. She's strong at protecting hypercarries at all stages.

passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
passive.summary: Pix fires bolts alongside allied attacks and can follow allies or enemies.
passive.details: Pix fires bolts at Lulu's attack target. Pix can be sent to follow allies or enemies with Lulu's spells, firing bolts from that position.

abilities.name: Glitterlance
abilities.summary: Fire bolts from you and Pix that slow enemies.
abilities.details: Lulu and Pix each fire a bolt toward a target location. Enemies hit are damaged and slowed.

abilities.name: Whimsy
abilities.summary: On ally: grant attack speed and movement speed. On enemy: polymorph them.
abilities.details: On ally: Grant bonus attack speed and movement speed. On enemy: Polymorph them into a harmless critter that can only move.

abilities.name: Help, Pix!
abilities.summary: On ally: shield them and send Pix to them. On enemy: damage and send Pix to them.
abilities.details: On ally: Shield an ally and attach Pix to them. On enemy: Damage an enemy and attach Pix to them, revealing them.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.summary: Give an ally bonus health and knock up enemies near them.
abilities.details: Lulu enlarges an ally, giving them bonus health and knocking up enemies around them. The ally also slows nearby enemies.

playstyle.identity: Lux is a long-range burst mage with a snare and giant laser ultimate. She excels at catching enemies and one-shotting them from afar.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive marks enemies; auto or R consumes for bonus damage. Q snares up to two enemies. W throws a wand that shields allies on the way out and back. E slows in a zone, reactivate to detonate. R fires a giant laser that procs passive. Q-E-R for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Lux spikes at level 6 with her burst ultimate. Luden's and ability haste reduce R cooldown. She's strong at picks and poke.

passive.name: Illumination
passive.summary: Abilities mark enemies; auto attacks or R consume marks for bonus damage.
passive.details: Lux's abilities mark enemies with light. Her basic attacks or Final Spark consume the mark for bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Light Binding
abilities.summary: Fire a binding that snares up to two enemies.
abilities.details: Lux fires a sphere of light that binds and damages up to two enemies. The second enemy is bound for less time.

abilities.name: Prismatic Barrier
abilities.summary: Throw a wand that shields allies on the way out and back.
abilities.details: Lux throws her wand in a line, shielding allies it passes through. On the way back, it shields again.

abilities.name: Lucent Singularity
abilities.summary: Create a slowing zone; reactivate to detonate for damage.
abilities.details: Lux creates a zone that slows enemies. She can reactivate to detonate it early, or it detonates automatically after a delay.

abilities.name: Final Spark
abilities.summary: Fire a giant laser across the map, consuming Illumination marks.
abilities.details: Lux fires a giant laser in a line, dealing damage and revealing enemies. It triggers Illumination on all enemies hit.

playstyle.identity: Malphite is a rock-solid tank whose ultimate is an unstoppable engage. He excels at teamfighting against AD-heavy teams with his armor stacking.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives a shield that regenerates out of combat. Q steals movement speed. W empowers autos with AoE. E slows attack speed around you. R is an unstoppable knockup dash. Stack armor, press R on grouped enemies, win.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Malphite spikes at level 6 with his engage ultimate. Armor items counter AD teams. He's strong at teamfight engage at all stages.

passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.summary: Gain a shield that regenerates when out of combat.
passive.details: Malphite has a shield equal to a percentage of his max health. The shield regenerates after not taking damage for a while.

abilities.name: Seismic Shard
abilities.summary: Throw a rock that damages and steals movement speed.
abilities.details: Malphite hurls a shard at an enemy, dealing damage, slowing them, and stealing their movement speed.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.summary: Passive: gain armor. Active: empower autos to deal AoE damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Malphite gains bonus armor, tripled while his shield is active. Active: His auto attacks deal bonus AoE damage for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.summary: Slam the ground to damage and slow enemy attack speed.
abilities.details: Malphite slams the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and reducing their attack speed.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.summary: Dash to a location, knocking up all enemies. Unstoppable.
abilities.details: Malphite charges to a target location, dealing damage and knocking up all enemies in the area. This dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.

playstyle.identity: Malzahar is a suppression mage who locks down a single target with his ultimate. He excels at deleting priority targets while his voidlings do extra damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives a spell shield periodically. Q silences in a line. W spawns voidlings that attack nearby targets. E spreads a damage-over-time (resets on kill, spreads to nearby). R suppresses a target while dealing percent health damage. E wave, R priority target.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Malzahar spikes at level 6 with his suppression ultimate. Liandry's burn synergizes with his damage over time. He's strong at picks and objective control.

passive.name: Void Shift
passive.summary: Periodically gain a spell shield that blocks crowd control.
passive.details: After not taking damage for a while, Malzahar gains a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability and crowd control.

abilities.name: Call of the Void
abilities.summary: Open two portals that silence enemies between them.
abilities.details: Malzahar opens two portals that fire after a delay, damaging and silencing enemies between them.

abilities.name: Void Swarm
abilities.summary: Spawn voidlings that attack nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Malzahar spawns a voidling. Voidlings deal more damage to targets affected by Malefic Visions and multiply when they kill units.

abilities.name: Malefic Visions
abilities.summary: Damage over time that spreads to nearby enemies on kill.
abilities.details: Malzahar infects an enemy with visions, dealing damage over time. If the target dies, it spreads to a nearby enemy and restores mana.

abilities.name: Nether Grasp
abilities.summary: Suppress an enemy while dealing percent max health damage.
abilities.details: Malzahar suppresses an enemy champion, dealing percent max health damage over time. He's also rooted during the channel.

playstyle.identity: Maokai is a tanky tree who controls space with saplings and roots entire teams. He excels at zoning with saplings and engaging with his wide ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals on next auto after several spells near you. Q knocks back and slows. W dashes and roots a target (untargetable during). E throws a sapling that chases in brush. R sends a wide root wave across the map. Zone with E, engage with R-W.
