playstyle.powerSpikes: Maokai spikes at level 6 with his team-wide engage. Tank items scale his sustain. He's strong at teamfights and objective control.

passive.name: Sap Magic
passive.summary: After several spells near you, next auto heals Maokai.
passive.details: When several spells are cast near Maokai, his next basic attack heals him for a percentage of his max health.

abilities.name: Bramble Smash
abilities.summary: Smash the ground to knock back, damage, and slow enemies.
abilities.details: Maokai smashes the ground, damaging and slowing enemies in a line. Enemies near him are knocked back.

abilities.name: Twisted Advance
abilities.summary: Dash to a target and root them; untargetable during.
abilities.details: Maokai becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy, dealing damage and rooting them on arrival.

abilities.name: Sapling Toss
abilities.summary: Throw a sapling that chases enemies; deals more damage in brush.
abilities.details: Maokai throws a sapling to a location. It chases nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Saplings placed in brush last longer and deal more damage.

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.summary: Send a wide wave of roots that grows as it travels.
abilities.details: Maokai sends out a massive wall of thorns that slowly advances, rooting and damaging all enemies hit.

playstyle.identity: Master Yi is a reset-based melee carry who becomes untargetable during Q and gains massive attack speed with R. He excels at cleaning up teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: every few autos, strike twice. Q makes you untargetable while bouncing to enemies (reduced CD on auto). W channels to heal and reduce damage. E gives true damage on autos. R gives speed and attack speed, extends on kill. Q to dodge, R for cleanup.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Master Yi spikes with attack speed items and at level 6. Guinsoo's and Kraken make him deadly. He's a late-game hypercarry.

passive.name: Double Strike
passive.summary: Every few attacks, strike twice.
passive.details: Every few basic attacks, Master Yi strikes twice. The second strike deals reduced damage but applies on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Alpha Strike
abilities.summary: Become untargetable and bounce between enemies; cooldown reduced by autos.
abilities.details: Master Yi becomes untargetable, bouncing between enemies and dealing damage. Each auto attack reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Meditate
abilities.summary: Channel to heal and take reduced damage.
abilities.details: Master Yi channels, healing himself and gaining massive damage reduction. Can be cancelled early.

abilities.name: Wuju Style
abilities.summary: Passive: bonus AD. Active: deal true damage on autos for several seconds.
abilities.details: Passive: Gain bonus attack damage. Active: For a few seconds, basic attacks deal bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Highlander
abilities.summary: Gain massive speed and attack speed; duration extends on takedown.
abilities.details: Master Yi gains movement speed, attack speed, and immunity to slows. The duration extends with each takedown.

playstyle.identity: Mel is a strategic enchanter who empowers allies with gold generation and powerful buffs. She excels at enhancing her team's carry potential.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive grants bonus gold on takedowns. Q fires a beam that empowers allies and damages enemies. W creates a zone that buffs allies inside. E tethers to an ally, sharing stats. R provides a massive shield and damage amp to an ally.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Mel spikes at level 6 with her amplifying ultimate. Enchanter items scale her buffs. She's strong when she has a carry to empower.

passive.name: Strategic Advantage
passive.summary: Gain bonus gold from takedowns and assists.
passive.details: Mel generates bonus gold when she or her allies get takedowns nearby.

abilities.name: Piercing Light
abilities.summary: Fire a beam that damages enemies and empowers allies hit.
abilities.details: Mel fires a beam of light that damages enemies and grants allies hit bonus effects.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.summary: Create a zone that buffs allies inside.
abilities.details: Mel creates a protected area that grants allies inside bonus stats and effects.

abilities.name: Tether of Ambition
abilities.summary: Tether to an ally, sharing stats between you.
abilities.details: Mel connects to an allied champion, sharing a portion of stats between them. Breaking the tether triggers bonus effects.

abilities.name: Apex of Power
abilities.summary: Massively shield and empower an ally, amplifying their damage.
abilities.details: Mel empowers an allied champion with a powerful shield and damage amplification, turning them into a deadly threat.

playstyle.identity: Milio is a healing enchanter who cleanses CC from his entire team. He excels at keeping allies alive and mobile with his fire-based buffs.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: allies you buff deal bonus damage. Q fires a ball that knocks back on hit. W enchants an ally with range and attack speed on their next ability. E creates a shield zone around an ally. R cleanses and heals all nearby allies. R to save the whole team from CC.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Milio spikes at level 6 with his team cleanse ultimate. Enchanter items scale his healing. He's strong at protecting teams.

passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.summary: Allies you buff deal bonus magic damage.
passive.details: When Milio buffs an ally, their next attack or ability deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
abilities.summary: Kick a ball that knocks back enemies and stuns against terrain.
abilities.details: Milio kicks a fireball that bounces off the first enemy hit, knocking them back. If they hit terrain, they're stunned.

abilities.name: Cozy Campfire
abilities.summary: Create a zone that heals allies inside.
abilities.details: Milio creates a healing zone that follows a nearby ally. Allies inside are healed over time.

abilities.name: Warm Hugs
abilities.summary: Shield an ally and grant them bonus attack range.
abilities.details: Milio shields an ally and grants them bonus attack range and movement speed.

abilities.name: Breath of Life
abilities.summary: Cleanse all crowd control from nearby allies and heal them.
abilities.details: Milio releases a wave that removes all crowd control from nearby allied champions and heals them.

playstyle.identity: Miss Fortune is an AoE ADC whose ultimate channels massive damage in a cone. She excels at teamfighting and poking with her bouncing Q.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: first auto on a target deals bonus damage. Q bounces to a second target (crits if first target dies). W gives attack speed and speed out of combat. E creates a slow zone. R channels a barrage of bullets in a cone. Position well, R into grouped enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Miss Fortune spikes at level 6 with her teamfight ultimate. Lethality or crit scale her. She's strong at AoE damage.

passive.name: Love Tap
passive.summary: First auto on each target deals bonus damage.
passive.details: Miss Fortune's first basic attack against a target deals bonus damage. Switching targets maximizes her damage.

abilities.name: Double Up
abilities.summary: Fire a shot that bounces; second hit crits if first target dies.
abilities.details: Miss Fortune fires a shot that bounces to an enemy behind the first. If the first target dies, the second hit critically strikes.

abilities.name: Strut
abilities.summary: Passive: gain movement speed when not hit. Active: gain attack speed.
abilities.details: Passive: Miss Fortune gains movement speed after not taking damage. Active: Gain attack speed and movement speed.

abilities.name: Make It Rain
abilities.summary: Rain bullets in an area that slows and damages enemies.
abilities.details: Miss Fortune fires a barrage of bullets at a location, dealing damage over time and slowing enemies.

abilities.name: Bullet Time
abilities.summary: Channel a barrage of bullets in a cone, dealing massive damage.
abilities.details: Miss Fortune channels, firing waves of bullets in a cone. Each wave can critically strike. She's rooted during the channel.

playstyle.identity: Mordekaiser is a juggernaut who drags enemies into his Death Realm for 1v1s. He excels at isolating and killing key targets with his steal-their-stats ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: abilities deal AoE damage around you when active. Q slams, isolated targets take more damage. W stores damage to shield/heal. E pulls enemies toward you. R drags one enemy to Death Realm, stealing their stats. Ult the carry, 1v1 them, win.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Mordekaiser spikes at level 6 with his 1v1 ultimate. Riftmaker sustains through fights. He's strong at isolating and killing anyone.

passive.name: Darkness Rise
passive.summary: After 3 abilities/autos, deal AoE damage and gain speed.
passive.details: After damaging enemies with 3 attacks or abilities, Mordekaiser gains movement speed and deals magic damage per second around him.

abilities.name: Obliterate
abilities.summary: Slam the ground; deals more damage to isolated targets.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser slams his mace, dealing damage in an area. If it hits only one enemy champion, the damage is increased.

abilities.name: Indestructible
abilities.summary: Store damage taken; activate to shield. Reactivate to heal.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser stores damage dealt and taken. Activate to consume the store as a shield. Reactivate to consume the shield to heal.

abilities.name: Death's Grasp
abilities.summary: Pull enemies in a direction toward you.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in a target direction toward him, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: Realm of Death
abilities.summary: Drag an enemy into Death Realm for a 1v1; steal their stats.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser banishes an enemy to Death Realm with him, stealing a portion of their stats. If they die in the realm, he keeps the stats until they respawn.

playstyle.identity: Morgana is a binding mage/support with the longest CC in the game. Her Black Shield blocks magic damage and CC entirely, protecting allies from being locked down.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a 3-second root on a single target. W creates a damage pool (heals against champions). E black shields an ally, making them CC immune. R tethers to nearby enemies, stunning after the duration. Q to catch, E to protect, R for teamfight stuns.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Morgana spikes at level 6 with her teamfight ultimate. Zhonya's lets her R safely. She's strong at picks and protection.

passive.name: Soul Siphon
passive.summary: Heal based on damage dealt to champions.
passive.details: Morgana heals for a percentage of the damage she deals to champions, large minions, and monsters.

abilities.name: Dark Binding
abilities.summary: Fire a binding that roots for up to 3 seconds.
abilities.details: Morgana fires a bolt that roots the first enemy hit for a long duration, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: Tormented Shadow
abilities.summary: Create a damage pool that heals you against champions.
abilities.details: Morgana creates a cursed ground that damages enemies inside. She heals based on damage dealt to champions, large minions, and monsters.

abilities.name: Black Shield
abilities.summary: Shield an ally from magic damage and crowd control.
abilities.details: Morgana shields an ally, absorbing magic damage and making them immune to crowd control until the shield breaks.

abilities.name: Soul Shackles
abilities.summary: Tether to nearby enemies; after 3 seconds, stun those still tethered.
abilities.details: Morgana chains herself to nearby enemies, dealing damage and slowing them. After 3 seconds, enemies still tethered are stunned and take additional damage.

champions.name: Naafiri
champions.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites

playstyle.identity: Naafiri is a pack-hunting assassin with the simplest kit among assassins. Her dogs assist her attacks and she excels at running down isolated targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive spawns packmates that attack with you. Q is a skillshot that bleeds (recast to dash to bleeding targets). W sends dogs forward to reveal and damage. E dashes through terrain. R makes dogs respawn faster and gives bonus speed.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Naafiri spikes at level 6 with her hunting ultimate. Prowler's Claw or Eclipse work well. She's strong mid-game as a simple, effective assassin.

strengths: Good roaming with E terrain dash

passive.name: We Are More
passive.summary: Packmates spawn and attack with you; heal when they spawn.
passive.details: Naafiri creates packmates that attack alongside her. They spawn periodically and can be killed. Spawning packmates heals Naafiri.

abilities.name: Darkin Daggers
abilities.summary: Throw daggers that bleed; recast to dash to bleeding targets.
abilities.details: Naafiri throws daggers that damage and bleed enemies. Recast to dash to any bleeding champion, dealing bonus damage if they're still bleeding.

abilities.name: Hounds' Pursuit
abilities.summary: Send packmates forward to reveal enemies and dash to the first champion hit.
abilities.details: Naafiri sends her packmates in a direction. They reveal and damage the first champion hit, and Naafiri dashes to them.

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.summary: Dash through terrain, damaging enemies and healing packmates.
abilities.details: Naafiri dashes in a direction, passing through thin terrain. Damages enemies and restores health to packmates.

abilities.name: The Call of the Pack
abilities.summary: Gain speed, vision, and faster packmate respawns. First champion hit takes bonus damage.
abilities.details: Naafiri howls, gaining movement speed and creating new packmates. She gains vision of nearby enemies and bonus damage on her first champion hit.

champions.name: Nami
champions.title: the Tidecaller

playstyle.identity: Nami is a versatile enchanter who enhances allies while disrupting enemies. Her bubble and wave provide catch potential alongside her healing and buffs.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives movement speed to allies hit by abilities. Q is a bubble knockup (hard to land). W bounces between allies (heals) and enemies (damages). E buffs an ally's autos with slow and damage. R is a tidal wave that knocks up and slows.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nami spikes at level 6 with her engage wave. Moonstone or Shurelya's amplify her kit. She's strong throughout with her utility.

strengths: Healing and damage in one spell
weaknesses: Q bubble is hard to land

passive.name: Surging Tides
passive.summary: Allies hit by your abilities gain movement speed.
passive.details: Allies touched by Nami's abilities gain bonus movement speed for a short duration.

abilities.name: Aqua Prison
abilities.summary: Throw a bubble that knocks up and stuns enemies.
abilities.details: Nami sends a bubble that knocks up all enemies in the area, stunning them for a short duration.

abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
abilities.summary: Bounce between allies (heals) and enemies (damages).
abilities.details: Nami sends a stream of water that bounces between allies and enemies, healing allies and damaging enemies up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
abilities.summary: Buff an ally's autos to deal bonus damage and slow.
abilities.details: Nami empowers an ally's auto attacks with bonus magic damage and a slow for their next few attacks.

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.summary: Send a massive wave that knocks up and slows enemies.
abilities.details: Nami summons a tidal wave that travels in a direction, knocking up enemies and slowing them. Grows wider as it travels.

champions.name: Nasus
champions.title: the Curator of the Sands

playstyle.identity: Nasus is an infinite-scaling juggernaut who farms Q stacks to become unstoppable. He's weak early but becomes a late-game raid boss who two-shots towers and champions.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is an auto reset that stacks permanently on kill (+3 normally, +12 on large monsters/champions). W slows attack and movement speed massively. E shreds armor in an area. R gives health, size, and armor/MR. Farm Q, scale, then win.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nasus spikes around 200-300 stacks when he threatens kills. Divine Sunderer gives him damage. He's a late-game hypercarry who needs to survive early.

strengths: W is strongest slow in game

passive.name: Soul Eater
passive.summary: Gain lifesteal that scales with level.
passive.details: Nasus has bonus lifesteal that increases at certain levels.

abilities.name: Siphoning Strike
abilities.summary: Auto reset that permanently stacks damage on kill.
abilities.details: Nasus empowers his next auto attack with bonus damage. If it kills, he gains permanent stacks (+3 normal, +12 large enemies/champions).

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.summary: Massively slow an enemy's movement and attack speed.
abilities.details: Nasus ages an enemy champion, slowing their movement and attack speed dramatically over several seconds.

abilities.name: Spirit Fire
abilities.summary: Create a zone that shreds armor and damages enemies.
abilities.details: Nasus creates a zone that deals initial damage and reduces the armor of enemies inside while dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: Fury of the Sands
abilities.summary: Gain health, size, armor/MR, and bonus Q damage over time.
abilities.details: Nasus transforms, gaining bonus health, armor, magic resist, and size. He also deals percent health damage around him and Q gains bonus damage.

playstyle.identity: Nautilus is a CC machine support with a hook, root, and knockup. He has the most crowd control of any champion and excels at locking down single targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive roots the first target you auto (per target cooldown). Q hooks to terrain or enemies. W is a shield that adds damage. E slows around you. R sends a shockwave that knocks up everyone in its path, then the target. Q-auto-E-R for full lockdown.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nautilus spikes at level 2-3 with his all-in CC. Level 6 adds guaranteed lockdown with R. He's strong throughout as a CC bot.

passive.name: Staggering Blow
passive.summary: First auto on each target roots them. Cooldown per target.
passive.details: Nautilus's first basic attack against a target roots them briefly and deals bonus damage. Has a cooldown per target.

abilities.name: Dredge Line
abilities.summary: Fire a hook; pull yourself to terrain or pull enemies to you.
abilities.details: Nautilus fires his anchor. If it hits terrain, he pulls himself there. If it hits an enemy, he pulls them together, meeting in the middle.

abilities.name: Titan's Wrath
abilities.summary: Shield yourself and deal bonus damage while the shield holds.
abilities.details: Nautilus surrounds himself with a shield. While the shield holds, his auto attacks deal bonus damage over time.

abilities.name: Riptide
abilities.summary: Create waves around you that slow enemies.
abilities.details: Nautilus creates waves that ripple outward, dealing damage and slowing enemies hit.

abilities.name: Depth Charge
abilities.summary: Send a shockwave that knocks up enemies in its path and the target.
abilities.details: Nautilus sends a shockwave that chases an enemy, knocking up all enemies it passes through. On reaching the target, they're knocked up and stunned.

playstyle.identity: Neeko is a deceptive burst mage who can disguise as allies. Her clone and camouflage create mind games while her ultimate provides devastating teamfight engage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive lets you disguise as an ally champion. Q blooms through minions (3 blooms on champions/large monsters). W sends a clone and makes you briefly invisible. E roots through targets (longer root through more). R jumps and stuns in an area after charging.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Neeko spikes at level 6 with her teamfight ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. She's strong mid-game with surprise R engages.

passive.name: Inherent Glamour
passive.summary: Disguise as an allied champion.
passive.details: Neeko can take the appearance of any allied champion. Taking damage or using abilities reveals her.

abilities.name: Blooming Burst
abilities.summary: Throw a bloom that explodes up to 3 times on champions or large monsters.
abilities.details: Neeko throws a seed that blooms, dealing damage. If it hits a champion or large monster, it blooms again up to twice more.

abilities.name: Shapesplitter
abilities.summary: Send out a clone and briefly become invisible.
abilities.details: Passive: Every third auto deals bonus magic damage. Active: Neeko sends a clone in a direction while she briefly becomes invisible and gains movement speed.

abilities.name: Tangle-Barbs
abilities.summary: Fire roots that grow stronger passing through enemies.
abilities.details: Neeko fires a tangle of roots. The first enemy hit is rooted; subsequent enemies are rooted for longer.

abilities.name: Pop Blossom
abilities.summary: Charge up then leap, stunning all nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Neeko channels, gaining a shield. After channeling, she leaps into the air and crashes down, dealing damage and stunning all nearby enemies.

playstyle.identity: Nidalee is a poke-focused jungler with two forms. Her spears chunk enemies from range, then she transforms to execute in cougar form.
playstyle.howToPlay: Human: Q is a long-range spear (more damage at range). W is a trap that reveals. E heals an ally. Cougar: Q is an execute (bonus on hunted targets). W pounces. E swipes. Hit spear to mark hunted, then all-in with cougar form.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nidalee spikes early - she's strongest levels 3-6 and snowballs hard. AP items scale her poke. She falls off if she doesn't get early leads.

passive.name: Prowl
passive.summary: Move faster in brush; hitting spear or trap marks enemies as Hunted.
passive.details: Nidalee gains movement speed in brush. Enemies hit by Javelin Toss or Bushwhack are marked Hunted, giving Nidalee movement speed toward them and enhanced cougar abilities.

abilities.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
abilities.summary: Human: long-range spear. Cougar: execute bite.
abilities.details: Human: Throw a spear that deals more damage at range. Cougar: Bite a target for damage that increases based on their missing health. Enhanced against Hunted.

abilities.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
abilities.summary: Human: place a trap. Cougar: pounce forward.
abilities.details: Human: Place an invisible trap that damages and marks enemies. Cougar: Pounce forward, dealing damage on landing. Enhanced pounce toward Hunted targets.

abilities.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
abilities.summary: Human: heal an ally. Cougar: swipe in front.
abilities.details: Human: Heal an ally and grant them attack speed. Cougar: Swipe in front dealing AoE damage.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Cougar
abilities.summary: Transform between human and cougar forms.
abilities.details: Nidalee transforms between human and cougar form, gaining new abilities in each form. Available at level 1.

playstyle.identity: Nilah is a melee ADC who shares bonus XP with her support. She has incredible sustain and can dodge abilities with her mist, scaling into a late-game monster.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive shares XP and amplifies healing/shielding from allies. Q empowers autos with range and cleave. W creates a mist that dodges autos. E dashes through targets. R pulls enemies in and damages/heals. Play aggressively with W protection.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nilah spikes faster than other ADCs due to shared XP. Infinity Edge and crit scale her. She's a late-game hypercarry who outlevels opponents.

passive.name: Joy Unending
passive.summary: Share bonus XP with support; amplify healing and shielding received.
passive.details: When Nilah last-hits minions, she and her nearest ally gain additional experience. She also amplifies healing and shielding from allies.

abilities.name: Formless Blade
abilities.summary: Empower autos to cleave and gain range.
abilities.details: Passive: Nilah's Q and autos heal her, amplified on crit. Active: Nilah whips her blade, gaining bonus range and causing attacks to deal damage in a cone.

abilities.name: Jubilant Veil
abilities.summary: Create a mist that dodges auto attacks.
abilities.details: Nilah shrouds herself in mist, gaining movement speed and causing auto attacks against her to miss. Can touch an ally to share the effect.

abilities.name: Slipstream
abilities.summary: Dash through a target, damaging enemies passed.
abilities.details: Nilah dashes through a target unit, dealing damage to enemies she passes through. Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Apotheosis
abilities.summary: Pull enemies in, deal damage, and heal based on damage dealt.
abilities.details: Nilah whirls her blade, pulling nearby enemies toward her center and dealing damage. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt.

playstyle.identity: Nocturne is a diving assassin whose ultimate blinds the entire enemy team while he dashes to a target. His global darkness creates fear even before he engages.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q throws shadow and gives movement speed on the trail. W is a spell shield that also gives attack speed on block. E fears after a tether. R darkens the map (no ally vision) and lets you dash to any visible enemy champion.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nocturne spikes at level 6 with his global engage. Stridebreaker or lethality builds work. He's strong mid-game at diving backlines.

passive.name: Umbra Blades
passive.summary: Periodically, autos cleave and heal Nocturne.
passive.details: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next auto attack deals damage to nearby enemies and heals him. Cooldown reduced by auto attacks.

abilities.name: Duskbringer
abilities.summary: Throw a shadow blade that leaves a trail granting speed and AD.
abilities.details: Nocturne throws a shadow blade, damaging enemies and leaving a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne gains bonus AD and movement speed.

abilities.name: Shroud of Darkness
abilities.summary: Passive: gain attack speed. Active: spell shield that gives more attack speed on block.
abilities.details: Passive: Nocturne gains bonus attack speed. Active: Create a spell shield that blocks the next ability. If it blocks something, gain doubled attack speed.

abilities.name: Unspeakable Horror
abilities.summary: Tether to an enemy; if it holds, fear them.
abilities.details: Nocturne creates a tether to an enemy, dealing damage. If the tether isn't broken, the target is feared.

abilities.name: Paranoia
abilities.summary: Darken the map and gain the ability to dash to any visible enemy champion.
abilities.details: Nocturne reduces enemy vision radius and removes ally vision. He can then recast to dash to an enemy champion in range.

playstyle.identity: Nunu & Willump is a ganking jungler with a giant snowball engage. He excels at objective control with his consume and creates early pressure with constant ganks.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q bites for massive damage and healing (true damage to monsters - use for smite fights). W charges a snowball that grows and knocks up. E throws snowballs that root after 3 hits. R channels a massive AoE slow and damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Nunu spikes early with snowball ganks. Level 6 adds R for teamfights. He's strong early-mid with objective control and ganks.

passive.name: Call of the Freljord
passive.summary: Nearby ally gains attack and movement speed; Willump's autos also damage nearby enemies.
passive.details: A nearby ally gains bonus attack speed and movement speed. Willump's basic attacks also damage enemies near his target.

abilities.name: Consume
abilities.summary: Bite a target for damage and healing; deals true damage to monsters.
abilities.details: Willump bites an enemy, dealing damage and healing Nunu. Against monsters, it deals true damage and has bonus healing.

abilities.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
abilities.summary: Roll a growing snowball that knocks up enemies.
abilities.details: Willump rolls a snowball that grows and speeds up over time. Hitting enemies or terrain causes it to explode, dealing damage and knocking up.

abilities.name: Snowball Barrage
abilities.summary: Throw snowballs; at 3 hits, root the target.
abilities.details: Nunu throws snowballs at nearby enemies. After throwing all snowballs, enemies hit 3 times are rooted.

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.summary: Channel to slow enemies; deals massive damage at the end.
abilities.details: Nunu & Willump channel, creating a blizzard that slows enemies. After channeling (or when cancelled), it deals massive damage based on channel time.

playstyle.identity: Olaf is an unstoppable berserker who becomes immune to CC during his ultimate. He runs down enemies with axes and lifesteal, getting stronger as he gets lower.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives attack speed based on missing health. Q throws an axe (pick up to reduce cooldown). W gives attack speed and healing. E deals true damage (costs health). R makes you immune to CC and gives movement speed toward enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Olaf spikes early with his dueling power and at 6 with CC immunity. Goredrinker and Death's Dance keep him alive. He falls off late but dominates early-mid.

passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.summary: Gain attack speed based on missing health.
passive.details: Olaf gains bonus attack speed for each percent of health he's missing.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.summary: Throw an axe that slows; pick it up to reduce cooldown.
abilities.details: Olaf throws an axe that damages and slows enemies. Picking up the axe significantly reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Vicious Strikes
abilities.summary: Gain attack speed and healing amplification.
abilities.details: Olaf gains bonus attack speed and his attacks heal him. Healing is increased based on missing health.

abilities.name: Reckless Swing
abilities.summary: Deal true damage to an enemy; costs health.
abilities.details: Olaf deals true damage to an enemy at the cost of his own health. If it kills, he refunds the health cost.

abilities.name: Ragnarok
abilities.summary: Become immune to CC and gain movement speed toward enemies.
abilities.details: Olaf removes all CC and becomes immune to crowd control. He gains bonus AD and movement speed toward enemy champions for the duration.

playstyle.identity: Orianna is a zone control mage who commands a ball for positioning-based damage. Her ultimate can single-handedly win teamfights with a well-placed shockwave.
playstyle.howToPlay: The Ball is central to her kit - all abilities originate from it. Q moves the ball (damages). W speeds allies or slows enemies at ball. E shields an ally and moves ball to them. R pulls everyone near the ball to its center. Attach ball to a diver for surprise R.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Orianna spikes at level 6 with her teamfight R. Luden's or Liandry's scale her damage. She's strong at all stages with consistent damage and utility.

passive.name: Clockwork Windup
passive.summary: Auto attacks deal bonus magic damage, stacking on the same target.
passive.details: Orianna's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage that increases when hitting the same target consecutively.

abilities.name: Command: Attack
abilities.summary: Move the ball to a location, damaging enemies passed.
abilities.details: Orianna commands the ball to travel to a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and at the destination.

abilities.name: Command: Dissonance
abilities.summary: The ball emits a pulse that speeds allies and slows enemies.
abilities.details: Orianna commands the ball to release an electric pulse, dealing damage, slowing enemies, and speeding allies in the area.

abilities.name: Command: Protect
abilities.summary: Shield an ally and move the ball to them.
abilities.details: Passive: The ball grants bonus armor and MR to whoever it's attached to. Active: Shield an ally and attach the ball to them.

abilities.name: Command: Shockwave
abilities.summary: Pull all enemies near the ball to its center.
abilities.details: Orianna commands the ball to unleash a shockwave, pulling all nearby enemies toward the ball and dealing damage.

playstyle.identity: Ornn is a forging tank who upgrades ally items in late game. His brittle mechanic adds massive CC, and his ultimate is a huge team fight engage tool.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive lets you build items in lane and upgrade ally mythics late. Q creates a pillar. W breathes fire, making enemies brittle (next CC knocks them up). E dashes and knocks up if you hit terrain/pillar. R sends a ram you can recast to redirect for a knockup.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ornn spikes at level 13+ when he can upgrade items. His trading is strong at level 1-3. He's a late-game scaling tank with incredible teamfight.

passive.name: Living Forge
passive.summary: Forge items anywhere; upgrade ally items at level 13+.
passive.details: Ornn can forge non-consumable items anywhere. At level 13+, he can upgrade one ally's mythic item into an improved version. He gets one more upgrade at later levels.

abilities.name: Volcanic Rupture
abilities.summary: Create a fissure that erupts into a pillar of rock.
abilities.details: Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure that damages and slows. After a delay, a pillar erupts at the end. The pillar is terrain.

abilities.name: Bellows Breath
abilities.summary: Breathe fire; the final flame makes enemies brittle.
abilities.details: Ornn becomes unstoppable and breathes fire, dealing damage. The last tick makes enemies brittle - the next CC knocks them up.

abilities.name: Searing Charge
abilities.summary: Dash; if you hit terrain, create a shockwave that knocks up.
abilities.details: Ornn charges forward, dealing damage. If he hits terrain (including his pillar), he creates a shockwave that knocks up nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Call of the Forge God
abilities.summary: Summon a ram; recast to headbutt it, knocking up enemies.
abilities.details: Ornn summons a ram that travels in a direction, slowing enemies. Recast to headbutt the ram, redirecting it and knocking up all enemies hit.

playstyle.identity: Pantheon is an early-game diver with point-and-click engage and tower diving potential. His shield blocks all damage from one direction, and his ultimate is semi-global.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers abilities at 5 stacks. Q taps for poke, hold for execute. W point-and-click stun and leap. E blocks all frontal damage (empowered E does damage). R drops you across the map. Snowball early before falling off.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Pantheon spikes at levels 2-3 and at 6 for roams. Eclipse or lethality work. He's strongest early-mid and falls off late.

passive.name: Mortal Will
passive.summary: At 5 stacks, next ability is empowered.
passive.details: Pantheon gains a stack when attacking or using abilities. At 5 stacks, his next basic ability is empowered.

abilities.name: Comet Spear
abilities.summary: Tap for quick thrust; hold to throw for execute damage.
abilities.details: Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear. Hold: He throws it, dealing increased damage and execute damage to low-health targets. Empowered: Deals more damage.

abilities.name: Shield Vault
abilities.summary: Point-and-click leap that stuns the target.
abilities.details: Pantheon leaps to an enemy, dealing damage and stunning them. Empowered: Also follows up with 3 auto attacks.

abilities.name: Aegis Assault
abilities.summary: Block all damage from one direction; slam at the end.
abilities.details: Pantheon braces, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front. He slams his shield at the end. Empowered: Extends duration.

abilities.name: Grand Starfall
abilities.summary: Leap and crash down at a semi-global range.
abilities.details: Pantheon channels then leaps into the air, landing at a target location after a delay. Enemies in the center take more damage.

champions.name: Poppy
champions.title: Keeper of the Hammer

playstyle.identity: Poppy is an anti-dash tank who shuts down mobile champions. Her W stops all dashes, and she can knock enemies into walls for massive damage and stun.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive throws your buckler for ranged auto and shield. Q slams twice and slows. W gives armor/MR and creates a zone that stops dashes (grounds and damages). E charges and stuns against terrain. R charges a knockup that sends enemies far away.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Poppy spikes against dash-heavy comps. Sunfire and tank items make her durable. She counters assassins and divers throughout the game.

strengths: R can remove enemies from fights
weaknesses: Falls off late without mobility to counter

passive.name: Iron Ambassador
passive.summary: Periodically, throw your buckler for ranged auto and gain a shield.
passive.details: Every few seconds, Poppy throws her buckler as a ranged attack that grants her a shield. The buckler bounces to the ground and can be picked up.

abilities.name: Hammer Shock
abilities.summary: Slam the ground twice, slowing enemies.
abilities.details: Poppy smashes the ground, dealing damage and slowing. After a delay, the area erupts again for additional damage.

abilities.name: Steadfast Presence
abilities.summary: Gain resistances; activate to create a zone that stops dashes.
abilities.details: Passive: Gain bonus armor and magic resist, doubled when low. Active: Create a zone that grounds and damages enemies who try to dash.

abilities.name: Heroic Charge
abilities.summary: Charge an enemy; stun if they hit terrain.
abilities.details: Poppy charges at an enemy, carrying them forward. If they hit terrain, they take bonus damage and are stunned.

abilities.name: Keeper's Verdict
abilities.summary: Charge a knockup that sends enemies flying away.
abilities.details: Tap: Knock up enemies in front. Hold: Charge up to send enemies flying much further away. Enemies land where they started if uncharged.

playstyle.identity: Pyke is an assassin support who shares kill gold with allies. His hook, stun, and execute ultimate make him a roaming threat who can snowball his entire team.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive converts bonus health to AD and heals when unseen. Q taps for stab, holds for hook. W goes invisible and gains speed. E dashes leaving a phantom that stuns. R executes below threshold and can be recast, giving gold to assisting allies too.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Pyke spikes at level 6 with his execute ultimate. Lethality items scale his damage. He's strong roaming mid-game to spread gold across the team.

passive.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
passive.summary: Convert bonus health to AD; heal when unseen after taking damage.
passive.details: Pyke cannot gain bonus health; it's converted to AD instead. When he takes damage, he stores it as grey health and heals when out of enemy sight.

abilities.name: Bone Skewer
abilities.summary: Tap for stab; hold to throw a hook that pulls enemies.
abilities.details: Tap: Pyke stabs forward, damaging and slowing. Hold: He throws his harpoon, pulling the first enemy hit toward him.

abilities.name: Ghostwater Dive
abilities.summary: Become camouflaged and gain movement speed.
abilities.details: Pyke enters camouflage and gains movement speed that decays over time. Being near enemies reveals him.

abilities.name: Phantom Undertow
abilities.summary: Dash and leave a phantom that stuns enemies when it returns.
abilities.details: Pyke dashes, leaving behind a phantom. The phantom returns to Pyke after a delay, stunning enemies it passes through.

abilities.name: Death from Below
abilities.summary: Execute enemies below threshold; can recast and shares kill gold.
abilities.details: Pyke blinks to a location and executes enemies below a health threshold. If it kills, he can recast within seconds. Allies who assisted also get full kill gold.

playstyle.identity: Qiyana is an AD assassin who uses terrain elements for different effects. Her ultimate shockwaves off walls, making her devastating in jungle fights and river.
playstyle.howToPlay: W dashes and picks up an element: Brush (invisible), River (root), Wall (bonus damage). Q throws element with effect. E dashes through target. R blasts enemies into terrain, stunning and dealing massive damage. Fight near walls for best R.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Qiyana spikes at level 3 with element combos and 6 with her teamfight R. Prowler's Claw enables assassinations. She's strong mid-game in terrain-heavy areas.

passive.name: Royal Privilege
passive.summary: First ability or attack on each enemy deals bonus damage.
passive.details: Qiyana's first attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage. Has a cooldown per target.

abilities.name: Edge of Ixtal
abilities.summary: Slash in a direction; enchanted Q has different effects by element.
abilities.details: Qiyana slashes in a direction. If she has an element, the slash has bonus effects: River roots, Wall deals bonus damage to low health, Grass makes her invisible.

abilities.name: Terrashape
abilities.summary: Dash toward terrain and enchant your weapon with an element.
abilities.details: Qiyana dashes toward terrain, gaining an element enchantment and bonus attack speed and movement speed near that terrain type.

abilities.name: Audacity
abilities.summary: Dash through a target, dealing damage.
abilities.details: Qiyana dashes to a target enemy, dealing damage. Can cast Q during the dash.

abilities.name: Supreme Display of Talent
abilities.summary: Create a shockwave that detonates on terrain, stunning enemies.
abilities.details: Qiyana creates a windblast that knocks back enemies. The blast detonates off terrain (walls, brush, river), dealing massive damage and stunning enemies caught.

playstyle.identity: Quinn is a roaming marksman who transforms into a high-speed bird for map mobility. She bullies melee tops and then roams to impact other lanes.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive marks enemies - hitting marks deals bonus damage. Q blinds and marks. W reveals area and gives attack speed near marked targets. E vaults off target, slowing and marking them. R transforms to Valor for massive speed (can't attack), recast to exit and deal damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Quinn spikes at level 6 with roaming ultimate. Lethality or crit builds work. She's a lane bully who uses R to impact the map.

passive.name: Harrier
passive.summary: Valor marks enemies; attacking marks deals bonus damage.
passive.details: Periodically, Valor marks a nearby enemy as Vulnerable. Attacking a Vulnerable target deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Blinding Assault
abilities.summary: Fire a projectile that blinds and marks the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Quinn fires a projectile that damages and blinds the first enemy hit, causing their auto attacks to miss. The target is also marked.

abilities.name: Heightened Senses
abilities.summary: Passive: gain attack speed near marked targets. Active: reveal a large area.
abilities.details: Passive: Attacking a marked target grants Quinn attack speed. Active: Valor reveals a large area around Quinn.

abilities.name: Vault
abilities.summary: Dash to a target, slow them, mark them, and bounce off.
abilities.details: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing damage, slowing them, and bouncing back while marking them as Vulnerable.

abilities.name: Behind Enemy Lines
abilities.summary: Transform into Valor for massive speed; can't attack until cancelled.
abilities.details: Quinn channels briefly then transforms into Valor, gaining massive movement speed but unable to attack. Recast or take action to exit, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

champions.name: Rakan
champions.title: The Charmer

playstyle.identity: Rakan is a flashy engage support who dashes in, charms enemies, and dashes out. He synergizes especially well with Xayah and excels at initiating teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives a shield periodically. Q pokes and heals on return. W dashes and knocks up (short delay). E dashes to allies twice (longer range to Xayah). R gives speed and charms first enemy touched for each target. W-R combo for engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Rakan spikes at level 6 with his charm engage. Mobility boots help engage. He's strong at all stages with his engage and peel flexibility.

weaknesses: E needs allies to dash to

passive.name: Fey Feathers
passive.summary: Gain a damage-absorbing shield periodically.
passive.details: Rakan periodically gains a shield. Touching an allied champion reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Gleaming Quill
abilities.summary: Fire a feather; if it hits, heal after it returns or touching an ally.
abilities.details: Rakan flings a magical feather that deals damage. If it hits an enemy champion, he heals himself and nearby allies when the feather returns or when he touches an ally.

abilities.name: Grand Entrance
abilities.summary: Dash to a location and knock up enemies after a short delay.
abilities.details: Rakan dashes to a location. After a brief delay, he knocks up nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Battle Dance
abilities.summary: Dash to an ally and shield them; can cast twice.
abilities.details: Rakan dashes to an ally champion, shielding them. Can be cast again within a few seconds. Has longer range toward Xayah.

abilities.name: The Quickness
abilities.summary: Gain speed and charm the first enemy touched per enemy champion.
abilities.details: Rakan gains a burst of movement speed and charms and damages the first enemy champion he touches. He can charm each enemy once per cast.

playstyle.identity: Rammus is an anti-AD tank who taunts enemies and reflects their damage back. His ball form lets him roll across the map for ganks and engages.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive deals damage based on armor. Q rolls into a ball, gaining speed and knocking up first target. W makes you take reduced damage but slows you (reflects autos). E taunts and shreds armor. R creates an earthquake that slows and damages.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Rammus spikes against AD-heavy teams. Thornmail makes him deadly to auto-attackers. He's a counter-pick tank rather than a blind pick.

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.summary: Basic attacks deal bonus damage based on armor.
passive.details: Rammus's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage based on his armor.

abilities.name: Powerball
abilities.summary: Roll into a ball, gaining speed and knocking up the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Rammus rolls into a ball, accelerating over time. Hitting an enemy knocks them up and deals damage. He can cast other abilities while rolling.

abilities.name: Defensive Ball Curl
abilities.summary: Curl up to reduce damage taken and reflect auto attack damage; slows you.
abilities.details: Rammus curls into a ball, gaining bonus armor and magic resist and reflecting damage from auto attacks. He is slowed while curled.

abilities.name: Frenzying Taunt
abilities.summary: Taunt an enemy and shred their armor.
abilities.details: Rammus taunts a target enemy, forcing them to attack him while reducing their armor.

abilities.name: Soaring Slam
abilities.summary: Leap and create an earthquake that slows and damages enemies.
abilities.details: Rammus leaps into the air and slams down, dealing damage and creating an earthquake zone that damages and slows enemies.

playstyle.identity: Rek'Sai is an aggressive early-game jungler who burrows underground. She detects enemies through tremors and excels at ganking and invading.
playstyle.howToPlay: Burrowed: Q launches a skillshot. W unburrows with a knockup. E creates a tunnel. Passive senses enemy movement. Unburrowed: Q bites 3 times. W burrows. E does damage (true damage when fury full). R dashes to marked enemy anywhere on map.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Rek'Sai spikes early with her ganking and invading. Prowler's Claw or Eclipse work. She's strongest early-mid and falls off late.

passive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
passive.summary: Gain fury from attacks; burrowing converts fury to healing.
passive.details: Rek'Sai generates fury when she attacks. While burrowed, she consumes fury to heal. She also senses nearby enemy movement through the ground.

abilities.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
abilities.summary: Unburrowed: 3 empowered bites. Burrowed: fire a skillshot.
abilities.details: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai's next 3 attacks deal bonus damage. Burrowed: She fires a bolt that reveals the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
abilities.summary: Toggle burrow; unburrowing knocks up nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Toggle between burrowed and unburrowed. Unburrowing knocks up nearby enemies. While burrowed, gain movement speed and tremor sense.

abilities.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
abilities.summary: Unburrowed: bite for damage (true damage at max fury). Burrowed: create a tunnel.
abilities.details: Unburrowed: Bite an enemy for damage that increases with fury. At max fury, deals true damage. Burrowed: Create a tunnel between two locations.

abilities.name: Void Rush
abilities.summary: Mark enemies you damage; dash to any marked enemy globally.
abilities.details: Passive: Damaging enemies marks them. Active: Become untargetable and dash to a marked enemy champion anywhere on the map.

playstyle.identity: Rell is an armored engage support who steals resistances and magnetizes enemies together. Her mount forms give her different engage and teamfight profiles.
playstyle.howToPlay: Mounted: W crashes down, dismounts, and stuns. Dismounted: slow but tanky, W remounts with a shield. Q pierces and steals resistances. E binds to an ally (break binding to stun). R pulls enemies toward you. Crash in, R to group enemies, E to stun.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Rell spikes at level 6 with her grouping ultimate. Tank items make her durable. She's strong in teamfights when she can group multiple enemies.

passive.name: Break the Mold
passive.summary: Attacks steal armor and MR from enemies.
passive.details: Rell's attacks deal bonus damage and steal armor and magic resist from the target, adding it to her own.

abilities.name: Shattering Strike
abilities.summary: Stab through enemies, stealing resistances and destroying shields.
abilities.details: Rell thrusts her lance, damaging enemies in a line, destroying shields, and stealing armor and MR.

abilities.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down / Mount Up
abilities.summary: Mounted: crash down to stun. Dismounted: remount and shield.
abilities.details: Mounted (Crash Down): Leap and crash, knocking up enemies and dismounting (slower but tankier). Dismounted (Mount Up): Remount and gain a shield.

abilities.name: Attract and Repel
abilities.summary: Bind to an ally; recast to stun enemies between you.
abilities.details: Rell binds to an ally. Recast or break the tether to stun all enemies between Rell and the ally.

abilities.name: Magnet Storm
abilities.summary: Pull nearby enemies toward you for several seconds.
abilities.details: Rell erupts with magnetic fury, dragging nearby enemies toward her repeatedly for several seconds.

champions.name: Renata Glasc
champions.title: the Chem-Baroness

playstyle.identity: Renata Glasc is a manipulative enchanter who can revive allies briefly and make enemies attack each other. Her ultimate turns teamfights chaotic.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers ally attacks. Q fires a missile that roots (or pulls two things together). W gives ally attack/move speed - if they die, they revive briefly as zombie. E damages and shields in a line. R sends a wave that makes enemies berserk (attack allies). W saves carries, R to flip teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Renata spikes at level 6 with her teamfight-flipping R. Shurelya's and support items scale her. She's strong at clutch saves and teamfight disruption.

strengths: R makes enemies attack each other

passive.name: Leverage
passive.summary: Ally attacks on enemies you damage deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Renata's basic attacks mark enemies. Allied champions' attacks against marked enemies deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Handshake
abilities.summary: Fire a missile that roots; hitting a second target pulls them together.
abilities.details: Renata fires a missile that roots the first enemy hit. She can recast to throw them in a direction, stunning if they hit terrain or another enemy.

abilities.name: Bailout
abilities.summary: Buff ally's attack and move speed; if they die, briefly revive them.
abilities.details: Renata grants an ally bonus attack speed and movement speed. If they take fatal damage, they briefly become a zombie. Getting a takedown saves them permanently.

abilities.name: Loyalty Program
abilities.summary: Send missiles that damage enemies and shield allies.
abilities.details: Renata sends chemtech missiles that shield allies and damage enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Hostile Takeover
abilities.summary: Send a wave that makes enemies go berserk, attacking their allies.
abilities.details: Renata sends a wave of chemicals that causes enemies to go berserk, gaining attack speed but being forced to attack their own allies. They prioritize champions over everything else.

playstyle.identity: Renekton is a lane-dominant early-game bruiser who generates fury for empowered abilities. He excels at snowballing lanes and diving with his ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Fury enhances abilities at 50+. Q heals and damages (more healing empowered). W stuns (empowered breaks shields and stuns longer). E dashes twice if you hit an enemy. R gives health, fury generation, and damages around you.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Renekton spikes at levels 3-6 and with first item. Eclipse or Goredrinker work. He's dominant early but falls off hard late.

passive.name: Reign of Anger
passive.summary: Generate fury from attacks; at 50+ fury, abilities are empowered.
passive.details: Renekton generates fury by attacking and taking damage. At 50+ fury, his next ability is empowered.

abilities.name: Cull the Meek
abilities.summary: Spin and deal damage; heal based on enemies hit. Empowered: more healing.
abilities.details: Renekton swings his blade, dealing damage and healing for each enemy hit. Empowered: Deals more damage and heals significantly more.

abilities.name: Ruthless Predator
abilities.summary: Stun an enemy with your next attack. Empowered: longer stun and breaks shields.
abilities.details: Renekton's next attack stuns the target and hits multiple times. Empowered: Hits more times, stuns longer, and destroys shields.

abilities.name: Slice and Dice
abilities.summary: Dash through enemies; if you hit, can dash again.
abilities.details: Renekton dashes in a direction. If he hits an enemy, he can dash again within a few seconds.

abilities.name: Dominus
abilities.summary: Gain health, size, and fury; deal damage around you over time.
abilities.details: Renekton transforms, gaining bonus health, increasing in size, and dealing damage around him. He also generates fury over time.

champions.name: Rengar
champions.title: the Pridestalker

playstyle.identity: Rengar is a bush-hunting assassin who leaps from brush or his ultimate's camouflage. He stacks ferocity for empowered abilities and can one-shot squishies from stealth.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive lets you leap from brush. Generate ferocity with abilities - at 4 stacks, next ability is empowered. Q is an auto reset. W heals and cleanses CC (empowered). E roots. R gives camouflage and reveals nearest enemy, leap gets crit. Emp Q for damage, Emp W for survival.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Rengar spikes at level 6 with his hunting ultimate. Duskblade or Eclipse work. He's a mid-game assassin who falls off against grouping.

weaknesses: Needs brush or R to engage

passive.name: Unseen Predator
passive.summary: Leap from brush; abilities generate ferocity for empowered casts.
passive.details: In brush, Rengar's next attack leaps to the target. Using abilities generates ferocity; at 4 stacks, his next ability is empowered. Killing unique champions upgrades his item.

abilities.name: Savagery
abilities.summary: Slash for damage and gain attack speed. Empowered: massive damage.
abilities.details: Rengar slashes, dealing damage and gaining attack speed. Empowered: Deals significantly more damage.

abilities.name: Battle Roar
abilities.summary: Roar to deal damage and heal recent damage. Empowered: also cleanse CC.
abilities.details: Rengar roars, dealing damage and healing for damage taken recently. Empowered: Also cleanses all crowd control.

abilities.name: Bola Strike
abilities.summary: Throw a bola that slows. Empowered: roots instead.
abilities.details: Rengar throws a bola that damages and slows the first enemy hit. Empowered: Roots instead of slowing.

abilities.name: Thrill of the Hunt
abilities.summary: Go camouflaged; reveal nearest enemy and leap for bonus crit damage.
abilities.details: Rengar gains camouflage and movement speed. The nearest enemy champion is revealed. His next leap from this state deals bonus crit damage.

champions.name: Riven
champions.title: the Exile

playstyle.identity: Riven is a high-skill AD caster who combos abilities and autos together. Her animation cancels and dash resets create one of the highest skill ceilings in the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers autos after abilities. Q is 3 dashes (3rd knocks up). W stuns around you. E dashes and shields. R empowers all abilities and unlocks Wind Slash execute. Weave autos between every ability. Animation cancel for maximum DPS.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Riven spikes at level 6 with execute damage and at cooldown reduction thresholds. Eclipse and ability haste let her combo more. She's strong throughout if piloted well.

strengths: Strong at all stages if mastered

passive.name: Runic Blade
passive.summary: Abilities charge her blade; empowered autos deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Riven's abilities charge her blade with up to 3 charges. Her basic attacks consume charges to deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Broken Wings
abilities.summary: Three dashes with slashes; third strike knocks up.
abilities.details: Riven dashes and slashes up to 3 times. The third slash knocks up enemies. Can be cast while moving.

abilities.name: Ki Burst
abilities.summary: Stun all nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Riven emits a Ki burst, damaging and stunning all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Valor
abilities.summary: Dash and gain a shield.
abilities.details: Riven dashes in a direction and gains a shield that absorbs damage for a short time.

abilities.name: Blade of the Exile
abilities.summary: Empower your blade for bonus range and damage; recast for Wind Slash execute.
abilities.details: Riven empowers her broken blade for increased damage, range, and AD. Recast to fire Wind Slash, dealing damage that increases based on missing health.

playstyle.identity: Rumble is a heat-managing AP bruiser whose ultimate zones entire areas. He excels in teamfights and objective control with his Equalizer.
playstyle.howToPlay: Heat builds with abilities - danger zone (50-100) empowers abilities, overheating silences you but empowers autos. Q flamethrower damages in a cone. W shields and speeds. E fires slowing harpoons. R drops a massive damage zone. Manage heat carefully.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Rumble spikes at level 6 with his teamfight ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. He's strong in mid-game teamfights with good Equalizers.

passive.name: Junkyard Titan
passive.summary: Abilities generate heat; danger zone empowers abilities; overheating silences but empowers autos.
passive.details: Rumble generates heat when using abilities. In danger zone (50-100 heat), abilities are empowered. At 100, he overheats: silenced but autos deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Flamespitter
abilities.summary: Breathe fire in a cone for sustained damage.
abilities.details: Rumble breathes fire in a cone, dealing damage over a few seconds. Danger Zone: Deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Scrap Shield
abilities.summary: Shield yourself and gain movement speed.
abilities.details: Rumble creates a shield and gains movement speed. Danger Zone: Shield and speed are increased.

abilities.name: Electro Harpoon
abilities.summary: Fire a harpoon that slows; stores 2 charges.
abilities.details: Rumble fires a harpoon that damages and slows. Stores up to 2 charges. Danger Zone: Slow is increased.

abilities.name: The Equalizer
abilities.summary: Call down a line of rockets that burn and slow.
abilities.details: Rumble calls down a line of rockets that damages and slows enemies in the zone. The fire persists for several seconds.

playstyle.identity: Ryze is a machine-gun mage who combos abilities for resets. His ultimate teleports his entire team, enabling unique macro plays and flanks.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a skillshot that does more damage to targets with E's Flux. E spreads Flux (spreads to nearby on kill). W roots (instant on Flux targets). Combo E-Q for damage, W-E-Q for root combo. R teleports you and allies in a circle after a delay.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ryze spikes with Tear stacked and ability haste. Rod of Ages into Seraph's scales him. He's a late-game scaling mage with DPS.

passive.name: Arcane Mastery
passive.summary: Gain bonus damage based on bonus mana.
passive.details: Ryze gains bonus ability power based on his maximum mana.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt; deals bonus damage to Flux targets and spreads Flux.
abilities.details: Ryze fires an Overload bolt. If it hits an enemy with Flux, it deals bonus damage, spreads Flux to nearby enemies, and grants Ryze a shield and movement speed.

abilities.name: Rune Prison
abilities.summary: Root a target; instant cast on Flux targets.
abilities.details: Ryze roots a target. If the target has Flux, the root is applied instantly.

abilities.name: Spell Flux
abilities.summary: Apply Flux to an enemy; spreads to nearby enemies on kill.
abilities.details: Ryze applies Flux to an enemy, dealing damage. If Flux kills the target, it spreads to nearby enemies. Overload consumes and spreads Flux.

abilities.name: Realm Warp
abilities.summary: Teleport yourself and allies in an area after a delay.
abilities.details: Ryze opens a portal to a nearby location. After a delay, he and all allies standing in the circle are teleported to the destination.

playstyle.identity: Samira is a combo-style ADC who builds a style grade to unlock her devastating ultimate. She dashes and weaves abilities for maximum flair and damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive grades Style from E to S with different attacks (autos/abilities). Q fires a shot or slashes melee. W spins, destroying projectiles. E dashes through ally/enemy (reset on kill). R requires S rank, unleashes a spin dealing massive damage. Build to S rank, then R.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Samira spikes at level 6 with her ultimate and first item. Infinity Edge and crit scale her. She's a snowbally ADC who takes over fights with S rank.

passive.name: Daredevil Impulse
passive.summary: Unique attacks build Style grade from E to S; can extend CC with melee attacks.
passive.details: Samira builds Style by hitting enemies with different attacks. At S rank, she can use R. She can also extend knock-ups with autos in melee range.

abilities.name: Flair
abilities.summary: Fire a shot at range or slash in melee.
abilities.details: At range, Samira fires a shot. In melee, she slashes with her sword. Both deal damage and can critically strike.

abilities.name: Blade Whirl
abilities.summary: Slash around you, destroying projectiles.
abilities.details: Samira slashes around herself, dealing damage twice and destroying all incoming projectiles for the duration.

abilities.name: Wild Rush
abilities.summary: Dash through an enemy or ally; resets on takedown.
abilities.details: Samira dashes through a target unit, dealing damage if it's an enemy. Takedowns reset the cooldown.

abilities.name: Inferno Trigger
abilities.summary: At S rank, unleash a barrage of shots around you.
abilities.details: Requires S style rank. Samira spins and fires shots at all nearby enemies for a few seconds, dealing damage that can crit. She can move while casting.

champions.name: Sejuani
champions.title: Fury of the North

playstyle.identity: Sejuani is a CC-heavy tank jungler who synergizes with melee allies. Her passive makes her incredibly durable in extended fights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives armor/MR after not taking damage. Q dashes and knocks up. W swings twice dealing damage. E stacks frost - melee ally attacks add stacks, at 4 stacks auto to stun. R throws her flail, stunning first champion and creating a slow zone.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sejuani spikes with a melee-heavy team. Level 6 adds ranged engage. She's strong throughout as a durable engage tank.

strengths: Good engage with Q and R

passive.name: Fury of the North
passive.summary: Gain armor and MR and slow resistance after not taking damage.
passive.details: After not taking damage for a while, Sejuani becomes frosted, gaining bonus armor, magic resist, and slow immunity. Lasts until she takes damage.

abilities.name: Arctic Assault
abilities.summary: Charge forward and knock up enemies hit.
abilities.details: Sejuani charges forward, dealing damage and knocking up enemies she collides with. Stops on hitting an enemy champion.

abilities.name: Winter's Wrath
abilities.summary: Swing twice; the second swing deals more damage and knocks back.
abilities.details: Sejuani swings her flail twice. The first swing deals damage in an arc; the second swing hits harder and knocks enemies back.

abilities.name: Permafrost
abilities.summary: Auto attacks and abilities stack frost; at 4 stacks, stun the target.
abilities.details: Sejuani and melee allies stack frost on enemies with attacks. At 4 stacks, Sejuani can activate to stun the target and deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Glacial Prison
abilities.summary: Throw your flail to stun the first champion hit and create a frost storm.
abilities.details: Sejuani throws her bola, stunning the first enemy champion hit. A storm then spreads outward, slowing enemies and eventually stunning those still inside.

playstyle.identity: Senna is an infinite-scaling marksman support who collects souls for range and damage. She can build as a carry or supportively depending on role.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: souls drop from minions and champions, giving AD, crit, and range. Q heals allies and damages enemies in a line. W roots after a delay. E creates a mist that camouflages allies. R is global, shields allies and damages enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Senna spikes with soul stacks - 60+ souls gives significant range. Lethality or crit builds work. She scales infinitely but is strongest mid-game.

passive.name: Absolution
passive.summary: Collect souls for permanent attack range, AD, and crit chance.
passive.details: Enemy champions and large minions/monsters drop Mist when damaged twice. Collecting Mist grants Senna gold, AD, and critical strike chance. At thresholds, she gains bonus range.

abilities.name: Piercing Darkness
abilities.summary: Fire a beam that heals allies and damages enemies in a line.
abilities.details: Senna fires a beam in a direction, healing ally champions and damaging enemies. Can target allies, enemies, or wards.

abilities.name: Last Embrace
abilities.summary: Fire a mist that roots enemies after a delay.
abilities.details: Senna fires a mist that damages and clings to the first enemy hit. After a delay, it roots the target and nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Curse of the Black Mist
abilities.summary: Create a mist that camouflages allies inside.
abilities.details: Senna surrounds herself with mist, gaining movement speed. Allied champions inside become camouflaged and appear as wraiths.

abilities.name: Dawning Shadow
abilities.summary: Fire a global beam that shields allies and damages enemies.
abilities.details: Senna fires a broad beam globally, shielding allies in the center and damaging enemies. The center deals more damage.

champions.name: Seraphine
champions.title: the Starry-Eyed Songstress

playstyle.identity: Seraphine is a scaling enchanter/mage who extends her abilities near allies. Her ultimate can charm an entire team if it bounces correctly.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: every third ability echoes. Notes: abilities near allies extend. Q deals more to low health. W shields and heals (double if ally already shielded). E slows, or roots if already slowed, or stuns if already rooted. R charms and extends through champions.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Seraphine spikes at level 6 with teamfight ultimate. AP or support items work. She scales well into late-game teamfights.

weaknesses: E needs setup for hard CC

passive.name: Stage Presence
passive.summary: Every third ability echoes; abilities are stronger near allies.
passive.details: Every third basic ability casts again. Abilities gain bonus effects when cast near allies based on how many are nearby.

abilities.name: High Note
abilities.summary: Deal damage in an area; deals more to low health targets.
abilities.details: Seraphine projects a note that deals magic damage, increased based on the target's missing health.

abilities.name: Surround Sound
abilities.summary: Shield and speed nearby allies; heal if already shielded.
abilities.details: Seraphine surrounds herself and nearby allies with sound, granting shield and movement speed. If she's already shielded, she also heals nearby allies.

abilities.name: Beat Drop
abilities.summary: Deal damage and slow; roots if already slowed, stuns if rooted.
abilities.details: Seraphine unleashes a wave that damages and slows. Enemies already slowed are rooted. Enemies already rooted are stunned.

abilities.name: Encore
abilities.summary: Charm enemies and extend through champions.
abilities.details: Seraphine fires a captivating force that charms and damages enemies. The wave's range extends each time it hits a champion (ally or enemy).

champions.name: Sett
champions.title: the Boss

playstyle.identity: Sett is a boss-style bruiser who absorbs damage and returns it amplified. His Haymaker true damage punch and supplex ultimate make him a teamfight terror.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives health regen and left-right punches (right punch is stronger). Q gives movement speed and empowers autos. W stores damage taken as Grit, unleashing true damage in center. E pulls enemies together and stuns. R suppresses and slams enemy into their team.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sett spikes at levels 1-3 with trading and at 6 with R engage. Stridebreaker or BORK work. He's strong early-mid in teamfights.

strengths: W can deal massive true damage

passive.name: Pit Grit
passive.summary: Regen health based on missing HP; right punch deals bonus damage.
passive.details: Sett regenerates health based on his missing health. His auto attacks alternate left and right; right punches deal bonus damage and attack faster.

abilities.name: Knuckle Down
abilities.summary: Gain movement speed; next two autos deal bonus damage.
abilities.details: Sett gains movement speed toward enemy champions. His next two auto attacks deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.summary: Store damage taken as Grit; release for a massive punch with true damage in center.
abilities.details: Sett stores damage taken as Grit. Activate to expend Grit, gaining a shield and dealing damage in a direction. The center deals true damage.

abilities.name: Facebreaker
abilities.summary: Pull enemies together; stun if pulled from both sides.
abilities.details: Sett pulls enemies on both sides toward him, dealing damage and slowing. If he pulls enemies from both sides, they're stunned.

abilities.name: The Show Stopper
abilities.summary: Grab an enemy and slam them, dealing damage based on their health.
abilities.details: Sett grabs an enemy champion, becoming unstoppable, and slams them into the ground, dealing damage to the target based on their max health and to nearby enemies.

playstyle.identity: Shaco is a trickster assassin who deceives enemies with boxes and clones. He invades, ganks from unexpected angles, and creates chaos.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q blinks and goes invisible, backstab crits. W places a fear box (use for traps/clears). E throws a dagger that slows and executes low health. R creates a clone (explodes into boxes on death). AP Shaco uses boxes, AD uses Q assassination.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Shaco spikes at level 3 with ganking tools. Duskblade or AP items work. He's strong early with cheese and invades.

passive.name: Backstab
passive.summary: Attacks from behind deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal bonus damage when hitting enemies from behind.

abilities.name: Deceive
abilities.summary: Blink and become invisible; next attack crits from stealth.
abilities.details: Shaco blinks to a location and becomes invisible. His next basic attack is guaranteed to critically strike.

abilities.name: Jack In The Box
abilities.summary: Place an invisible box that fears and attacks enemies.
abilities.details: Shaco places a box that arms after a delay. When triggered, it fears and attacks nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Two-Shiv Poison
abilities.summary: Passive: autos slow. Active: throw a dagger that deals execute damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks slow enemies. Active: Shaco throws a dagger that damages, slows, and deals bonus damage to low health targets.

abilities.name: Hallucinate
abilities.summary: Create a controllable clone; on death, it explodes into boxes.
abilities.details: Shaco becomes invisible briefly and creates a clone. The clone can be controlled and explodes into 3 boxes when killed, dealing damage and fearing enemies.

playstyle.identity: Shen is a global tank who teleports to allies with his ultimate. He protects his team while being a solid laner with his spirit blade mechanics.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives a shield periodically. Q calls spirit blade through you, empowering autos and slowing. W creates a dodge zone around spirit blade. E taunts in a dash. R shields an ally and teleports you to them. Split push and R to join fights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Shen spikes at level 6 with global presence. Sunfire and tank items work. He's strong at all stages with his map pressure.

passive.name: Ki Barrier
passive.summary: Periodically gain a shield; abilities reduce cooldown.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Shen gains a shield. Affecting other champions with abilities reduces this cooldown.

abilities.name: Spirit Blade
abilities.summary: Call your spirit blade; autos against enemies it passes through deal bonus damage.
abilities.details: Shen calls his spirit blade to him. Enemies it passes through are slowed, and Shen's next 3 autos deal bonus damage based on their max health.

abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
abilities.summary: Create a zone around the spirit blade that blocks all auto attacks.
abilities.details: Shen creates a protective zone around his spirit blade. Allied champions inside the zone dodge all basic attacks.

abilities.name: Shadow Dash
abilities.summary: Dash and taunt all enemies hit.
abilities.details: Shen dashes in a direction, dealing damage and taunting all enemy champions and monsters he passes through.

abilities.name: Stand United
abilities.summary: Shield an ally anywhere on the map; after channeling, teleport to them.
abilities.details: Shen channels, granting a shield to a target ally anywhere on the map. After channeling, he teleports to their location.

playstyle.identity: Shyvana is a farming jungler who transforms into a dragon. Her dragon form enhances all abilities and she excels with AP burst or AD bruiser builds.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: killing dragons gives bonus stats. Q double auto. W surrounds you with fire. E marks (bonus damage on marked). R transforms to dragon, E becomes massive fireball (AP build oneshots). Farm to 6, transform for fights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Shyvana spikes at level 6 with dragon form. AP for burst, AD for DPS. She needs to farm and scales into mid-game.

passive.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
passive.summary: Killing dragons grants bonus stats; gain fury from attacks.
passive.details: Shyvana deals bonus damage to dragons and gains bonus armor and magic resist for each dragon her team kills. She also generates fury for Dragon's Descent.

abilities.name: Twin Bite
abilities.summary: Auto attack twice; applies on-hit effects twice.
abilities.details: Shyvana's next auto strikes twice, dealing bonus damage. Both hits apply on-hit effects. Dragon Form: Also damages enemies around the target.

abilities.name: Burnout
abilities.summary: Surround yourself with fire and gain movement speed.
abilities.details: Shyvana surrounds herself with fire, dealing damage to nearby enemies and gaining movement speed. Basic attacks extend the duration. Dragon Form: Larger area.

abilities.name: Flame Breath
abilities.summary: Fire a fireball that marks enemies; attacks on marked targets deal bonus damage.
abilities.details: Shyvana fires a ball of flame that damages and marks enemies. Auto attacks on marked enemies deal bonus damage. Dragon Form: A massive explosion that leaves a burning zone.

abilities.name: Dragon's Descent
abilities.summary: Transform into a dragon, gaining bonus stats and enhanced abilities.
abilities.details: Shyvana transforms into a dragon, dashing forward and dealing damage. She gains bonus health and her abilities are enhanced. Requires full fury.

playstyle.identity: Singed is a proxy-farming disruptor who runs through enemies leaving poison. His unique playstyle involves running around being obnoxious while enemies chase him.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q toggles poison trail behind you. W creates a slow/ground zone. E flings enemies behind you (into W). R gives massive stats. Run into enemies, poison, fling carries, run away. Proxy farm behind enemy tower to draw pressure.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Singed spikes with boots and at 6 with R stats. Rylai's makes poison slow. He's strong when he can run around teamfights.

passive.name: Noxious Slipstream
passive.summary: Gain movement speed when near champions.
passive.details: Singed gains a burst of movement speed when he passes nearby champions.

abilities.name: Poison Trail
abilities.summary: Toggle to leave a trail of poison behind you.
abilities.details: Singed creates a trail of poison behind him that damages enemies who walk through it.

abilities.name: Mega Adhesive
abilities.summary: Create a zone that slows and grounds enemies.
abilities.details: Singed throws a vial that creates a sticky zone, slowing enemies and grounding them (preventing dashes).

abilities.name: Fling
abilities.summary: Throw an enemy behind you, damaging them.
abilities.details: Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing damage. If they land in Mega Adhesive, they're also rooted.

abilities.name: Insanity Potion
abilities.summary: Gain massive bonus stats for a duration.
abilities.details: Singed drinks a potent brew, gaining bonus ability power, armor, magic resist, movement speed, health regeneration, and mana regeneration.

playstyle.identity: Sion is an infinite-scaling HP tank who charges across the map with his ultimate. His passive lets him fight on after death, making him annoying to deal with.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: on death, reanimate and attack until dying again. Q charges a knockup. W shields and explodes. E pushes minions/champions and shreds armor. R charges across map, stunning on impact. Stack health with W passive. R for engage or roams.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sion spikes with health stacks and at 6 with R engage. Sunfire and health items scale his passive. He's a late-game health monster.

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.summary: On death, reanimate as a zombie that attacks until dying again.
