passive.details: When Sion dies, he reanimates for a few seconds, gaining bonus lifesteal and attack speed but rapidly decaying health. He can move and attack freely.

abilities.name: Decimating Smash
abilities.summary: Charge and release a knockup; longer charge = more damage and range.
abilities.details: Sion charges up a heavy blow. Release to damage and knock up enemies. Longer charge increases range, damage, and knockup duration.

abilities.name: Soul Furnace
abilities.summary: Passive: gain permanent health from kills. Active: shield that explodes.
abilities.details: Passive: Sion gains permanent bonus health for killing units. Active: Sion shields himself. After a delay or on recast, the shield explodes for damage.

abilities.name: Roar of the Slayer
abilities.summary: Shout to damage, slow, and reduce armor; pushes minions.
abilities.details: Sion roars in a direction, damaging the first enemy hit, slowing them, and reducing their armor. If it hits a minion, the minion is pushed and damages enemies behind.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
abilities.summary: Charge in a direction; impact stuns and deals damage.
abilities.details: Sion charges in a direction, becoming unstoppable and accelerating. Impact deals damage and stuns enemies, with damage and stun duration increasing with distance.

playstyle.identity: Sivir is a waveclear ADC whose abilities bounce between enemies. Her spell shield blocks abilities, and her ultimate speeds her entire team.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives movement speed when hitting champions. Q is a boomerang that damages twice. W makes autos bounce to nearby enemies. E spell shields (blocks one ability, refunds mana). R speeds up nearby allies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sivir spikes with crit items for W bounces. Kraken or Galeforce work. She's a late-game teamfighter with AoE damage.

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.summary: Gain movement speed when hitting enemy champions.
passive.details: Sivir gains bonus movement speed for a short time when she damages an enemy champion with an ability or attack.

abilities.name: Boomerang Blade
abilities.summary: Throw a boomerang that damages enemies out and back.
abilities.details: Sivir throws her crossblade, dealing damage to enemies it passes through on the way out and back.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.summary: Auto attacks bounce to nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Sivir's next few auto attacks bounce to additional enemies, dealing damage to each target.

abilities.name: Spell Shield
abilities.summary: Block the next enemy ability; gain mana if successful.
abilities.details: Sivir creates a shield that blocks the next enemy ability. If successful, she heals and restores mana.

abilities.name: On The Hunt
abilities.summary: Rally nearby allies, giving everyone bonus movement speed.
abilities.details: Sivir rallies her allies, granting herself and nearby allies bonus movement speed for a duration.

playstyle.identity: Skarner is a pick-focused tank who drags enemies out of position with his ultimate. His reworked kit gives him CC and durability to reach priority targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a charged slam that stuns (needs charge). W has two parts: first gives shield and speed, second grabs/throws enemies/terrain. E impales in a line. R suppresses and drags a target with you. Flash R to grab carries and drag them to your team.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Skarner spikes at level 6 with his drag ultimate. Tank items make him durable. He's strong when he can isolate targets.

passive.name: Threads of Vibration
passive.summary: Abilities apply stacks that deal bonus damage at 3 stacks.
passive.details: Skarner's abilities apply Quaking stacks. At 3 stacks, they detonate to deal bonus percent max health damage.

abilities.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
abilities.summary: Rip out a rock; throw it to stun enemies.
abilities.details: Skarner rips out a rock, empowering his next attack. Throw the rock to deal damage and stun enemies hit. Can store multiple charges.

abilities.name: Seismic Bastion
abilities.summary: Gain a shield; recast to slam and damage enemies.
abilities.details: Skarner surrounds himself with a shield and gains movement speed. Recast to slam the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Ixtal's Impact
abilities.summary: Charge forward, ignoring terrain; grab and drag the first champion hit.
abilities.details: Skarner charges in a direction, ignoring terrain. He grabs the first enemy champion hit, carrying them with him before throwing them.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.summary: Suppress a target and drag them with you.
abilities.details: Skarner impales an enemy champion, suppressing them and dragging them with him for a few seconds. Deals damage when the suppression ends.

playstyle.identity: Smolder is an infinitely scaling dragon ADC who gains stacks on Q hits. His abilities upgrade at stack thresholds, making him a late-game hypercarry.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a targeted ability that stacks on hit. W fires a slow zone. E dashes and flies over terrain briefly. R fires a huge wave globally. Q upgrades: 25 stacks adds explosion, 125 adds burn, 225 adds massive true damage. Farm Q stacks for scaling.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Smolder spikes at Q upgrade thresholds (25, 125, 225). Crit items scale him. He's a late-game hypercarry who needs to stack.

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.summary: Q hits permanently stack; stacks upgrade abilities at thresholds.
passive.details: Hitting champions with abilities grants Smolder stacks. At certain thresholds (25, 125, 225), his abilities gain bonus effects.

abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt at a target; evolves with stacks.
abilities.details: Smolder breathes fire at a target, dealing damage. At 25 stacks: creates an explosion. At 125: adds a burn. At 225: deals bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Achooo!
abilities.summary: Sneeze fire that slows; explodes after a delay.
abilities.details: Smolder sneezes fire at a location, slowing enemies. After a delay, it explodes dealing more damage.

abilities.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
abilities.summary: Dash forward, briefly flying over terrain.
abilities.details: Smolder dashes and gains flight, ignoring terrain for a short distance.

abilities.name: MMOOOMMMM!
abilities.summary: Call mom to fire a massive global wave.
abilities.details: Smolder calls his mother, who fires a massive wave across the map dealing damage to enemies hit. Slows and reveals enemies.

playstyle.identity: Sona is an aura enchanter who provides constant buffs to her team. Her abilities create auras that enhance nearby allies while her ultimate is a teamfight-winning stun.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities create auras that buff allies. Q damages and gives damage aura. W heals and gives shield aura. E speeds and gives speed aura. Passive empowers auto after 3 abilities (Q empowered = more damage, W = damage reduction, E = slow). R stuns in a line.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sona spikes at level 6 with her stun ultimate. Moonstone scales her auras. She's a late-game enchanter who buffs her whole team.

passive.name: Power Chord
passive.summary: After 3 abilities, next auto is empowered based on last ability used.
passive.details: After casting 3 abilities, Sona's next auto is empowered. Effect depends on last ability: Q deals bonus damage, W reduces target's damage, E slows.

abilities.name: Hymn of Valor
abilities.summary: Deal damage to nearby enemies; aura gives allies bonus damage on next attack.
abilities.details: Sona fires bolts at nearby enemies, dealing damage. Creates an aura that empowers allied attacks with bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Aria of Perseverance
abilities.summary: Heal yourself and a nearby ally; aura shields allies.
abilities.details: Sona heals herself and the most wounded nearby ally. Creates an aura that shields allies who stay near.

abilities.name: Song of Celerity
abilities.summary: Gain movement speed; aura speeds nearby allies.
abilities.details: Sona gains movement speed. Creates an aura that grants movement speed to nearby allied champions.

abilities.name: Crescendo
abilities.summary: Play a chord that stuns all enemies in a line.
abilities.details: Sona plays her ultimate chord, dealing damage and stunning all enemies in a line.

playstyle.identity: Soraka is the premier healer who sacrifices her own health to heal allies. Her global ultimate can save teammates across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q damages and heals Soraka if she hits champions. W heals allies at cost of Soraka's health. E silences and roots after delay. R globally heals all allies. Poke with Q to sustain yourself, then heal teammates with W.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Soraka spikes with heal/shield power items. Moonstone or Redemption amplify her. She's strong at all stages as a healer.

passive.name: Salvation
passive.summary: Gain movement speed toward low health allies.
passive.details: Soraka gains bonus movement speed when moving toward allied champions below a health threshold.

abilities.name: Starcall
abilities.summary: Call down a star that damages and heals you if it hits a champion.
abilities.details: Soraka calls down a star that damages enemies and slows them. If it hits a champion, Soraka heals over time.

abilities.name: Astral Infusion
abilities.summary: Heal an ally at the cost of your own health.
abilities.details: Soraka heals an ally champion, spending a portion of her own health to do so.

abilities.name: Equinox
abilities.summary: Create a zone that silences enemies; roots after a delay.
abilities.details: Soraka creates a zone that silences enemies inside. After a delay, the zone detonates, rooting enemies still inside.

abilities.name: Wish
abilities.summary: Heal all allied champions globally.
abilities.details: Soraka calls upon the stars to heal all allied champions anywhere on the map. Heals more on low health targets.

playstyle.identity: Swain is a drain-tank battlemage who transforms into a demon form. He excels in extended fights, healing massive amounts while dealing AoE damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive pulls CC'd enemies and heals. Q fires bolts (more damage closer). W has huge range vision/damage. E sends a claw that returns, rooting. R transforms, draining nearby enemies - recast to deal damage based on health drained. Pull enemies in, R, drain to full.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Swain spikes at level 6 with his transform. Liandry's and health/AP scale him. He's strong in extended teamfights where he can drain.

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.summary: Pull CC'd enemies toward you and heal; collect soul fragments for bonus health.
passive.details: Swain can pull immobilized enemies toward him, dealing damage. Enemies near him drop soul fragments that heal him and grant permanent bonus health.

abilities.name: Death's Hand
abilities.summary: Fire bolts that deal more damage at close range.
abilities.details: Swain fires bolts that deal damage. Hitting multiple bolts on the same enemy deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Vision of Empire
abilities.summary: Reveal and damage a distant area; slows and reveals enemies.
abilities.details: Swain reveals an area at a huge range after a delay, dealing damage to and slowing enemies inside. Also reveals them.

abilities.name: Nevermove
abilities.summary: Fire a claw that roots enemies on its return.
abilities.details: Swain fires a demonic wave that passes through enemies, then returns to him. Enemies hit on the return are rooted.

abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
abilities.summary: Transform, draining nearby enemies. Recast to deal AoE damage.
abilities.details: Swain transforms into a demon, draining health from nearby enemies over time. Recast to end early and deal damage in an area based on health drained.

champions.name: Sylas
champions.title: the Unshackled

playstyle.identity: Sylas is an AP bruiser who steals enemy ultimates, making every game different. His kit combines burst, healing, and mobility with the unpredictability of using the enemy team's own ultimates against them.
playstyle.howToPlay: Trade with E (dash) > Q (damage) > auto attacks (passive procs). Your passive makes your autos deal AoE magic damage after abilities - weave them in. W heals more when you're low - use it mid-fight. Steal the most impactful enemy ult and look for game-changing plays.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sylas spikes at level 6 when he can steal ultimates. He's strong in mid-game skirmishes with 2 items. His scaling depends heavily on enemy team comp - some stolen ults are game-winning.

strengths: Steals enemy ultimates for versatile plays
Good mobility with double E dash

passive.name: Petricite Burst
passive.summary: After casting an ability, your next auto attack whirls chains in an AoE.
passive.details: After using an ability, Sylas' next basic attack whirls his chains around him, dealing bonus magic damage to the target and all nearby enemies. This is a huge part of his damage - always weave auto attacks between abilities for maximum DPS.

abilities.name: Chain Lash
abilities.summary: Lash out chains that intersect and explode after a delay.
abilities.details: Sylas lashes his chains out in an X pattern. After a brief delay, the intersection detonates, dealing bonus damage and slowing enemies. Landing the intersection is key to your burst - practice the timing. Good for waveclear and poke.

abilities.name: Kingslayer
abilities.summary: Dash to an enemy and deal damage; heal yourself, increased when low health.
abilities.details: Sylas lunges at an enemy, dealing magic damage and healing himself. Both damage and healing are increased based on the target's and Sylas' missing health respectively. This is your sustain in fights - the lower you are, the more you heal.

abilities.name: Abscond / Abduct
abilities.summary: Dash forward; recast to throw chains that pull you to the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Abscond: Sylas dashes in a direction, gaining a small shield. Abduct (recast): Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit and knocking them up briefly. This is your engage, escape, and combo starter - two dashes make you very mobile.

abilities.name: Hijack
abilities.summary: Steal an enemy champion's ultimate and cast it as your own.
abilities.details: Sylas steals the ultimate of a target enemy champion, replacing Hijack with their ult for a period of time. Stolen ults scale with Sylas' stats (AP) rather than the original champion's. Some ults are incredible on Sylas (Malphite R, Amumu R) while others are weaker. Target priority matters.

playstyle.identity: Syndra is a burst mage who manipulates dark spheres. Her ultimate launches all spheres at a target, dealing massive single-target burst.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q spawns a sphere. W picks up and throws spheres/minions. E pushes spheres and stuns enemies hit by them. R launches all spheres at one target (more spheres = more damage). Set up spheres with Q, use E-Q combo for stun, then R for execute.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Syndra spikes at level 6 with her burst ultimate. Luden's scales her damage. She's strong in lane and at bursting single targets.

passive.name: Transcendent
passive.summary: Gain Splinters from abilities; at 120 Splinters, upgrade abilities and gain bonus damage.
passive.details: Syndra gains Splinters from damaging champions and leveling. At 120, her abilities upgrade. She also gains permanent bonus damage after upgrading.

abilities.name: Dark Sphere
abilities.summary: Create a sphere that damages enemies.
abilities.details: Syndra conjures a dark sphere at a location, dealing damage to enemies. The sphere remains for several seconds.

abilities.name: Force of Will
abilities.summary: Pick up a sphere or minion and throw it.
abilities.details: Syndra grabs a sphere, minion, or monster. Recast to throw it, dealing damage and slowing enemies on impact.

abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
abilities.summary: Push spheres and enemies; enemies hit by spheres are stunned.
abilities.details: Syndra pushes enemies and spheres in a cone. Enemies hit by pushed spheres are stunned.

abilities.name: Unleashed Power
abilities.summary: Launch all spheres at an enemy, dealing massive damage.
abilities.details: Syndra launches all active spheres plus additional spheres at an enemy champion, dealing massive damage. More spheres = more damage.

champions.name: Tahm Kench
champions.title: The River King

playstyle.identity: Tahm Kench is a protective tank who eats allies to save them or enemies to kill them. His W is a long-range engage tool.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a skillshot that slows and stuns if target has 3 stacks. W travels underground and knocks up enemies on arrival. E stores damage taken to shield or heal. R devours ally (protective) or enemy with 3 stacks (offensive). Use W for engage, R to save carries.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Tahm Kench spikes at levels 3-6 with trading and R. Tank items scale his shield. He's strong at protecting allies and trading.

strengths: Can eat allies to save them

passive.name: An Acquired Taste
passive.summary: Auto attacks and abilities apply stacks for enhanced effects.
passive.details: Tahm Kench's attacks and abilities apply stacks. At 3 stacks, his Q stuns and R can devour enemies.

abilities.name: Tongue Lash
abilities.summary: Lash out and slow; stuns enemies with 3 stacks.
abilities.details: Tahm Kench lashes his tongue, damaging and slowing the first enemy hit. Enemies with 3 stacks are stunned.

abilities.name: Abyssal Dive
abilities.summary: Dive underground and emerge at a location, knocking up enemies.
abilities.details: Tahm Kench dives underground, becoming unstoppable. He emerges at a target location, dealing damage and knocking up enemies.

abilities.name: Thick Skin
abilities.summary: Store damage taken; activate to heal or wait to gain a shield.
abilities.details: Passive: Tahm Kench stores damage taken as grey health. Active: Convert grey health to a shield. If he doesn't activate, the grey health heals him over time.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.summary: Eat an ally to protect them, or an enemy with 3 stacks to damage them.
abilities.details: Tahm Kench devours a target. Allied champions are kept safe and can be spit out. Enemy champions with 3 stacks can be devoured, taking damage and being held briefly.

playstyle.identity: Taliyah is a zone control mage who shapes terrain. Her wall can cut off entire sections of the map, and her worked ground mechanic rewards repositioning.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives speed near walls. Q throws rocks (creates worked ground that gives single rock). W knocks up and pushes enemies. E creates a minefield that explodes on dashes. R creates a massive wall across terrain. Use W to knock enemies into E mines.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Taliyah spikes at level 6 with her map-altering ultimate. Luden's scales her burst. She's strong at objective control with R.

passive.name: Rock Surfing
passive.summary: Gain movement speed near terrain.
passive.details: Taliyah gains bonus movement speed when near walls or terrain.

abilities.name: Threaded Volley
abilities.summary: Throw rocks; creates worked ground (single rock on worked ground).
abilities.details: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks that deals damage. Creates worked ground. On worked ground, only a single rock is thrown but it deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Seismic Shove
abilities.summary: Create an area that knocks up and pushes enemies.
abilities.details: Taliyah marks a location, then erupts it upward after a delay, knocking up and pushing enemies in a chosen direction.

abilities.name: Unraveled Earth
abilities.summary: Create a minefield that explodes when enemies dash through.
abilities.details: Taliyah scatters boulders on the ground that slow enemies. If enemies dash through the field, the boulders explode for bonus damage.

abilities.name: Weaver's Wall
abilities.summary: Create a massive wall that cuts across the terrain.
abilities.details: Taliyah creates a long wall of rock that travels across the map. She can ride the wall initially. The wall blocks movement until destroyed or timed out.

playstyle.identity: Talon is a roaming assassin who can jump over any terrain in the game. He excels at bursting targets and disappearing before enemies can react.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive bleeds on 3 ability hits. Q is melee crit or ranged stab. W throws blades out and back. E jumps over any terrain (each terrain has cooldown). R goes invisible and throws blades that return on attack. W-Q for poke, R for all-in, E to roam everywhere.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Talon spikes at level 2-3 with burst combo and at 6 with R. Lethality items scale him. He's strongest mid-game roaming.

passive.name: Blade's End
passive.summary: Abilities stack wounds; at 3 stacks, auto attack bleeds the target.
passive.details: Talon's abilities apply Wound stacks. At 3 stacks, his next auto attack consumes them to deal bonus bleed damage.

abilities.name: Noxian Diplomacy
abilities.summary: Dash and stab; at melee range, deals critical damage.
abilities.details: Talon stabs a target. At close range, he critically strikes. At range, he leaps to the target. Refunds cooldown on kill.

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.summary: Throw blades that return, dealing damage and slowing.
abilities.details: Talon throws blades in a cone that return after a moment, dealing damage both ways. Returning blades slow.

abilities.name: Assassin's Path
abilities.summary: Jump over any terrain; each terrain has a cooldown.
abilities.details: Talon vaults over any terrain in the game. Each terrain segment has its own cooldown before he can use it again.

abilities.name: Shadow Assault
abilities.summary: Go invisible and throw blades outward; blades return on attack or recast.
abilities.details: Talon becomes invisible and throws blades outward. The blades return to him when he attacks or recasts, dealing damage.

playstyle.identity: Taric is a protective enchanter/tank who makes his entire team invulnerable with his ultimate. His abilities can be cast through a linked ally.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers next 2 autos after abilities. W links to ally (all abilities also cast from them). Q heals nearby allies. E stuns in a line (also from linked ally). R makes nearby allies invulnerable after a delay. Position well for double E stuns.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Taric spikes at level 6 with team invulnerability. Tank items make him durable. He's strong at teamfights with properly timed R.

passive.name: Bravado
passive.summary: After abilities, next 2 autos deal bonus damage and reduce cooldowns.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Taric's next 2 auto attacks deal bonus magic damage and reduce his basic ability cooldowns.

abilities.name: Starlight's Touch
abilities.summary: Heal nearby allies; stacks charges over time.
abilities.details: Taric heals himself and nearby allies. He stores charges over time and uses them for more powerful heals.

abilities.name: Bastion
abilities.summary: Link to an ally; your abilities also cast from their location.
abilities.details: Taric shields an ally and links to them. While linked, his Q, E, and R also cast from the ally's position.

abilities.name: Dazzle
abilities.summary: Charge and fire a beam that stuns; also casts from linked ally.
abilities.details: Taric fires a beam from himself (and his linked ally) that stuns enemies after a delay.

abilities.name: Cosmic Radiance
abilities.summary: After a delay, make yourself and nearby allies invulnerable.
abilities.details: Taric calls down cosmic energy. After a delay, he and all nearby allied champions become invulnerable for a few seconds.

playstyle.identity: Teemo is an annoying yordle who poisons enemies and hides mushrooms across the map. He excels at tilting opponents and map control through shroom placement.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive makes you invisible when standing still. Q blinds (enemy autos miss). W gives speed. E poisons on autos. R places invisible mushrooms that explode for damage and slow. Shroom high-traffic areas for vision and damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Teemo spikes at level 6 with mushrooms. Liandry's makes poison and shrooms burn harder. He's strong at kiting and map control.

passive.name: Guerrilla Warfare
passive.summary: Become invisible when standing still; gain attack speed when exiting.
passive.details: After a delay of not moving, Teemo becomes invisible. When he breaks stealth, he gains bonus attack speed.

abilities.name: Blinding Dart
abilities.summary: Blind an enemy, causing their auto attacks to miss.
abilities.details: Teemo shoots a dart that deals magic damage and blinds the target, causing their auto attacks to miss.

abilities.name: Move Quick
abilities.summary: Gain movement speed; activate for more speed.
abilities.details: Passive: Teemo gains bonus movement speed if he hasn't been damaged recently. Active: Double the bonus briefly.

abilities.name: Toxic Shot
abilities.summary: Auto attacks poison enemies for damage over time.
abilities.details: Teemo's auto attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit and poison enemies, dealing damage over time.

abilities.name: Noxious Trap
abilities.summary: Place invisible mushrooms that explode, poisoning and slowing.
abilities.details: Teemo places a poisonous mushroom that becomes invisible. When enemies step on it, it explodes dealing damage over time and slowing.

champions.name: Thresh
champions.title: the Chain Warden

playstyle.identity: Thresh is the quintessential playmaking support with unmatched utility. His hook-lantern combo can engage, peel, or save allies from certain death, making him the master of controlling fights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Land hooks (Q) to engage or catch enemies out of position. Throw lantern (W) to allies for shields or to pull them to safety. Use Flay (E) to interrupt dashes or set up hooks. The Box (R) zones enemies in teamfights. Master the lantern-hook combo for aggressive plays.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Thresh is strong at level 2 with Q+E for early kills. Level 6 adds significant zone control. He scales with souls collected (passive) and CDR to throw more hooks and lanterns.

strengths: Incredible utility with hook, lantern, and displacement
Can save allies from almost any situation with lantern
Strong at all stages of the game
Flexible playstyle - can engage or peel
weaknesses: Hook has a long cooldown early and can be dodged
Requires good team coordination for lantern saves
Needs to collect souls to scale his defensive stats

passive.name: Damnation
passive.summary: Collect souls from dead enemies to gain armor and ability power.
passive.details: Enemies that die near Thresh drop souls that he can collect. Each soul grants permanent armor and ability power. Souls appear for a few seconds before disappearing. Positioning to collect souls safely while trading is key to scaling.

abilities.name: Death Sentence
abilities.summary: Hook an enemy and drag yourself to them.
abilities.details: Thresh throws his hook in a line. The first enemy hit is stunned and dragged toward Thresh. Reactivating Q pulls Thresh to the hooked target. You can hook over walls and follow up with your full combo. Missing hook leaves you vulnerable, so pick your shots.

abilities.name: Dark Passage
abilities.summary: Throw a lantern that shields allies and lets them dash to you.
abilities.details: Thresh throws a lantern that shields nearby allies. An ally can click the lantern to dash to Thresh's location. This is your signature save tool - throw it to allies in danger or use it aggressively to bring your jungler into lane from unexpected angles.

abilities.name: Flay
abilities.summary: Sweep enemies in a direction, damaging and slowing them.
abilities.details: Thresh sweeps his chain in a line, pushing enemies in the chosen direction and slowing them. Passively, his basic attacks deal bonus magic damage based on how long since his last attack. Use Flay to interrupt dashes, set up hooks, or peel enemies off your carry.

abilities.name: The Box
abilities.summary: Create a prison of walls that slow and damage enemies who pass through.
abilities.details: Thresh creates a pentagon of spectral walls around himself. Enemies passing through a wall take magic damage and are heavily slowed. Each wall can only affect one enemy. Use in choke points or to trap enemies after landing a hook.

playstyle.identity: Tristana is a scaling ADC with resets and increasing range. Her jump resets on kills, allowing her to bounce through teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives attack range per level. Q gives attack speed steroid. W rocket jumps (reset on kill or E explosion). E is a bomb that stacks damage with autos - explode for burst. R knocks back and damages. W in, E + autos to stack bomb, W out or reset.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Tristana spikes at levels 2-3 for all-in and late with max range. Kraken and crit scale her. She's strong early for kills and late for range.

passive.name: Draw a Bead
passive.summary: Gain attack range per level.
passive.details: Tristana gains bonus attack range as she levels, eventually having one of the longest ranges in the game.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.summary: Gain massive attack speed for a few seconds.
abilities.details: Tristana gains bonus attack speed for several seconds.

abilities.name: Rocket Jump
abilities.summary: Jump to a location; resets on kills and E explosions.
abilities.details: Tristana rockets to a location, dealing damage and slowing on landing. Kills and fully stacked E explosions reset the cooldown.

abilities.name: Explosive Charge
abilities.summary: Place a bomb that explodes after 4 stacks from attacks.
abilities.details: Tristana places a bomb on a target that arms over time or with her attacks. After 4 stacks, it explodes dealing massive damage.

abilities.name: Buster Shot
abilities.summary: Knock back an enemy with a blast.
abilities.details: Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing damage and knocking back the target. Can add E stacks.

playstyle.identity: Trundle is a stat-stealing troll who gets stronger by weakening enemies. His pillar creates terrain for zone control and his R steals tank stats.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals when enemies die nearby. Q empowers auto and steals AD. W creates a zone where you move faster and attack faster. E creates a pillar that slows and blocks. R steals enemy armor/MR, making tanks squishier and you tankier.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Trundle spikes at level 6 against tanks. Divine Sunderer scales him. He's strong at dueling tanks and disrupting with pillar.

passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.summary: Heal when enemy units die nearby.
passive.details: When any enemy unit dies nearby, Trundle heals for a percentage of their max health.

abilities.name: Chomp
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to deal bonus damage and steal AD.
abilities.details: Trundle bites a target, dealing bonus damage and stealing their attack damage for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Frozen Domain
abilities.summary: Create a zone that increases your attack speed, movement speed, and healing.
abilities.details: Trundle coats an area in ice, gaining bonus attack speed, movement speed, and increased healing while standing in it.

abilities.name: Pillar of Ice
abilities.summary: Create a pillar of ice that knocks aside and slows enemies.
abilities.details: Trundle creates a pillar of ice that acts as terrain, knocking enemies aside and slowing those around it.

abilities.name: Subjugate
abilities.summary: Steal armor and magic resist from an enemy.
abilities.details: Trundle drains a portion of an enemy's armor and magic resist, adding it to his own for several seconds.

playstyle.identity: Tryndamere is a splitpushing melee carry who cannot die during his ultimate. He builds fury for crits and is one of the best 1v1 duelists in the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive builds fury for crit chance. Q consumes fury to heal (more heal at low HP). W slows and reduces AD if enemies face away. E spins through enemies (reduced CD on crits). R makes you unable to die for 5 seconds. Split push, R to survive, clean up.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Tryndamere spikes at level 6 with his immortality and with Kraken/Navori. He's a late-game splitpush monster.

passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.summary: Build fury for critical strike chance.
passive.details: Tryndamere gains fury when attacking and being attacked. More fury gives higher critical strike chance.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.summary: Passive: gain AD based on missing health. Active: heal and consume fury.
abilities.details: Passive: Tryndamere gains bonus AD based on missing health. Active: He consumes fury to heal, healing more at low health.

abilities.name: Mocking Shout
abilities.summary: Slow enemies facing away and reduce their AD.
abilities.details: Tryndamere shouts, reducing nearby enemies' attack damage. Enemies facing away are also slowed.

abilities.name: Spinning Slash
abilities.summary: Spin through enemies dealing damage; cooldown reduced by crits.
abilities.details: Tryndamere spins through enemies, dealing damage. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown.

abilities.name: Undying Rage
abilities.summary: Become unable to die for 5 seconds.
abilities.details: Tryndamere becomes unkillable for 5 seconds, unable to drop below 1 HP no matter how much damage he takes.

champions.name: Twisted Fate
champions.title: the Card Master

playstyle.identity: Twisted Fate is a global roaming mage whose ultimate teleports him anywhere on the map. He excels at side-lane ganks and his gold card provides point-and-click CC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives extra gold on kills. Q throws cards in a line. W cycles cards - Gold stuns, Red slows and damages nearby, Blue restores mana. E gives attack speed and every 4th auto does bonus damage. R reveals all enemies and allows teleport.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Twisted Fate spikes at level 6 with global presence. Rapid Firecannon extends gold card range. He's strong with map plays.

weaknesses: R has channel that can be interrupted

passive.name: Loaded Dice
passive.summary: Gain extra gold on kills.
passive.details: Twisted Fate gains bonus gold each time he kills a unit.

abilities.name: Wild Cards
abilities.summary: Throw three cards in a line.
abilities.details: Twisted Fate throws three cards in a spread, dealing damage to enemies they pass through.

abilities.name: Pick a Card
abilities.summary: Cycle cards; pick Gold to stun, Red to slow AoE, Blue to restore mana.
abilities.details: Twisted Fate cycles cards above his head. Selecting a card empowers his next auto: Gold stuns, Red slows and damages around target, Blue restores mana.

abilities.name: Stacked Deck
abilities.summary: Gain attack speed; every 4th attack deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Twisted Fate gains attack speed. Every fourth auto deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Destiny
abilities.summary: Reveal all enemies; recast to teleport anywhere on the map.
abilities.details: Twisted Fate reveals all enemy champions. While active, he can recast to teleport to any location on the map.

playstyle.identity: Twitch is a stealth ADC who ambushes from invisibility. His ultimate makes autos pierce through enemies, enabling team-wiping moments.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive poisons (stacks to 6). Q goes invisible then gives attack speed on reveal. W throws a cask that slows. E detonates poison stacks for damage. R gives range and makes autos pierce through all enemies. Stealth flank, R, mow down the whole team.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Twitch spikes with Runaan's for R piercing bolts. Kraken and crit scale him. He's a late-game teamfight carry.

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.summary: Auto attacks apply poison stacks.
passive.details: Twitch's basic attacks apply stacks of venom that deal true damage over time, stacking up to 6 times.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.summary: Go invisible; gain attack speed when revealed.
abilities.details: Twitch becomes camouflaged after a delay. When he reveals himself or attacks, he gains bonus attack speed.

abilities.name: Venom Cask
abilities.summary: Throw a cask that slows and applies poison.
abilities.details: Twitch throws a cask that slows enemies in an area and applies stacks of Deadly Venom.

abilities.name: Contaminate
abilities.summary: Detonate poison stacks on nearby enemies for damage.
abilities.details: Twitch detonates all venom stacks on nearby enemies, dealing physical damage per stack.

abilities.name: Spray and Pray
abilities.summary: Gain range and AD; autos pierce through all enemies.
abilities.details: Twitch gains bonus AD and attack range. His attacks become piercing bolts that pass through all enemies in a line.

playstyle.identity: Udyr is a stance-swapping bruiser who charges through enemies with bear form. His reworked kit offers more versatility and teamfight impact.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities are stances you swap between; awakening them adds power. Q (Wilding Claw) empowers autos with lightning. W (Iron Mantle) shields and heals. E (Blazing Stampede) stuns on first hit per target. R (Wingborne Storm) creates a storm around you. Cycle stances for max DPS.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Udyr spikes early with ganks and at level 6 with R awakening. Trinity Force or tank works. He's strong early-mid running at enemies.

passive.name: Bridge Between
passive.summary: Cycle stances to awaken them for bonus effects.
passive.details: Udyr has 4 stances. Swapping builds Awakened stacks. At 2 stacks, the next stance is Awakened with bonus effects.

abilities.name: Wilding Claw
abilities.summary: Empowers attacks with lightning damage. Awakened: lightning strikes after attacks.
abilities.details: Udyr empowers his next two attacks with bonus damage. Awakened: Auto attacks call down lightning that bounces to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Iron Mantle
abilities.summary: Gain shield and heal on attacks. Awakened: massive shield and heal.
abilities.details: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Awakened: Shield and healing are significantly increased.

abilities.name: Blazing Stampede
abilities.summary: Gain speed and stun the first enemy hit. Awakened: immune to CC briefly.
abilities.details: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack on each enemy stuns them. Awakened: Become immune to crowd control briefly.

abilities.name: Wingborne Storm
abilities.summary: Create a storm that damages enemies around you. Awakened: massive storm.
abilities.details: Udyr creates a glacial storm around him that slows and damages enemies. Awakened: The storm is much larger and deals more damage.

playstyle.identity: Urgot is a juggernaut with shotgun knees who executes low-health enemies. He excels at extended trades and can pull enemies into his meat grinder.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: shotgun knees fire on autos, rotating around him (each knee has CD). Q slows in an area. W toggles rapid fire at reduced damage. E dashes and flips first enemy hit. R fires a drill that slows - at low HP, recast to execute and fear nearby enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Urgot spikes at level 9 with max W and at 6 with execute. Black Cleaver stacks fast with W. He's strong in extended fights.

passive.name: Echoing Flames
passive.summary: Auto attacks near enemies trigger shotgun knees dealing percent health damage.
passive.details: Urgot's six legs each have a shotgun that fires when he auto attacks in that direction, dealing percent max health damage. Each knee has a separate cooldown.

abilities.name: Corrosive Charge
abilities.summary: Fire a bomb that slows enemies in an area.
abilities.details: Urgot fires a canister that explodes at a location, dealing damage and slowing enemies.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.summary: Toggle rapid fire at reduced damage; shields when maxed.
abilities.details: Urgot toggles rapid auto attacks at reduced damage. Attacks automatically target lowest health enemy. At max rank, has no mana cost and shields Urgot.

abilities.name: Disdain
abilities.summary: Dash and flip the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Urgot charges forward, shielding himself. The first enemy hit is stunned and flipped behind him.

abilities.name: Fear Beyond Death
abilities.summary: Fire a drill; at low HP, recast to execute and fear enemies.
abilities.details: Urgot fires a drill that impales the first champion hit, slowing them. If the target drops below 25% HP, recast to reel them in and execute them, fearing nearby enemies.

playstyle.identity: Varus is a poke ADC with a long-range sniper Q and spreading corruption ultimate. He excels at poking from range and can build AP for on-hit or AD for poke.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives attack speed on kills. Q charges for long-range damage. W stacks blight - popping stacks deals percent health. E is AoE slow. R fires corruption that spreads between enemies, rooting them. Poke with Q, R to start fights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Varus spikes with lethality for Q poke or on-hit for DPS. Level 6 adds engage with R. He's strong at poking and starting fights.

passive.name: Living Vengeance
passive.summary: Gain attack speed on kills.
passive.details: Killing a unit grants Varus bonus attack speed. Champion kills grant more attack speed.

abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
abilities.summary: Charge and fire a long-range arrow.
abilities.details: Varus charges his bow, increasing range and damage. Release to fire an arrow that damages all enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
abilities.summary: Autos apply blight; abilities detonate blight for percent health damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks apply Blight stacks. Abilities consume Blight stacks to deal bonus percent max health damage.

abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
abilities.summary: Fire arrows at an area that slow and apply Grievous Wounds.
abilities.details: Varus fires a hail of arrows at an area, dealing damage and creating a zone that slows enemies and applies Grievous Wounds.

abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
abilities.summary: Fire corruption that roots and spreads to nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Varus fires a tendril of corruption that roots the first enemy hit. The corruption then spreads to nearby enemies, rooting them after a delay.

playstyle.identity: Vayne is a tank-killing ADC with true damage on every third hit. Her tumble and invisibility make her slippery while she melts anyone regardless of armor.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives movement speed toward enemies. Q tumbles and empowers auto. W deals true damage every third hit (percent max health). E pushes enemy back, stunning if they hit terrain. R gives AD and makes Q grant invisibility. Kite with Q tumbles, W shreds tanks.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vayne spikes with attack speed items. Kraken and Guinsoo's maximize her DPS. She's a late-game hypercarry.

passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.summary: Gain movement speed when moving toward enemy champions.
passive.details: Vayne gains bonus movement speed when moving toward a visible enemy champion.

abilities.name: Tumble
abilities.summary: Roll and empower next auto to deal bonus damage.
abilities.details: Vayne tumbles a short distance and empowers her next basic attack to deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Silver Bolts
abilities.summary: Every third attack on the same target deals true damage.
abilities.details: Vayne's attacks apply silver bolts. On the third attack against the same target, the bolts detonate dealing percent max health true damage.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.summary: Knock back an enemy; stun if they hit terrain.
abilities.details: Vayne fires a heavy bolt that knocks back an enemy. If they hit terrain, they're stunned and take bonus damage.

abilities.name: Final Hour
abilities.summary: Gain AD and bonus passive speed; Tumble grants invisibility.
abilities.details: Vayne gains bonus attack damage and triple the movement speed from Night Hunter. Tumble also grants brief invisibility.

playstyle.identity: Veigar is an infinite-scaling burst mage who becomes stronger with every ability hit. His cage and ultimate execute make him devastating in late game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks AP permanently from ability hits. Q fires two bolts. W drops a meteor after delay. E creates a cage that stuns enemies who touch the walls. R is a point-and-click nuke that scales with enemy missing health. Stack AP, cage, then one-shot.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Veigar spikes at AP thresholds and level 6. Rabadon's amplifies his passive. He's a late-game hyper-scaling mage.

passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.summary: Gain permanent AP from hitting abilities and takedowns.
passive.details: Veigar gains permanent ability power when hitting enemies with abilities. Champion takedowns grant bonus stacks.

abilities.name: Baleful Strike
abilities.summary: Fire two bolts that grant AP stacks on hit.
abilities.details: Veigar fires a bolt that damages the first two enemies. Killing units grants permanent AP.

abilities.name: Dark Matter
abilities.summary: Drop a meteor after a delay; cooldown reduced by stacks.
abilities.details: Veigar calls down a meteor at a location after a delay. Stacking his passive reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.summary: Create a cage that stuns enemies who touch the walls.
abilities.details: Veigar creates a cage of energy. Enemies who touch the walls are stunned.

abilities.name: Primordial Burst
abilities.summary: Blast an enemy for massive damage, increased by their missing health.
abilities.details: Veigar blasts an enemy with primordial energy, dealing massive magic damage that increases based on their missing health.

playstyle.identity: Vel'Koz is an artillery mage who researches enemies to deal true damage. His abilities combo together to stack his passive for bonus damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: 3 ability hits = true damage proc. Q fires a bolt that can split at angles. W creates a line that erupts. E knocks up in an area. R channels a massive laser that constantly stacks and procs passive. Hit abilities to stack passive, then R for massive damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vel'Koz spikes at level 6 with his laser ultimate. Luden's scales his poke. He's strong at poking and teamfighting.

passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
passive.summary: After 3 ability hits, deal true damage.
passive.details: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Deconstruction stacks. At 3 stacks, the enemy takes bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Plasma Fission
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt that can split at 90 degree angles.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz fires a bolt that slows. It can split into two bolts at 90-degree angles on recast or at max range.

abilities.name: Void Rift
abilities.summary: Create a rift that erupts for damage.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz opens a rift that deals damage immediately and again after a delay when it erupts.

abilities.name: Tectonic Disruption
abilities.summary: Disrupt the ground, knocking up enemies.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz disrupts a patch of ground, knocking up and damaging enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Lifeform Disintegration Ray
abilities.summary: Channel a laser that deals damage and stacks passive.
abilities.details: Vel'Koz channels a beam of energy, dealing damage per second and slowing enemies. Each tick applies and procs his passive, dealing true damage.

playstyle.identity: Vex is an anti-mobility mage who fears enemies who dash near her. Her ultimate lets her dive into the backline and reset on kills.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: periodically fear enemies hit by abilities; dashing near her grants Doom faster. Q fires a wave. W fears around her and shields. E sends shadow that damages and marks. R fires a projectile - hit enemy to dash to them (resets on kill). Anti-dash mage who dives.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vex spikes at level 6 with her dive ultimate. Luden's scales her burst. She's strong against mobile teams.

passive.name: Doom 'n' Gloom
passive.summary: Periodically fear with abilities; enemies dashing near her speed this up.
passive.details: Vex periodically becomes empowered with Doom - her next ability fears enemies. Enemies dashing near her generate Doom faster and are marked with Gloom for bonus damage.

abilities.name: Mistral Bolt
abilities.summary: Fire a wave that damages and accelerates.
abilities.details: Vex fires a wave of mist that damages enemies and gains speed as it travels.

abilities.name: Personal Space
abilities.summary: Gain a shield and damage/fear enemies around you.
abilities.details: Vex gains a shield and emits a shockwave that damages nearby enemies. Applies Doom fear if available.

abilities.name: Looming Darkness
abilities.summary: Send your shadow to mark and slow enemies.
abilities.details: Vex sends Shadow to a location. It deals damage, slows enemies, and marks them with Gloom.

abilities.name: Shadow Surge
abilities.summary: Fire Shadow; hitting an enemy lets you dash to them. Resets on kill.
abilities.details: Vex fires Shadow forward. If it hits an enemy, she can recast to dash to them, dealing damage on arrival. Resets on champion kills within a few seconds.

playstyle.identity: Vi is a diving bruiser who punches through anything to reach her target. Her ultimate is unstoppable and guarantees reaching the backline.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive shields on ability hit. Q charges a dash that knocks back (longer charge = more distance). W shreds armor with hits. E empowers autos with AoE. R is unstoppable - dash to target, knocking aside anyone in the way, then knockup. R to reach carries.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vi spikes at level 6 with her guaranteed engage. Eclipse and bruiser items scale her. She's strong at diving priority targets.

passive.name: Blast Shield
passive.summary: Gain a shield when hitting with an ability.
passive.details: Vi gains a shield when she hits an enemy with an ability. Has a cooldown.

abilities.name: Vault Breaker
abilities.summary: Charge and dash forward, knocking back enemies.
abilities.details: Vi charges up a dash. On release, she dashes forward, damaging and knocking back all enemies hit.

abilities.name: Denting Blows
abilities.summary: Every third hit shreds armor and deals percent max health damage.
abilities.details: Every third attack on the same target deals bonus percent max health damage and reduces their armor.

abilities.name: Relentless Force
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to deal AoE damage.
abilities.details: Vi empowers her next auto attack to deal bonus damage in a cone behind the target.

abilities.name: Assault and Battery
abilities.summary: Dash to a target unstoppably, knocking aside enemies and suppressing on arrival.
abilities.details: Vi becomes unstoppable and dashes to an enemy champion, knocking aside anyone in her way. On arrival, she knocks up and damages the target.

playstyle.identity: Viego is the Ruined King who possesses enemies he kills. He becomes the slain champion temporarily, enabling unique outplays with stolen abilities.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: killing champions leaves a wraith - possess to become them with their abilities. Q stabs and marks (auto on marked heals). W charges a dash that stuns. E creates camouflage mist. R blinks to execute lowest HP enemy in range. Kill, possess, repeat.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Viego spikes with BOTRK and at level 6. He's strong when he gets resets and can possess multiple enemies.

passive.name: Sovereign's Domination
passive.summary: Killed enemies leave wraiths; possess them to become that champion.
passive.details: Enemies killed by Viego or who die nearby leave behind a wraith. Viego can possess wraiths to become that champion temporarily, healing and gaining their basic abilities.

abilities.name: Blade of the Ruined King
abilities.summary: Stab forward; auto attacks on marked targets heal you.
abilities.details: Passive: Viego's attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Marked enemy autos heal Viego. Active: Stab forward dealing damage and applying the mark.

abilities.name: Spectral Maw
abilities.summary: Charge and dash, stunning the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Viego charges up a dash. On release, he dashes forward, stunning the first enemy hit. Longer charge = longer stun.

abilities.name: Harrowed Path
abilities.summary: Create a mist that camouflages and speeds you.
abilities.details: Viego creates a wall of mist that spreads along terrain. While in the mist, he becomes camouflaged and gains attack speed and movement speed.

abilities.name: Heartbreaker
abilities.summary: Blink and execute the lowest HP enemy in range.
abilities.details: Viego becomes untargetable and blinks to a location, attacking the lowest health enemy nearby for percent missing health damage.

playstyle.identity: Viktor is a scaling control mage who upgrades his abilities throughout the game. His laser and gravity field provide excellent zone control.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: upgrade abilities by farming (augmented abilities are stronger). Q shields and empowers next auto. W creates a slow field that stuns after delay. E fires a laser that can be bent. R creates a moving storm. Farm augments, control zones with W and R.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Viktor spikes with each augment (Q first usually) and after full upgrades. Luden's scales him. He's a late-game scaling mage.

passive.name: Glorious Evolution
passive.summary: Farm to upgrade abilities with Hex Core.
passive.details: Viktor starts with a Hex Core that upgrades. He gains Hex Fragments from killing minions and champions. At thresholds, he can augment his abilities.

abilities.name: Siphon Power
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt that shields you; next auto deals bonus damage. Augmented: speed boost.
abilities.details: Viktor fires a device that damages and returns to grant him a shield. His next auto deals bonus damage. Augmented: Also grants movement speed.

abilities.name: Gravity Field
abilities.summary: Create a zone that slows and stuns after duration. Augmented: slows more.
abilities.details: Viktor creates a field that slows enemies. After a delay or reaching full stacks, enemies inside are stunned. Augmented: Also pulls enemies toward the center.

abilities.name: Death Ray
abilities.summary: Fire a laser in a line that can be bent. Augmented: explodes after a delay.
abilities.details: Viktor fires a laser that he can direct, dealing damage in a line. Augmented: The laser also explodes after a delay.

abilities.name: Chaos Storm
abilities.summary: Create a storm that follows enemies and deals damage over time. Augmented: moves faster.
abilities.details: Viktor creates a chaos storm that deals damage and silences on impact, then deals damage over time while following enemies. Augmented: Storm moves faster.

playstyle.identity: Vladimir is a resourceless drain mage who scales into a late-game monster. His pool makes him untargetable and he sustains through fights with healing.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive converts HP to AP and AP to HP. Q drains (empowered Q heals more). W pools, becoming untargetable (costs HP). E charges and releases AoE damage (costs HP). R marks enemies to take more damage and heals Vlad after. Sustain through laning, scale to teamfight monster.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vladimir spikes with levels and at CDR breakpoints. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. He's a late-game hyperscaling mage.

passive.name: Crimson Pact
passive.summary: Bonus health gives AP; AP gives bonus health.
passive.details: Vladimir gains ability power based on his bonus health and bonus health based on his ability power.

abilities.name: Transfusion
abilities.summary: Drain an enemy for damage and healing. Empowered Q heals more.
abilities.details: Vladimir drains health from an enemy. After casting it several times, his next Q is empowered to deal more damage and heal significantly more.

abilities.name: Sanguine Pool
abilities.summary: Sink into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable and slowing enemies.
abilities.details: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable. He slows enemies above him and drains their health. Costs health to use.

abilities.name: Tides of Blood
abilities.summary: Charge and release a burst of blood that damages enemies.
abilities.details: Vladimir charges up blood, then releases it in a nova around him dealing damage. Costs health and deals more damage when charged longer.

abilities.name: Hemoplague
abilities.summary: Infect enemies to take more damage; heals Vladimir when it detonates.
abilities.details: Vladimir infects enemies in an area, causing them to take increased damage. After a delay, the infection detonates, dealing damage and healing Vladimir for each champion hit.

champions.name: Volibear
champions.title: the Relentless Storm

playstyle.identity: Volibear is a diving juggernaut who disables towers with his ultimate. He excels at tower diving and becomes an unstoppable force in teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives attack speed stacks that chain lightning. Q gives speed and stuns on next auto. W bites and heals (more damage if used twice quickly). E creates a shield zone from the sky. R leaps and disables towers, gaining size and HP. Tower dive with impunity.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Volibear spikes at level 6 with tower disabling. Trinity Force or tank items work. He's strong at diving and teamfighting.

weaknesses: W needs 2 hits for full effect

passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.summary: Attacks grant stacking attack speed; at max stacks, lightning chains.
passive.details: Volibear's attacks grant attack speed stacks. At max stacks, his attacks chain lightning to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Thundering Smash
abilities.summary: Gain speed toward enemies; next attack stuns and deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: Volibear gains movement speed toward enemies. His next auto attack deals bonus damage and stuns the target.

abilities.name: Frenzied Maul
abilities.summary: Bite an enemy; heal if used twice quickly on same target.
abilities.details: Volibear mauls a target, dealing damage. If he hits the same target again within a few seconds, he deals bonus damage and heals.

abilities.name: Sky Splitter
abilities.summary: Call lightning that shields you and damages enemies in the zone.
abilities.details: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location. If he's inside when it strikes, he gains a shield. Enemies in the zone take damage.

abilities.name: Stormbringer
abilities.summary: Leap and crash down, disabling towers and gaining HP and size.
abilities.details: Volibear leaps to a location, gaining bonus health and size. On landing, he damages enemies and disables nearby enemy towers for several seconds.

playstyle.identity: Warwick is a sustain-heavy jungler who hunts low-health enemies. His blood scent reveals and speeds him toward wounded targets, making him excellent at chasing.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals on autos (more at low HP). Q lunges and heals (hold to follow dashes/flashes). W senses low HP enemies globally, giving speed. E fears enemies around you. R leaps in a line, suppressing first champion hit. Hunt wounded enemies with W speed, R to catch.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Warwick spikes early with dueling and at 6 with engage. Titanic Hydra or tank items work. He's strong early-mid at chasing.

passive.name: Eternal Hunger
passive.summary: Auto attacks heal; heals more at low health.
passive.details: Warwick's basic attacks heal him. The healing increases when Warwick is low on health.

abilities.name: Jaws of the Beast
abilities.summary: Lunge and bite; hold to follow the enemy's movement.
abilities.details: Warwick lunges at an enemy, dealing damage and healing himself. Holding the button makes Warwick follow the target if they dash or flash.

abilities.name: Blood Hunt
abilities.summary: Sense low health enemies globally; gain speed toward them.
abilities.details: Passive: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health globally, gaining movement speed toward them. Active: The next hunt triggers on any enemy.

abilities.name: Primal Howl
abilities.summary: Reduce damage taken; recast or wait to fear nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Warwick howls, gaining damage reduction. After a duration or on recast, he fears all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Infinite Duress
abilities.summary: Leap forward and suppress the first champion hit.
abilities.details: Warwick leaps in a direction, suppressing the first champion hit and dealing damage over time while healing himself.

playstyle.identity: Wukong is a trickster diver who can clone himself and knock up entire teams with his spinning ultimate. He excels at teamfight disruption and assassinating carries.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gains armor/MR near enemies. Q extends staff and reduces armor. W creates a clone and stealths briefly (clone attacks). E dashes to target and clones attack. R spins, knocking up and gaining movement speed. W to juke, E in, R for teamfight knockups.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Wukong spikes at level 6 with double knockup (R can be cast twice). Divine Sunderer or bruiser items work. He's strong at teamfighting and diving.

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.summary: Gain armor and health regen near enemies.
passive.details: Wukong gains bonus armor and health regeneration for each nearby enemy champion.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.summary: Next attack extends range and reduces armor.
abilities.details: Wukong's next auto attack gains range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor.

abilities.name: Warrior Trickster
abilities.summary: Become invisible and leave a clone that attacks.
abilities.details: Wukong becomes invisible briefly and creates a clone that attacks nearby enemies. The clone can trigger on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Nimbus Strike
abilities.summary: Dash to an enemy; clone also dashes to nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Wukong dashes to a target enemy, dealing damage and gaining attack speed. His clone also dashes to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.summary: Spin to knock up enemies; can cast twice.
abilities.details: Wukong spins his staff, knocking up and damaging nearby enemies while gaining movement speed. He can cast this ability a second time within a short window.

playstyle.identity: Xayah is a feather-recalling ADC who can become untargetable during her ultimate. She excels when fighting with Rakan and at rooting enemies who step in her feather lines.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: abilities leave feathers. Q throws 2 feathers. W gives attack speed and lets autos pass through (leaves feathers). E recalls all feathers, rooting enemies hit by 3+. R throws feathers and goes untargetable. Set up feathers, E to root, combo with Rakan.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Xayah spikes at level 6 with her safety R. Kraken and crit scale her. She's strong with good feather setup and Rakan.

passive.name: Clean Cuts
passive.summary: Abilities throw feathers that stay on the ground.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Xayah's next autos throw feathers that pass through targets and drop on the ground behind them.

abilities.name: Double Daggers
abilities.summary: Throw two feathers that deal damage in a line.
abilities.details: Xayah throws two daggers that deal damage to all enemies they pass through, each leaving a feather.

abilities.name: Deadly Plumage
abilities.summary: Gain attack speed; autos pass through and leave feathers.
abilities.details: Xayah creates a storm of blades, gaining attack speed. Her autos deal increased damage, pass through targets, and leave feathers. If Rakan is nearby, he also gains the buff.

abilities.name: Bladecaller
abilities.summary: Recall all feathers; root enemies hit by 3+.
abilities.details: Xayah recalls all feathers, dealing damage to enemies they pass through. Enemies hit by 3 or more feathers are rooted.

abilities.name: Featherstorm
abilities.summary: Become untargetable and throw a fan of feathers.
abilities.details: Xayah leaps into the air, becoming untargetable, then throws a fan of feathers that damage enemies.

playstyle.identity: Xerath is a long-range artillery mage who bombards enemies from extreme distance. His ultimate can snipe enemies across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: autos restore mana. Q charges to extend range. W creates a zone that slows and damages. E stuns (longer range = longer stun). R locks in place and fires 3-5 long-range shots. Poke with Q-W, E for peel, R to snipe from afar.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Xerath spikes with mana and ability haste. Luden's scales his poke. He's strong at siege and poking safely.

passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.summary: Auto attacks restore mana.
passive.details: Xerath's auto attacks periodically restore mana.

abilities.name: Arcanopulse
abilities.summary: Charge and release a long-range beam.
abilities.details: Xerath charges up, increasing range. On release, he fires a beam that damages all enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Eye of Destruction
abilities.summary: Call down a blast that slows and damages, more in center.
abilities.details: Xerath calls down a blast at a location, dealing damage and slowing. Enemies in the center take more damage and are slowed more.

abilities.name: Shocking Orb
abilities.summary: Fire an orb that stuns; longer travel = longer stun.
abilities.details: Xerath fires an orb that stuns the first enemy hit. The stun duration increases based on travel distance.

abilities.name: Rite of the Arcane
abilities.summary: Root yourself and fire 3-5 long-range shots.
abilities.details: Xerath roots himself in place and fires a barrage of shots at extreme range, each dealing damage on impact.

playstyle.identity: Xin Zhao is a straightforward duelist who excels at diving single targets. His ultimate creates a safe zone that blocks projectiles from outside.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals every 3rd hit. Q empowers 3 autos, 3rd knocks up. W slashes then thrusts (thrust slows). E dashes to target and slows. R knocks back enemies and creates a zone - outside projectiles are blocked. E-Q-W combo to duel, R to isolate in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Xin Zhao spikes early with dueling and at 6 with his isolation R. Eclipse or bruiser items work. He's strong at early ganks and 1v1s.

passive.name: Determination
passive.summary: Every third attack heals.
passive.details: Every third attack heals Xin Zhao.

abilities.name: Three Talon Strike
abilities.summary: Empower next 3 attacks; third knocks up.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao empowers his next 3 auto attacks to deal bonus damage. The third attack knocks the target up.

abilities.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
abilities.summary: Slash, then thrust; thrust slows enemies.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao slashes in a cone, then thrusts forward. The thrust slows enemies and has higher range.

abilities.name: Audacious Charge
abilities.summary: Dash to an enemy, slowing them and nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao dashes to an enemy, dealing damage and slowing them and nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Crescent Guard
abilities.summary: Knock back enemies and create a zone that blocks outside projectiles.
abilities.details: Xin Zhao sweeps his spear, knocking back enemies (except the last one hit by abilities). He creates a zone around him that blocks all projectiles from outside.

champions.name: Yasuo
champions.title: the Unforgiven

playstyle.identity: Yasuo is a high-skill skirmisher who dances through fights with dashes and wind. His double crit passive and wind wall create outplay opportunities that can turn losing fights into pentakills.
playstyle.howToPlay: Stack Q (Steel Tempest) to third cast for the tornado knockup. Dash through minion waves with E to close gaps or dodge skillshots. Wind Wall blocks all projectiles - save it for crucial abilities. Ult off any allied knockup for massive damage and armor pen.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yasuo spikes hard at level 2 with Q+E trades. He reaches 100% crit with just two items thanks to his passive. His 2-item spike (typically IE + Shieldbow) is one of the strongest in the game.

strengths: Double crit chance lets him spike at 2 items
Infinite dashes through minions for mobility
Can ult off any knockup, including allies
weaknesses: Squishy and often dives too deep
Needs minions nearby for full mobility
High skill floor - easy to int on

passive.name: Way of the Wanderer
passive.summary: Double critical strike chance and gain a shield when moving.
passive.details: Yasuo gains double crit chance from all sources, reaching 100% with just two crit items. Additionally, moving generates Flow - when full, the next enemy damage he takes is blocked by a shield. The shield helps survive burst and makes trades favorable.

abilities.name: Steel Tempest
abilities.summary: Thrust forward; on third cast, unleash a knockup tornado.
abilities.details: Yasuo thrusts his sword, dealing damage in a line. Hitting an enemy grants a stack (2 stacks max). At 2 stacks, the next Q fires a tornado that knocks up all enemies hit. Q can crit and its cooldown scales with attack speed. Stack it constantly in lane.

abilities.name: Wind Wall
abilities.summary: Create a wall that blocks all enemy projectiles.
abilities.details: Yasuo creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for several seconds. This includes auto-attacks, abilities, and even some ultimates. It's your key defensive tool - save it for crucial moments like blocking ADC autos in teamfights or stopping key abilities.

abilities.name: Sweeping Blade
abilities.summary: Dash through an enemy; each dash increases damage.
abilities.details: Yasuo dashes through a target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each dash increases the damage of subsequent dashes (stacking up to twice). You can only dash through each target once every few seconds. Use minions to close gaps, dodge skillshots, or escape.

abilities.name: Last Breath
abilities.summary: Blink to airborne enemies, suspend them, and gain armor penetration.
abilities.details: Yasuo blinks to any visible airborne enemy champion (from any source), suspending all nearby airborne enemies and dealing damage. For 15 seconds after, his crits ignore bonus armor. You can ult off ally knockups like Malphite R or even jungle camp knockups.

playstyle.identity: Yone is Yasuo's brother who wields two swords and can leave his body to dive enemies. He has similar Q stacking but with a guaranteed spirit form engage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: every 2nd auto deals magic damage. Q thrusts (stacks to dash like Yasuo). W shields and damages in a cone. E leaves body and gains ramping damage - snap back after. R blinks behind enemies and knocks them up. E-R for massive engage, Q3 for knockup.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yone spikes at level 3 with combo and level 6 for engage. BOTRK and crit scale him. He's strong mid-late with dives.

passive.name: Way of the Hunter
passive.summary: Every second auto deals bonus magic damage; crits deal reduced damage.
passive.details: Every second auto attack deals bonus magic damage. Yone also gains double crit chance from items but crits deal reduced damage.

abilities.name: Mortal Steel
abilities.summary: Thrust forward; at 2 stacks, dash and knock up.
abilities.details: Yone thrusts forward, dealing damage. On hit, he gains a stack. At 2 stacks, the next Q dashes through enemies, knocking them up.

abilities.name: Spirit Cleave
abilities.summary: Slash in a cone, gaining a shield based on enemies hit.
abilities.details: Yone slashes in a cone dealing magic and physical damage. He gains a shield that scales with the number of champions hit.

abilities.name: Soul Unbound
abilities.summary: Leave your body to dive; snap back after, dealing stored damage.
abilities.details: Yone enters spirit form, gaining movement speed and leaving his body behind. After a duration or recast, he snaps back, dealing a percentage of all damage dealt during spirit form.

abilities.name: Fate Sealed
abilities.summary: Blink behind all enemies in a line and knock them up.
abilities.details: Yone blinks forward, pulling all enemies in the path behind him and knocking them up.

champions.name: Yorick
champions.title: Shepherd of Souls

playstyle.identity: Yorick is a splitpushing juggernaut who summons ghouls and a Maiden to push lanes. He excels at taking towers and 1v1ing while his army overwhelms enemies.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: graves spawn from dead enemies. Q empowers auto and raises ghouls from graves. W creates a ring of terrain (traps enemies). E marks enemies (ghouls jump to marked). R summons Maiden who raises ghouls and pushes with you. Split push with Maiden, trap with W.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yorick spikes at level 6 with Maiden. Hullbreaker makes him a split monster. He's strong at taking towers.

weaknesses: W can be walked out of

passive.name: Shepherd of Souls
passive.summary: Enemies that die nearby spawn graves; Q raises ghouls from graves.
passive.details: Enemies that die near Yorick have a chance to spawn a grave. Yorick can raise ghouls from graves with Q.

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to deal bonus damage and heal; raise ghouls from graves.
abilities.details: Yorick empowers his next auto to deal bonus damage and heal him. If there are graves nearby, he raises ghouls from them.

abilities.name: Dark Procession
abilities.summary: Create a ring of terrain that traps enemies.
abilities.details: Yorick summons a ring of corpses that acts as terrain. Enemies inside must destroy the wall or have a dash to escape.

abilities.name: Mourning Mist
abilities.summary: Throw mist that marks enemies; ghouls leap to marked targets.
abilities.details: Yorick throws a globule of mist that damages and marks the first enemy hit. Ghouls leap to and focus marked targets.

abilities.name: Eulogy of the Isles
abilities.summary: Summon the Maiden who fights alongside you and spawns ghouls.
abilities.details: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist who fights alongside him. The Maiden raises ghouls and pushes with Yorick until she dies.

playstyle.identity: Yunara is a marksman who deals sustained damage from the bot lane. She excels at kiting and dealing consistent damage in extended fights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Focus on farming and scaling. Position safely in teamfights and deal consistent damage while kiting back from threats. Use abilities to enhance your auto attacks and maintain distance from enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yunara spikes with her core marksman items. Kraken Slayer and crit items scale her damage. She's strongest in the mid to late game when fully itemized.

passive.name: Passive
passive.summary: Enhances auto attacks or abilities.
passive.details: Yunara's passive ability enhances her combat effectiveness.

abilities.name: Q Ability
abilities.summary: Primary damage ability.
abilities.details: Yunara's Q provides damage and utility for trading and fighting.

abilities.name: W Ability
abilities.summary: Secondary utility or damage ability.
abilities.details: Yunara's W provides additional options in combat.

abilities.name: E Ability
abilities.summary: Mobility or defensive ability.
abilities.details: Yunara's E helps with positioning or survival.

abilities.name: R Ability
abilities.summary: Ultimate ability with high impact.
abilities.details: Yunara's ultimate provides a powerful effect in teamfights or skirmishes.

playstyle.identity: Yuumi is an untargetable enchanter who attaches to allies. She provides healing and buffs while being impossible to kill as long as her host survives.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: autos restore mana and shield ally. Q fires a guided missile (buffed when attached). W attaches to ally (untargetable, gives adaptive force). E heals attached ally and gives speed. R waves that root on 3 hits. Attach to carry, detach to proc passive.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yuumi spikes with mana and AP. Moonstone enhances healing. She's strong attached to a fed carry.

passive.name: Bop 'n' Block
passive.summary: Auto attacks restore mana and shield ally when attached.
passive.details: Yuumi's next auto attack restores mana. If she's attached, she also grants her ally a shield.

abilities.name: Prowling Projectile
abilities.summary: Fire a missile that you can guide; empowered when attached.
abilities.details: Yuumi fires a missile that she can steer. If attached, the missile deals more damage and slows on hit.

abilities.name: You and Me!
abilities.summary: Attach to an ally, becoming untargetable and sharing stats.
abilities.details: Yuumi attaches to an ally, becoming untargetable. She shares her adaptive force with them. She can hop between allies.

abilities.name: Zoomies
abilities.summary: Heal attached ally and grant movement speed.
abilities.details: Yuumi heals herself or her attached ally and grants them bonus movement speed and attack speed.

abilities.name: Final Chapter
abilities.summary: Fire waves that root enemies hit 3 times.
abilities.details: Yuumi channels waves of magic damage. Enemies hit by three waves are rooted. Can be cast while attached.

playstyle.identity: Zaahen is a skirmisher who excels at extended duels and jungle clear. He can be played in both top lane and jungle, using his kit to outplay opponents in 1v1 situations.
playstyle.howToPlay: Look for isolated duels and extended trades where your sustained damage shines. In jungle, use efficient clear patterns and look for skirmish opportunities. In top, trade aggressively when abilities are available.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zaahen spikes with his first completed item. Trinity Force or bruiser items synergize well with his kit. He's strong in the mid-game with item advantages.

passive.name: Passive
passive.summary: Enhances combat effectiveness.
passive.details: Zaahen's passive provides sustained benefits in extended fights.

abilities.name: Q Ability
abilities.summary: Primary damage ability.
abilities.details: Zaahen's Q is his main damage tool for trading and clearing.

abilities.name: W Ability
abilities.summary: Secondary ability for utility or damage.
abilities.details: Zaahen's W provides additional options in combat situations.

abilities.name: E Ability
abilities.summary: Mobility or defensive ability.
abilities.details: Zaahen's E helps with gap closing or survival.

abilities.name: R Ability
abilities.summary: Ultimate ability with significant impact.
abilities.details: Zaahen's ultimate provides a powerful combat advantage.

playstyle.identity: Zac is a blob tank who bounces into teamfights and revives from his chunks. His engage range is massive and he provides tons of CC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: on death, split into chunks that reform you. Q grabs two things and slams together. W does AoE damage. E charges a massive leap. R bounces, knocking up and moving enemies. E from fog for surprise engage, Q to slam enemies together, R in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zac spikes at level 4-5 with E range and level 6 for R CC. Tank items scale him. He's strong at engage and teamfighting.

passive.name: Cell Division
passive.summary: Abilities drop blobs that heal. On death, split into 4 chunks that reform.
passive.details: Zac's abilities drop chunks of himself that he can pick up to heal. When he dies, he splits into 4 bloblets. If any survive, he reforms.

abilities.name: Stretching Strikes
abilities.summary: Grab two targets and slam them together.
abilities.details: Zac's next auto grabs an enemy. Hitting a second target slams them together, dealing damage and briefly stunning.

abilities.name: Unstable Matter
abilities.summary: Burst, dealing AoE percent health damage.
