abilities.details: Zac explodes, dealing percent max health damage to nearby enemies. Picking up blobs reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Elastic Slingshot
abilities.summary: Charge to slingshot and knock up enemies on landing.
abilities.details: Zac charges up, then launches himself to a location, knocking up enemies on landing. Longer charge = more range.

abilities.name: Let's Bounce!
abilities.summary: Bounce repeatedly, knocking up and moving enemies.
abilities.details: Zac bounces 4 times, each bounce knocking up enemies and moving them toward where he bounced.

playstyle.identity: Zed is a shadow-based assassin who marks enemies with his ultimate for delayed burst. He excels at diving carries and escaping with his shadows.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: autos deal bonus damage to low HP. Q throws shurikens. W sends shadow (recast to swap). E slashes around self and shadows. R dashes to enemy, marking them - damage dealt after R pops. W-E-Q poke, R to dive, W or R back to escape.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zed spikes at level 3 with W combo and level 6 for assassination. Lethality scales him. He's strong mid-game.

passive.name: Contempt for the Weak
passive.summary: Auto attacks deal bonus damage to low health enemies.
passive.details: Zed's auto attacks deal bonus magic damage to targets below 50% health. Each target has a cooldown.

abilities.name: Razor Shuriken
abilities.summary: Throw a shuriken in a line; shadows also throw.
abilities.details: Zed and his shadows throw shurikens that damage enemies in a line. Hitting the same target with multiple shurikens deals reduced damage.

abilities.name: Living Shadow
abilities.summary: Send out a shadow; recast to swap places.
abilities.details: Zed sends a shadow forward. Recasting swaps places with the shadow. The shadow mimics his Q and E.

abilities.name: Shadow Slash
abilities.summary: Slash around yourself and shadows, slowing enemies.
abilities.details: Zed and his shadows slash, damaging and slowing enemies around them.

abilities.name: Death Mark
abilities.summary: Dash to enemy, marking them. After a delay, the mark pops for stored damage.
abilities.details: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy, marking them. After 3 seconds, the mark pops, dealing damage based on a percentage of all damage dealt while marked.

playstyle.identity: Zeri is a mobile ADC whose autos are skillshots. Her ultimate gives her massive speed and chain lightning, making her a nightmare to catch in teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: charged autos steal shield. Q is her main auto-replacement skillshot. W pierces terrain. E dashes over walls. R gives speed and chain lightning on hit, stacking from hits. E over walls, Q as main damage, R to kite and stack in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zeri spikes at level 6 with her speed and at 3 items. Trinity Force or crit scale her. She's strong in extended teamfights.

passive.name: Living Battery
passive.summary: Auto attacks are skillshots; steal shields from enemies.
passive.details: Zeri's basic attacks deal magic damage and steal enemy shields. She gains shield when damaging shields.

abilities.name: Burst Fire
abilities.summary: Fire a burst of shots in a line (acts as her auto attack).
abilities.details: Zeri fires a burst of rounds that deal physical damage. This is treated as her basic attack and applies on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Ultrashock Laser
abilities.summary: Fire a laser that deals more damage through terrain.
abilities.details: Zeri fires an electric pulse. If it hits terrain, it becomes a long-range laser that slows and deals more damage.

abilities.name: Spark Surge
abilities.summary: Dash, gaining speed; can dash through terrain.
abilities.details: Zeri dashes a short distance, gaining attack speed. If she dashes into terrain, she vaults over it.

abilities.name: Lightning Crash
abilities.summary: Gain massive speed; attacks chain lightning. Stacks on hit.
abilities.details: Zeri discharges electricity, damaging nearby enemies and gaining massive movement speed and chain lightning on her attacks. Each hit extends the duration and adds stacks.

playstyle.identity: Ziggs is a poke and siege mage who excels at destroying towers. His bombs zone enemies and his ultimate can nuke from across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers autos periodically (faster on abilities). Q bounces bombs. W satchel charges (knock up, destroys low towers). E scatters mines. R throws a mega bomb cross-map. Poke with Q, W to execute towers or escape, R to snipe fights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ziggs spikes with ability haste and AP. Luden's scales his poke. He's strong at siege and poking.

passive.name: Short Fuse
passive.summary: Periodically empower auto attack for bonus damage.
passive.details: Ziggs's next auto attack periodically deals bonus magic damage. Abilities reduce the cooldown.

abilities.name: Bouncing Bomb
abilities.summary: Throw a bomb that bounces up to twice.
abilities.details: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that explodes on hitting an enemy or after bouncing twice.

abilities.name: Satchel Charge
abilities.summary: Place a charge that knocks up enemies; can destroy low-health towers.
abilities.details: Ziggs places a satchel that he can detonate to knock up enemies. It can also be used to knock himself away or execute low-health towers.

abilities.name: Hexplosive Minefield
abilities.summary: Scatter mines that slow and damage enemies.
abilities.details: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that arm after a moment. Enemies who step on them take damage and are slowed.

abilities.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
abilities.summary: Throw a massive bomb at long range that deals huge damage.
abilities.details: Ziggs throws a huge bomb that travels across the map and deals massive damage in an area. More damage at the center.

playstyle.identity: Zilean is a time mage who revives allies with his ultimate. He provides insane utility with speed-ups, slows, and his double-bomb stun.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: gives bonus XP to allies. Q places a time bomb (2 bombs on same target stun). W reduces Q/E cooldowns. E speeds ally or slows enemy. R puts an ally in stasis - they revive if they die. Double-bomb for stun, R to save carries.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zilean spikes at level 6 with revive and with CDR for double-bomb. Shurelya's adds utility. He's strong at protecting carries.

passive.name: Time in a Bottle
passive.summary: Store experience; grant it to level up allies.
passive.details: Zilean stores experience over time. He can use it to level up a nearby ally champion.

abilities.name: Time Bomb
abilities.summary: Place a bomb that detonates after a delay; 2 bombs stun.
abilities.details: Zilean places a time bomb that detonates after a few seconds. Placing two bombs on the same target stuns when the first detonates.

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.summary: Reduce Q and E cooldowns.
abilities.details: Zilean reduces the cooldowns of Time Bomb and Time Warp.

abilities.name: Time Warp
abilities.summary: Speed up an ally or slow an enemy.
abilities.details: Zilean bends time around a target. Allies are sped up; enemies are slowed.

abilities.name: Chronoshift
abilities.summary: Put an ally in stasis; if they die, they revive.
abilities.details: Zilean places a protective time rune on an ally. If they die within a few seconds, they enter stasis and revive with health.

playstyle.identity: Zoe is a trickster burst mage who one-shots with long-range bubbles and stars. She picks up summoner spells and item actives from minions.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers auto after abilities. Q throws a star - redirect for more distance/damage. W drops spell shards from minions (use enemy spells). E fires a sleepy bubble (through walls = longer range). R blinks then returns. E-Q-R for max range burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zoe spikes at level 3 and at 6 with poke. Luden's scales her burst. She's strong at picks with E.

passive.name: More Sparkles!
passive.summary: After casting an ability, next auto deals bonus damage.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Zoe's next auto attack deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Paddle Star
abilities.summary: Throw a star; redirect it for more damage based on distance.
abilities.details: Zoe throws a star that she can redirect. It deals more damage the further it travels before hitting.

abilities.name: Spell Thief
abilities.summary: Collect spell shards from minions; cast enemy summoner spells.
abilities.details: Enemy summoner spells and item actives drop spell shards. Zoe can pick them up and cast them. Casting grants movement speed and orbs.

abilities.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
abilities.summary: Fire a bubble that puts enemies to sleep; travels farther through walls.
abilities.details: Zoe throws a bubble that makes the first enemy hit drowsy, then puts them to sleep. Travels farther if it passes through terrain.

abilities.name: Portal Jump
abilities.summary: Blink to a location, then return to original position.
abilities.details: Zoe teleports to a location, then automatically returns to her original position after a moment.

playstyle.identity: Zyra is a zone control mage who spawns plants to attack enemies. Her ultimate creates a massive zone that knocks up after a delay.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive spawns seeds periodically. Q damages in a rectangle. W plants a seed (more seeds = more plants). E roots in a line. Abilities on seeds spawn plants. R creates a zone that knocks up when it ends. Place seeds, Q/E to spawn plants, R in teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zyra spikes at level 6 with her zone control R. Liandry's makes plants burn. She's strong at zone control and teamfighting.

passive.name: Garden of Thorns
passive.summary: Spawn seeds near Zyra periodically.
passive.details: Seeds periodically spawn near Zyra. They can be turned into plants by her abilities.

abilities.name: Deadly Spines
abilities.summary: Damage enemies in a rectangle; spawns plants from seeds.
abilities.details: Zyra grows thorns in an area, dealing damage. Seeds in the area become Thorn Spitters that attack enemies.

abilities.name: Rampant Growth
abilities.summary: Plant a seed; abilities hitting seeds spawn plants.
abilities.details: Zyra plants a seed that lasts for a short duration. Abilities hitting seeds spawn plants.

abilities.name: Grasping Roots
abilities.summary: Send roots that damage and root; spawns plants from seeds.
abilities.details: Zyra sends roots forward that root enemies. Seeds in the path become Vine Lashers that slow enemies.

abilities.name: Stranglethorns
abilities.summary: Create a zone of thorns; after a delay, knock up enemies inside.
abilities.details: Zyra summons a massive thicket that deals damage and enrages plants. After a delay, enemies inside are knocked up.
